01-第一段-1到12級.md:241｜交通步驟｜十字路口開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），可綁旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風（1413 51.99, 29.89）。｜Learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34). You can set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:241｜標籤｜補充｜Supplement
01-第一段-1到12級.md:243｜站內取捨｜「新的背包」值得做。帆布腳料可和提拉加德城堡其他任務一起收。｜"Carry Your Weight" is Do. Canvas scraps can be collected together with other quests of Tiragarde Keep.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:244｜站內取捨｜先交背信棄義的人類（Vanquish the Betrayers）784，才接得到海底沈船（From The Wreckage....）825。把沉船和沃納爾大師（A Solvent Spirit）818 排成同一趟。｜First hand over Vanquish the Betrayers 784, and then receive 825 (From The Wreckage....). Line up the wreck with Master Vornal (A Solvent Spirit) 818.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:245｜站內取捨｜暗巷區副本接續可先留。打算下怒焰裂谷（Ragefire Chasm）再跟索爾接隱藏的敵人（Hidden Enemies）5726→5727→5728。5726 所需的軍官徽章可在北邊火刃區取得。｜Stay in the dark alley area to continue the dungeon. Plan to take Ragefire Chasm and then follow Thrall to take Hidden Enemies 5726→5727→5728. The officer badge required for 5726 can be obtained in the northern Fire Blade area.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:246｜站內提醒｜不足 12 級可補保衛商路（Securing the Lines）、骷髏石（Skull Rock）或地底威脅（Threat from Below）前幾段。｜If you are less than 12 levels, supplement the first few paragraphs of Securing the Lines, Skull Rock or Threat from Below.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:248｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／城堡通道易多拉，先打外側／提拉加德城堡，順收新背包所需的帆布腳料｜Dense/normal mobs/castle passage Yidora, hit the outside first/Tiragarde Keep, and collect the canvas scraps needed for the new backpack
01-第一段-1到12級.md:249｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／巡邏可能加怪，先拉營地邊緣／剃刀嶺西面，可和野豬人的進犯一起做｜Concentrate / normal mobs / patrol may add monsters, first pull the edge of the camp / Razor Hill west, can be done together with Encroachment
01-第一段-1到12級.md:250｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／有施法怪，貼掩體拉到近處／北杜洛塔，做保衛商路或進奧格瑪前補到 12 級｜Concentrate/normal mobs/there are spellcasting monsters, stick to the cover and pull close/North Durotar, make Securing the Lines or make up to level 12 before entering Orgrimmar

01-第一段-1到12級.md:260｜危險說明｜北岸的海巨人在納迦區活動。清掉周圍小怪再打，跑不動時從岸上撤。｜The sea giants of the North Shore are active in the Naga Zone. Clear out the surrounding mobs and fight again. When you can't run anymore, retreat from the shore.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:471｜交通步驟｜沿大路向北到十字路口，開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），並向旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風綁爐石（1413 51.99, 29.89）。｜Follow the road north to the Crossroads. Learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:473｜站內取捨｜值得做幻象儀祭（Rite of Vision）767→771→772、智慧儀祭（Rite of Wisdom）773 和雷霆崖之旅（Journey into Thunder Bluff）775，末段正好開飛行點。｜Do Rite of Vision 767→771→772, Rite of Wisdom 773 and Journey into Thunder Bluff 775. The final section is just right for flying.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:474｜站內取捨｜水井任務先完成前一口才接下一口【僅牛頭人】。已到 12 級時可跳過蠻鬃之井支線【僅牛頭人】。｜Complete the water well quest first before taking the next one [Tauren only]. If you have reached level 12, skip the Well of Wildmane branch [Tauren only].
01-第一段-1到12級.md:474｜標籤｜僅牛頭人｜Tauren only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:475｜站內取捨｜到了雷霆崖可接怒焰裂谷（Ragefire Chasm）前置，打算進本才跟拉哈羅接試探敵人（Testing an Enemy’s Strength）5723、尋找背包（Searching for the Lost Satchel）5722。｜When it comes to Thunder Bluff, it can be connected to Ragefire Chasm preamplifier. If you plan to buy this book, connect Testing an Enemy's Strength (Testing an Enemy’s Strength) 5723 and Searching for the Lost Satchel 5722 with Rahauro.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:476｜站內提醒｜接近 12 級還差經驗，優先補莫高雷北邊鷹身人、赤色石或菲茲普羅克礦坑；10 級職業解鎖見文末。｜Need XP for level 12? Grind harpies in northern Mulgore, Red Rocks or the Venture Co. Mine. See the class quests below for level 10 unlocks.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:478｜練怪說明｜分散／一般怪／草地可逐隻拉，留意游走怪／血蹄村北側，順收馬茲拉納其材料｜Scattered/normal mobs/grass can be pulled one by one, pay attention to wandering monsters/North side of Bloodhoof Village, and collect Mazzranache materials smoothly
01-第一段-1到12級.md:479｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／混有工人與巡邏，先沿礦坑外側拉／菲茲普羅克礦坑周邊，可順做礦坑任務｜Concentrated/normal mobs/mixed with workers and patrols, first pull along the outside of Mines/Fitzprok Mines, and follow the Mines quest
01-第一段-1到12級.md:480｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／混有施法型鷹身人，先拉營地外側／莫高雷西北鷹身人營地，接近 12 級時補經驗｜Dense/normal mobs/mixed with spellcasting harpies, pull the outside of the camp first/Mulgore Northwest harpy camp, gain experience when approaching level 12
01-第一段-1到12級.md:485｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:488｜危險說明｜菲茲普羅克礦坑會把巡邏與礦工一起拉入戰。先清外側，拿到筆記板就退出洞道。｜Fitzprok Mines will bring patrols and miners into battle. Clear the outside first, get the clipboard and exit the cave.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:494｜站內交通｜跨族起點從布瑞爾南側飛艇塔下船，沿大道向西進喪鐘鎮。完整轉乘見文首。｜From another start zone, leave the zeppelin tower south of Brill and follow the road west to Deathknell.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:498｜站內提醒｜從墓穴內的 363 開始【僅不死族】。抵達喪鐘鎮後，可在暗影牧師薩維斯（1420 30.84, 66.20）接 364。若薩維斯未顯示任務，沿道路前往布瑞爾。｜Start at 363 inside the tomb [Undead only]. After arriving at Deathknell, pick up 364 at Shadow Priest Sarvis (1420 30.84, 66.20). If Xavius ​​doesn't show a quest, follow the road to Brill.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:674｜步驟說明｜16級去銀松森林時交｜Turn in when you go to Silverpine Forest at level 16
01-第一段-1到12級.md:674｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
01-第一段-1到12級.md:675｜交通步驟｜前往布瑞爾東南方的飛艇塔，到西平台找飛艇管理員薩匹塔（1420 60.74, 58.87）搭奧格瑪線。飛艇抵達杜洛塔奧格瑪正門外東側塔樓的南平台（1411 50.82, 13.54）。｜Board the Orgrimmar zeppelin at Zapetta's west platform southeast of Brill (1420 60.74, 58.87). Get off at the south platform of the east tower outside Orgrimmar (1411 50.82, 13.54).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:676｜交通步驟｜下塔進奧格瑪正門，開朵拉斯飛行點（1454 45.12, 63.89）。已開十字路口飛點就直接飛；初訪沿杜洛塔大道南下剃刀嶺，再向西過橋進貧瘠之地。抵達十字路口後開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），向旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風綁爐石（1413 51.99, 29.89），接貧瘠之地 十字路口。｜Enter Orgrimmar and learn Doras's flight path (1454 45.12, 63.89). Fly to the Crossroads if unlocked. Otherwise run south to Razor Hill, cross west into the Barrens and continue to the Crossroads. Learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:678｜站內提醒｜若 383 未接，直接從布瑞爾旅店和第一批可接任務開始。｜If 383 is not answered, start directly from Brill hotel and the first batch of available quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:679｜站內取捨｜血色、蜘蛛和墓穴草在東南同趟做；北岸魚人和阿加曼德可成一趟。先就近交，12 級就轉去十字路口。｜Blood, Spider and Tombweed can be taken together in the southeast; Murlocs and Agamand on the north shore can be taken together in one trip. Start with inbreeding, then move to The Crossroads at level 12.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:680｜站內取捨｜旅店旁的 375 需要粗線，順路向供應商買。97558 若手上仍少北岸魚人皮，可等再去北岸時完成。｜The 375 next to the hotel requires Coarse Thread, so buy it from the supplier en route. 97558 If you still lack the North Shore Murloc Skin, wait until you go to the North Shore to complete it.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:681｜站內取捨｜可在銀色黎明的兩個原地任務後接班達利昂要塞 96899【僅獸人／食人妖／不死族】。要塞的部分後續可接【僅不死族】。趕往十字路口可在銀色黎明的兩個原地任務後離開。｜Bandarion Keep 96899 [Orcs/Trolls/Undead only] can be obtained after the two local quests of the Argent Dawn. Some parts of the fortress can be picked up later [Undead only]. Rush to The Crossroads to leave after the Argent Dawn's two local quests.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:681｜標籤｜僅獸人／食人妖／不死族｜Orc/Troll/Undead only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:681｜標籤｜僅不死族｜Undead only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:682｜站內提醒｜若未到 12 級，優先補 372、408 或銀色黎明 96895／96897／96898，依可接與所在位置選擇。｜If you have not reached level 12, give priority to 372, 408 or Argent Dawn 96895/96897/96898, depending on where you are.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:684｜練怪說明｜分散／一般怪／會施法，可從營地外側逐隻拉／布瑞爾西南，與第一輪血色十字軍任務同行｜Scattered/normal mobs/can cast spells, can be pulled one by one from outside the camp/Brill southwest, accompanying the first round of The Scarlet Crusade quest
01-第一段-1到12級.md:685｜練怪說明｜集中／一般怪／與血殭屍混居，留意巡邏／東南墓地，巡查後方和墓穴草可一起做｜Concentrate/normal mobs/mix with blood zombies, pay attention to patrols/southeast cemetery, Rear Guard Patrol and tomb grass can be done together
01-第一段-1到12級.md:686｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／與黑暗執法者混居，營地邊緣較好單拉／東南銀色黎明支線附近，11 級後可補到 12｜Dense/normal mobs/mixed with Dark Enforcer, better to pull alone on the edge of the camp/near the southeastern Silver Dawn branch, after level 11 it can be supplemented to level 12
01-第一段-1到12級.md:691｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
01-第一段-1到12級.md:694｜危險說明｜東南墓地混有血殭屍與遊蕩的幽靈，容易被前後夾擊。沿墓地邊緣清，留住退路。｜There are blood zombies and Wandering Spirit mixed in the southeast cemetery, and they are easily attacked from both front and rear. Clear along the edge of the cemetery to leave an escape route.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:700｜站內交通｜跨族起點從莫高雷 天空守望者高原 南側碼頭（1412 34.30, 25.80）搭割天者號，在瓦拉納爾西碼頭（2521 57.90, 80.90）下船，再沿路北上坦德爾林地。｜From another start zone, board the Skycutter at Skywatcher Plateau's south dock in Mulgore (1412 34.30, 25.80). Get off at Valanaar's west dock (2521 57.90, 80.90) and follow the road north.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:704｜站內提醒｜抵達瓦拉納爾後沿大道北上坦德爾林地。其他部落可做共用支線，種族限定與未解鎖的前置步驟由插件過濾。1–3 級可先沿坦德爾林地打飛狐幼崽與捲雲蜂，再做可接的採集和村落支線。若已清完可接任務仍不足 12，回莫高雷接血蹄村支線補足。｜From Valanaar, follow the road north to Thendal Grove. Other Horde races can do the shared side quests. Race restrictions and missing prerequisites are filtered. At levels 1–3, kill young vuldren and cirrusflies before the gathering and village quests. If you finish below 12, do side quests in Bloodhoof Village.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:706｜粗體註記｜坦德爾村、瞭望塔與山坡｜Thendal Village, the watchtower and hills

01-第一段-1到12級.md:954｜步驟說明｜用傳送門抵達羅哈希尖塔後再進行劇情，完成後回瓦拉納爾交件。｜Portal to the spires for the event. Turn in afterward in Valanaar.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:963｜交通步驟｜到瓦拉納爾小屋外的西碼頭（2521 57.90, 80.90），在塑風者碼頭管理員所在的碼頭搭割天者號。到莫高雷 天空守望者高原 南側碼頭（1412 34.30, 25.80）下船。瓦拉納爾的東碼頭（2521 65.90, 83.50）開往達拉然。｜Board the skycutter at Valanaar's west dock (2521 57.90, 80.90), by the Skyborne dockmaster. Get off at Skywatcher Plateau's south dock in Mulgore (1412 34.30, 25.80). Valanaar's east dock (2521 65.90, 83.50) serves Dalaran.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:965｜步驟說明｜同任務也可找穆倫‧地怒（1412 33.42, 22.59）。｜The same quest can also be found at Alaana Stormwalker (1412 33.42, 22.59).

01-第一段-1到12級.md:966｜步驟說明｜之後到奧格瑪才交｜Then pay at Orgrimmar
01-第一段-1到12級.md:966｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
01-第一段-1到12級.md:967｜交通步驟｜從 天空守望者高原 沿地面道路南下，搭雷霆崖電梯上城，先開塔爾飛行點（1456 47.00, 49.83）。若十字路口飛點已開，可直接飛過去。初訪則沿莫高雷大道走東側山口，經陶拉祖營地開歐姆薩·雷角飛行點（1413 44.45, 59.15），再沿大路往北。到十字路口開迪弗拉克飛行點（1413 51.50, 30.34），向旅店老闆伯蘭德·草風綁爐石（1413 51.99, 29.89），接貧瘠之地 十字路口。｜Run south from Skywatcher Plateau, take the lift to Thunder Bluff and learn Tal's flight path (1456 47.00, 49.83). Fly to the Crossroads if unlocked. Otherwise leave Mulgore via the east pass, learn Camp Taurajo from Omusa Thunderhorn (1413 44.45, 59.15), then follow the road north. In the Crossroads, learn Devrak's flight path (1413 51.50, 30.34) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind (1413 51.99, 29.89).
01-第一段-1到12級.md:969｜站內取捨｜本島主線依序走坦德爾、申德村、瓦拉納爾、奧基爾聖殿。還沒到12級可先做果園或影風森林支線，再搭飛艇。｜The main line of the island takes Tandel, Shen'dar Village, Valanaar and Shrine of Akir in sequence. If you haven't reached level 12 yet, first do the Orchard or Shadowgale Forest side quest, and then take the zeppelin.
01-第一段-1到12級.md:970｜站內取捨｜村旁學徒和強盜任務可一起接。也可同時接角鷹獸騷擾（Hippogryph Harassment）92516【僅天裔精靈】。群爪問題（The Problem With Prideclaws）給簡易皮革背袋。愛管閒事的法師（Meddlesome Mages）可選潮汐流轉塑像【僅德魯伊】。完成火之召喚可取得充能烈焰圖騰【僅薩滿】。｜The village apprentice and bandit quests can be taken together. also connect Hippogryph Harassment 92516 [only Skyborne] at the same time. The Problem With Prideclaws to Simple Leather Satchel. Meddlesome Mages Optional Idol of Shifting Tides [Druids only]. Complete Call of Fire to obtain Totem of Charged Flames [Shaman only].

01-第一段-1到12級.md:974｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／可逐隻開怪，留意鄰近蜂群／坦德爾林地，1–2 級可先在起點附近升級｜Dense/normal mobs/open monsters one by one, pay attention to nearby swarms/Thendal Grove, level 1-2 can be upgraded near the starting point first
01-第一段-1到12級.md:975｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／強盜會成群，先清營地邊緣／申德高地，與犯罪元素及被偷走的風石同行｜Dense/normal mobs/robbers will gather in groups, clear the edge of the camp first/Shen'dar Highlands, and go with The Criminal Element and Pilfered Windstones
01-第一段-1到12級.md:976｜練怪說明｜密集／一般怪／混有步行兵，先從營地外側拉／影風森林，順做不屑為伍也不夠格之人，接近 12 級時補經驗｜Dense/normal mobs/mixed with foot soldiers, first pull/Shadowgale Forest from the outside of the camp, followed by Unwanted and Unworthy, gain experience when approaching level 12

01-第一段-1到12級.md:991｜危險說明｜坦德爾林地瞭望塔的跳下路線需要空中行走。先把種族技能放上快捷列，跳下後立即用。｜Thendal Grove The jump route from the observation tower requires walking on the air. Put the racial skills on the shortcut list first, and use them immediately after jumping off.

01-第一段-1到12級.md:992｜危險說明｜影風森林營地的奧拉凱斯追風者混在步行兵之間，別穿營地中央，沿外圈逐隻拉。｜Shadowgale Forest Al'Aketh Stormchaser in the camp should be mixed among the foot soldiers. Don't go through the center of the camp and pull them one by one along the outer circle.

02-12到30級.md:118｜交通步驟｜從棘齒城沿西南路到死水綠洲，清完綠洲目標再走回十字路口交件，保留爐石供銀松回程。｜Take the southwest road to the Stagnant Oasis. Clear it and run back to the Crossroads to turn in. Save your hearth for the return from Silverpine.

02-12到30級.md:133｜交通步驟｜選做雷霆崖支線時，已開塔爾的飛行點就從十字路口搭鳥。沒開時由陶拉祖營地沿路入莫高雷，搭雷霆崖電梯上城，找塔爾開點（1456 47.00, 49.83）。853 計時從接取開始，只有能及時到達才接。｜For the optional Thunder Bluff detour, fly from the Crossroads if unlocked. Otherwise enter Mulgore via Camp Taurajo, take the lift and learn Tal's flight path (1456 47.00, 49.83). Quest 853 starts a timer on pickup. Take it only if you can make it.

02-12到30級.md:143｜步驟說明｜雷霆崖靈魂高地的克拉莉斯，留銀松森林 瑟伯切爾在銀松交。｜Pick up from Clarice on Spirit Rise. Turn in at the Sepulcher later.
02-12到30級.md:143｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
02-12到30級.md:144｜交通步驟｜從目前所在的十字路口或雷霆崖飛奧格瑪，前提是已開奧格瑪飛點。從十字路口首次去奧格瑪，走東北大道過怒水河再沿杜洛塔大道北上；從雷霆崖首次去，先飛十字路口。進城找朵拉斯開點（1454 45.12, 63.89）。｜Fly to Orgrimmar if unlocked. For your first visit, start at the Crossroads, cross the Southfury River and follow the Durotar road north. From Thunder Bluff, fly to the Crossroads first. Unlock Orgrimmar with Doras (1454 45.12, 63.89).
02-12到30級.md:145｜步驟說明｜順路進奧格瑪智慧谷才接，留石爪山脈 烈日石居找希雷斯。｜Pick up in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom. See Seereth on the Sun Rock Retreat leg.
02-12到30級.md:145｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
02-12到30級.md:145｜標籤｜13級起｜Lv 13+
02-12到30級.md:146｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪出城，走到杜洛塔飛艇塔的弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）所在一側，往銀松森林時搭提里斯法林地線。爐石保持十字路口。｜Leave Orgrimmar and board the Tirisfal Glades zeppelin at Frezza's platform (1411 50.82, 13.54). Keep your hearth at the Crossroads.
02-12到30級.md:148｜站內交通｜第 4 步開十字路口並綁爐石；第一趟棘齒城開布萊格；離站到弗雷薩一側等提里斯法林地線。｜Step 4: Drive The Crossroads and tie the hearthstone; drive Bragok for the first Ratchet; leave the station and wait for the Tirisfal Glades line on the Fresa side.
02-12到30級.md:149｜站內取捨｜值得做 870 → 877 → 880，只有交完才開往銀松的 3301。TUGs 把 880 排到另一次貧瘠之地，本路線提早清完，方便下一站直接交 3301。｜Do 870 → 877 → 880, and only 3301 bound for Silver Pine after paying. TUGs queued 880 to another The Barrens. This route was cleared early, so that 3301 could be transferred directly to the next stop.
02-12到30級.md:150｜站內取捨｜北側沼澤護送、礦洞與 888 留貧瘠之地 棘齒城與陶拉祖營地一起做，第一次到棘齒城只清近岸海盜。｜Escort the swamp, mine and 888 on the north side. Leave The Barrens Ratchet and Camp Taurajo together. The first time you go to Ratchet, you will only clear the offshore pirates.
02-12到30級.md:151｜站內取捨｜雷霆崖 853、1489、264 看是否順路；若已 16 級又無哀嚎隊伍，可直接轉銀松。｜Thunder Bluff 853, 1489, 264 to see if it goes your way; if you are already level 16 and there is no wailing team, directly transfer to Silver Pine.
02-12到30級.md:152｜站內提醒｜14–16 可選怒焰裂谷；主線無須排到副本。未滿 16 可提前做貧瘠之地 棘齒城與陶拉祖營地的 881、875，或在死水綠洲（約 55, 42）打變異龜，走下一站前先交現成的任務。｜Ragefire Chasm is optional at 14–16. Below 16, do 881 and 875 early at Ratchet and Camp Taurajo or grind turtles at Stagnant Oasis (about 55, 42). Turn in completed quests before leaving.
02-12到30級.md:155｜練怪說明｜十字路口東南的開闊平原，密度中等、普通怪。附近有半人馬巡邏，沿路挑落單的陸行鳥，適合 12–13 級補開局經驗。｜The Crossroads The open plain in the southeast, with medium density and normal mobs. There are centaurs patrolling nearby and picking up lone chocobos en route. It is suitable for level 12-13 to replenish starting experience.
02-12到30級.md:156｜練怪說明｜死水綠洲岸邊密度高，普通怪；往外拉，留意附近的科卡爾。可同步補變異的鉗嘴龜殼。｜The Stagnant Oasis The density on the shore is high and there are normal mobs; pull out and pay attention to Kokar nearby. The mutated jaw turtle shell can be replenished.
02-12到30級.md:162｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:163｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊,盜賊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:167｜危險說明｜棘齒城南的南海炮兵與海盜會從高低兩層一起加入。先清山腳再上坡取零件。｜Ratchet South's South Seas Artillery and pirates will join together from the upper and lower floors. First clear the foot of the mountain and then go uphill to get the parts.
02-12到30級.md:175｜交通步驟｜在杜洛塔城外飛艇塔，找弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）確認提里斯法林地線再登艇。到布瑞爾南方的飛艇塔後沿大道往幽暗城；保留十字路口爐石。｜At the Durotar zeppelin tower, confirm the Tirisfal Glades route with Frezza (1411 50.82, 13.54). Get off south of Brill and follow the road to Undercity. Keep your hearth at the Crossroads.
02-12到30級.md:176｜交通步驟｜尚未開幽暗城飛點就進城找邁克爾·加勒特（1458 63.25, 48.56）。若已開瑟伯切爾就飛去；首次到瑟伯切爾先出幽暗城，沿提里斯法林地西南的大路進銀松森林。｜Learn Undercity's flight path from Michael Garrett (1458 63.25, 48.56). Fly to the Sepulcher if unlocked. Otherwise leave the city and take Tirisfal's southwest road into Silverpine Forest.

02-12到30級.md:334｜交通步驟｜有幽暗城待交的任務時，從瑟伯切爾飛幽暗城一趟；沒有待交任務即可在瑟伯切爾直接用下一個爐石步驟。｜Fly to Undercity if you have turn-ins there. Otherwise hearth straight from the Sepulcher at the next step.

02-12到30級.md:340｜交通步驟｜用先前綁好的爐石回貧瘠之地 十字路口。爐石不可用時，由幽暗城出城到布瑞爾南塔，找薩匹塔（1420 60.74, 58.87，西平台）確認奧格瑪線；下艇後進奧格瑪飛十字路口。｜Hearth to the Crossroads. If your hearth is unavailable, board the Orgrimmar zeppelin at Zapetta's west platform south of Brill (1420 60.74, 58.87), then fly to the Crossroads.
02-12到30級.md:342｜站內交通｜初訪瑟伯切爾先走地面；開點後才飛。回程優先用十字路口爐石，冷卻時才搭奧格瑪飛艇。｜First visit The Sepulcher Walk on the ground first; fly after turning on the point. On the return trip, use the The Crossroads hearthstone first, and only take the Orgrimmar zeppelin when it’s cooled down.
02-12到30級.md:343｜站內取捨｜值得做｜先解鎖 479 與永恆版 95981，同一趟掃安伯米爾；479 交回後再殺 480 的法師。｜Do | Unlock 479 and eternal version 95981 first, scan Ambermill in the same trip; return 479 and then kill the 480 mage.
02-12到30級.md:344｜站內取捨｜值得做｜焚木村一起做 99、450；交 99 後一次接 98298、98299，到葛雷邁恩之牆一起清。｜Do | Pyrewood Village Do 99 and 450 together; hand in 99 and then pick up 98298 and 98299 at once, and clear the Greymane Wall together.
02-12到30級.md:345｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜走到 20 級便可以回貧瘠之地。優先跳過還沒進場的護送 435、伏擊 452 與影牙城堡支線。若已接 447、444 等幽暗城交付，從瑟伯切爾飛回時順便交。｜Optional|return to The Barrens when you reach level 20. Prioritize skipping the Escort 435, Ambush 452 and Shadowfang Keep branches that have not yet entered the scene. If you have already received delivery of Undercity such as 447 and 444, turn it in when flying back from The Sepulcher.
02-12到30級.md:346｜站內取捨｜先別交｜493 在 19 級接到後留給希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾。路線先回貧瘠之地，不另跑一趟塔倫米爾。｜Don't turn it in yet | 493 will be left to Hillsbrad Foothills Tarren Mill after receiving it at level 19. The route returns to The Barrens first, instead of taking another trip to Tarren Mill.
02-12到30級.md:347｜站內提醒｜若低於 20 級，先清葛雷邁恩之牆（約 43, 81）或安伯米爾（約 63, 65）剩餘的單人任務和普通怪。有隊伍時可打影牙城堡；1013 最低 16 級，1014、1098 最低 18 級。｜If it is lower than level 20, first clear the remaining single-player quests and normal mobs in Greymane Wall (approximately 43, 81) or Ambermill (approximately 63, 65). play Shadowfang Keep when you have a team; the minimum level of 1013 is 16, and the minimum level of 1014 and 1098 is 18.
02-12到30級.md:350｜練怪說明｜安伯米爾外圍密度中等，普通遠程怪；先清路邊，用地形拉離房屋門口，減少連帶引怪。｜Ambermill The peripheral density is medium, and there are ordinary remote monsters; clear the roadside first, and use the terrain to pull it away from the door of the house to reduce the risk of attracting monsters.
02-12到30級.md:351｜練怪說明｜安伯米爾外圈密度中等，普通遠程怪；附近有衛士，逐隻打。離原本達拉然任務近。｜Ambermill The density in the outer circle is medium, and there are ordinary long-range monsters; there are guards nearby, so fight them one by one. Close to the original Dalaran quest.
02-12到30級.md:352｜練怪說明｜葛雷邁恩之牆前密度高，普通怪；近牆區域較擠，從路邊逐隻拉，適合離站前補到 20 級。｜The density in front of the Greymane Wall is high, and there are normal mobs; the area near the wall is crowded, so pull them one by one from the roadside, which is suitable for reaching level 20 before leaving the station.

02-12到30級.md:367｜危險說明｜銀松森林有 24–25 級精英阿魯高之子巡邏。看到精英就繞開，別往林內逃。｜Silverpine Forest is patrolled by the elite level 24–25 Sons of Arugal. If you see an elite, avoid it and don't run into the forest.
02-12到30級.md:368｜危險說明｜焚木村通往葛雷邁恩之牆的路也會遇到阿魯高之子。做完伏擊就走，別沿牆追怪。｜Pyrewood Village The path to Greymane Wall also encounters the Sons of Arugal. After completing the ambush, leave, don't chase monsters along the wall.
02-12到30級.md:377｜粗體註記｜從銀松返回十字路口，先掃北側｜Back from Silverpine: clear north of the Crossroads first
02-12到30級.md:379｜交通步驟｜銀松森林 瑟伯切爾已回十字路口者在營地接任。中途加入且仍在東部王國，優先爐石回十字路口；爐石不可用則搭布瑞爾南塔的奧格瑪線，再從奧格瑪飛十字路口。十字路口爐石先留到北線清完。｜Pick up quests if you're already back at the Crossroads. Joining from the Eastern Kingdoms? Hearth there, or take the Orgrimmar zeppelin south of Brill and fly to the Crossroads. Save your hearth for the end of the northern loop.

Otherwise take the east road and learn Ratchet from Bragok (1413 63.08, 37.16). Keep quest 894 if you picked it up at the Crossroads.

02-12到30級.md:544｜站內交通｜北側清完用爐石回十字路口，先交營地任務再飛棘齒城。初到陶拉祖營地補開飛點。｜After clearing the north side, use the hearthstone to return to The Crossroads. First, hand in the camp quest and then fly to Ratchet. First arrived at Camp Taurajo to make up for flying points.
02-12到30級.md:545｜站內取捨｜值得做 878、95774、899 的重疊目標。899 需要 60 根獠牙，不夠就留在背包，等級達標時可省去單刷。｜Do overlapping targets of 878, 95774, 899. 899 requires 60 fangs. If you don’t have enough, keep them in your backpack. skip the single brushing when the level reaches the standard.
02-12到30級.md:546｜站內取捨｜開往石爪山的 1060、1483 在下一站交，1069 先採卵、下次順路回棘齒城才交。6382 與選做的 6543 留灰谷。｜1060 and 1483 bound for Stone Claw Mountain will be handed in at the next stop. 1069 will be handed in after collecting eggs first and then returning to Ratchet next time. 6382 Leave Ashenvale with the optional 6543 option.
02-12到30級.md:547｜站內取捨｜20 級精英 92706、半人馬事件 4021、邊境 97250 組隊再做；北方城堡護送容易引到沿路怪，也可略過。｜Level 20 Elite 92706, Centaur Incident 4021, Border 97250 can be done in a team; Northwatch Hold Escort can easily attract monsters en route, so also skip it.
02-12到30級.md:548｜站內取捨｜礦工的寶貝掉率偏低，已打不出便去做路線後段；四個稀有只在遇到並拾到物品時觸發。｜Miner's Fortune has a low drop rate, so if you can’t get it out, go to the back of the route; the four rare ones are only triggered when you encounter and pick up items.
02-12到30級.md:549｜站內提醒｜未到 23 級可在肅清原野 98093 的怪點（47.11, 77.38）續打蜥蜴、潛獵者，或南下接 843。哀嚎洞穴入口約 47.70, 35.00，建議 18–23 級跑。可帶貧瘠之地 十字路口已解鎖的尖牙德魯伊 914、毒蛇花 962，棘齒城港口的麻煩 959、智慧飲料 1491，以及洞外岩台的變異皮革 1486、清除變異者 1487。｜Below 23, grind lizards and stalkers at Field to Clear (47.11, 77.38) or head south for 843. Wailing Caverns (47.70, 35.00) is best at 18–23. Pick up 914 and 962 at the Crossroads, 959 and 1491 at Ratchet, and 1486 and 1487 on the ledge outside.
02-12到30級.md:552｜練怪說明｜肅清原野密度高，普通怪；在草地輪巡，留意憤恨的掠取者精英，避開戰團中央。｜Field to Clear has high density and is an normal mob; patrol the grassland, pay attention to Outraged Pillager elites, and avoid the center of the battle group.
02-12到30級.md:553｜練怪說明｜與雷鱗蜥蜴同一片草地，密度高、普通怪；有其他玩家清同區時，沿外圈補另一種怪，不必轉營地。｜The same grassland as Stormhide, with high density and normal mobs; when other players clear the same area, they can fill in another type of monster along the outer circle without changing camps.
02-12到30級.md:560｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:565｜危險說明｜肅清原野的精英掠取者在普通怪之間巡邏。只打外圈蜥蜴，避免穿過戰團。｜Field to Clear's elite raiders patrol among normal mobs. Only fight the outer ring of lizards to avoid running through the battle group.
02-12到30級.md:566｜危險說明｜通往塵泥沼澤的邊境有成群聯盟士兵。沒有隊伍可略過遭錯怪，得平反。｜The border leading to Dustwallow Marsh has hordes of Alliance soldiers. No team can skip Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected.

Learn the flight path from Tharm (1442 45.12, 59.84) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Jayka (1442 47.47, 62.13). Save it until the southern pass turn-ins are done.

02-12到30級.md:649｜交通步驟｜做完雷霆崖選做支線先從雷霆崖飛奧格瑪。從奧格瑪出城，到杜洛塔飛艇塔弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）處確認提里斯法林地線；搭到布瑞爾南塔，再走到幽暗城。接續往希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾。｜After the optional Thunder Bluff quests, fly to Orgrimmar. Board the Tirisfal zeppelin at Frezza's platform (1411 50.82, 13.54). Get off south of Brill, head to Undercity, then continue to Tarren Mill.
02-12到30級.md:651｜站內交通｜烈日石居首次開點和綁爐石；留爐石給南側山口交件後回烈日石居，續飛棘齒城。｜Sun Rock Retreat is opened for the first time and the hearth stone is tied; leave the hearth stone to the south mountain pass and return to Sun Rock Retreat, and continue the flight to Ratchet.
02-12到30級.md:652｜站內取捨｜值得做。暗色湖撿蓋亞之種，石爪峰清塞納留斯的遺產。交回種子後，焦炭谷四項同趟做。千針石林 亂風崗路過大升降梯再交 5881。｜Do. Mirkfallon Lake picks up Gaea Seed, Stonetalon Peak clears Cenarius' Legacy. After returning the seeds, do the four items The Charred Vale in the same trip. Thousand Needles Freewind Post Passing by The Great Lift, please pay 5881 again.
02-12到30級.md:653｜站內取捨｜之後順路。1088 在梣谷 碎木崗哨打奧達努斯；1095～1096 只有日後會回狂風峭壁才續做，少一趟棘齒城往返。｜Drop by later. 1088 Call Ordanus at Ashenvale Splintertree Post; 1095~1096 can only be continued if you return to Windshear Crag in the future, one less round trip to Ratchet.
02-12到30級.md:654｜站內取捨｜可跳過。貝瑟萊斯、土靈的覺醒要打精英；1058 要刷多種野獸且交件在南端，已有足夠材料才交。｜Optional. For Besseleth and Earthen Arise, fight elites; for 1058, farm a variety of beasts and submit the materials at the south end. Only when you have enough materials can you submit them.
02-12到30級.md:655｜站內提醒｜沒到25級時在焦炭谷外圍（約32, 64）補血怒鷹身人或火元素，先打單隻落單怪。｜Before reaching level 25, add Bloodfury Harpy or fire element outside The Charred Vale (approximately 32, 64), and kill only the lone monster first.
02-12到30級.md:658｜練怪說明｜焦炭谷東側入口密度中等，普通怪；外圍先挑落單，留意巡邏，23 級即可補經驗。｜The Charred Vale The east entrance has a medium density and contains normal mobs; pick out single monsters on the outside first, and pay attention to patrols. gain experience at level 23.
02-12到30級.md:659｜練怪說明｜焦炭谷東側密度高，普通施法怪；利用山壁拉出營地，避免把巢群一起引來。可同時做焦炭谷任務。｜The Charred Vale The east side has a high density and contains ordinary spell-casting monsters; use the mountain wall to pull out the camp to avoid attracting the nest group together. The Charred Vale quests can be performed at the same time.
02-12到30級.md:665｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:666｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
02-12到30級.md:668｜危險說明｜蛛網山地有精英蜘蛛貝瑟萊斯。先清周圍小蜘蛛，沒有隊伍可跳過。｜There is an elite spider Besseleth in Spider Web Mountain. Clear the surrounding little spiders first, there are no teams to jump over.
02-12到30級.md:669｜危險說明｜滾岩峽谷洞裡路窄，開桶召出高戈羅克前先清洞口到桶邊的退路。｜Boulderslide Ravine The road in the cave is narrow. Before opening the barrel to summon Goggeroc, clear the retreat from the cave entrance to the barrel.
02-12到30級.md:677｜交通步驟｜石爪山脈 烈日石居已進幽暗城者從城內出發。塔倫米爾飛點已開可直飛；初訪先飛瑟伯切爾，再沿南路到銀松通往希爾斯布萊德的東側道路，過丘陵沿北岔路到塔倫米爾。瑟伯切爾未開點則由幽暗城先走地面。若中途加入仍在卡林多，才先到奧格瑪城外搭飛艇。｜Start from Undercity if you arrived from Sun Rock Retreat. Fly to Tarren Mill if unlocked. Otherwise fly to the Sepulcher, follow the south road east into Hillsbrad, then take the north fork. Walk from Undercity if needed. If still in Kalimdor, board the zeppelin outside Orgrimmar first.
02-12到30級.md:678｜交通步驟｜初訪找札瑞斯開塔倫米爾飛行點（1424 60.14, 18.62），並向旅店老闆沙恩綁爐石（1424 62.78, 19.03）。｜On arrival, learn Zarise's flight path (1424 60.14, 18.62) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Shay (1424 62.78, 19.03).

02-12到30級.md:749｜交通步驟｜離開幽暗城，走到布瑞爾南方飛艇塔，在薩匹塔（1420 60.74, 58.87，西平台）一側等奧格瑪線，前往千針石林 亂風崗時搭這班船。若已到 29 級且亂風崗已完成，抵奧格瑪後可直接轉梣谷 碎木崗哨。｜Board the Orgrimmar zeppelin south of Brill at Zapetta's west platform (1420 60.74, 58.87) for Freewind Post. At level 29 with Freewind Post finished, go straight from Orgrimmar to Splintertree Post.
02-12到30級.md:751｜站內交通｜初訪先由瑟伯切爾步行至塔倫米爾；開札瑞斯飛點、向沙恩綁爐石。離站從幽暗城走到布瑞爾南塔搭奧格瑪線。｜For the first visit, first walk from The Sepulcher to Tarren Mill; open Zarise and tie the hearthstone to Shane. From the station, walk from Undercity to Brill South Tower and take line Orgrimmar.
02-12到30級.md:752｜站內取捨｜值得做｜496、501 在西面同一趟收集，搭配希爾斯布萊德之戰 527。交 527 後才出現 546，之後殺人類時一路收頭骨。｜Do | 496 and 501 are collected on the same trip in the west, paired with Battle of Hillsbrad 527. After turning in 527, 546 appears, and then when killing humans, collect the skulls en route.
02-12到30級.md:753｜站內取捨｜值得做｜98094、509 順路完成馬索吉周圍的兩個任務；若接了 1066，再到敦霍爾德外圍。Forever XP 走完才補滿顱骨，此處從 528 起就順手收。｜Do |98094, 509 Complete the two quests around Masoji en route; if you take 1066, go to the outside of Durnholde. The skull was filled up only after Forever
02-12到30級.md:754｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜若 567 缺目標且需為此折返，直接前往下一站。丹加洛克 541 怪多，獨行可留到等級更高；98095 西側山脊有高等山獅，趕路時略過整條支線。｜Optional|If there is no target in 567 and turn back for this purpose, go directly to the next stop. Dun Garok 541 There are many monsters, so stay alone until the level is higher; there is a high-level Mountain Cougar on the ridge on the west side of 98095. Skip the entire side quest when you are on your way.
02-12到30級.md:755｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜若石爪山脈 烈日石居已接 1065，趁敦霍爾德行程完成 1066，帶 1067 給千針石林 亂風崗途經雷霆崖時交。｜En route afterwards|If Stonetalon Mountains Sun Rock Retreat has already received 1065, take advantage of Durnholde's itinerary to complete 1066 and bring 1067 to Thousand Needles Freewind Post when passing through Thunder Bluff.
02-12到30級.md:756｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜509 → 513 完成後，希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾可在幽暗城接 515，再回希爾斯布萊德海岸做。｜Then stop by | 509 → 513. After completing Hillsbrad Foothills Tarren Mill, pick up 515 at Undercity, and then return to the coast of Hillsbrad to do it.
02-12到30級.md:757｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜想現在救敦霍爾德城堡的兩名囚犯，可順做克魯斯克的拯救行動（The Rescue，498）；同地的通緝：辛迪加成員（WANTED: Syndicate Personnel，549）可一起做。奧特蘭克山脈收錄兩個任務的完整步驟。完成 498 後 29 級才接續秘密潛入（Infiltration，533）。｜Later | If you want to rescue the two prisoners Durnholde Keep now, do The Rescue (The Rescue, 498) of Krusk; do WANTED: Syndicate Personnel (WANTED: Syndicate Personnel, 549) in the same place together. Alterac Mountains contains the complete steps of the two quests. Infiltration (Infiltration, 533) is only continued at level 29 after completing 498.
02-12到30級.md:758｜站內提醒｜到 27 級即可轉千針石林 亂風崗短訪，再進梣谷。仍低於 27 級時先在西側希爾斯布萊德農場（約 33, 42）打農夫，或清敦霍爾德城堡外圍（約 77, 43）的普通辛迪加成員；有隊伍可再挑戰丹加洛克。｜When you reach level 27, transfer to Thousand Needles Freewind Post short visit, and then enter Ashenvale. When it is still below level 27, first fight the farmers at Hillsbrad Fields (about 33, 42) on the west side, or clear the ordinary syndicate members outside Durnholde Keep (about 77, 43); if you have a team, challenge Dun Garok again.
02-12到30級.md:761｜練怪說明｜希爾斯布萊德農場東側密度中等，普通怪；避開農舍門口的群怪，可同步收人類顱骨。｜Hillsbrad Fields The density on the east side is medium, and there are normal mobs; avoid the group of monsters at the farmhouse door, and collect human skulls at the same time.
02-12到30級.md:762｜練怪說明｜農場中段密度中等，普通怪；沿田邊找巡邏步卒，避開同時站著議員與農夫的屋內。｜Farm The density in the middle section is medium, and there are normal mobs; look for patrol infantry along the edge of the field, and avoid the house where the congressman and the farmer are standing at the same time.
02-12到30級.md:763｜練怪說明｜敦霍爾德城堡北側的野外林地密度較低，普通怪；避開城堡人群，適合沿東側主線回程時補幾隻。｜Durnholde Keep The wild woodland on the north side has a low density and contains normal mobs; to avoid the crowds in the castle, it is suitable to pick up a few monsters en route back along the main line on the east side.
02-12到30級.md:769｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only

02-12到30級.md:774｜危險說明｜丹加洛克的火槍手、牧師與巡山人會在階梯口互相支援。隊伍先清外圈，再進室內找上尉。｜Dun Garok Musketeers, priests, and rangers will support each other at the top of the stairs. The team first clears the outer circle, then goes indoors to find the captain.
02-12到30級.md:775｜危險說明｜放西峰藥劑瓶要經雪怪洞上方。遇到高等山獅就沿坡繞開，避免直接上陡坡。｜To put the Xifeng potion bottle, go above the snow monster cave. If you encounter high-level Mountain Cougar, go around it along the slope and avoid going directly up the steep slope.
02-12到30級.md:783｜交通步驟｜在布瑞爾南方飛艇塔找薩匹塔（1420 60.74, 58.87，西平台）確認奧格瑪線。抵杜洛塔後進奧格瑪；有 1067 要交就先飛雷霆崖再飛陶拉祖，否則從奧格瑪飛陶拉祖。若仍在塔倫米爾才先飛幽暗城轉飛艇。｜Confirm the Orgrimmar zeppelin at Zapetta's west platform south of Brill (1420 60.74, 58.87). Enter Orgrimmar after landing. Fly through Thunder Bluff if turning in 1067. Otherwise fly directly to Camp Taurajo. If still in Tarren Mill, fly to Undercity first.

02-12到30級.md:796｜步驟說明｜同任務也可找勞恩·峭壁行者（46.14, 51.71）。｜The same quest can also be found in Rau Cliffrunner (46.14, 51.71).
02-12到30級.md:799｜交通步驟｜先繞亂風崗北側半人馬營地，再去多恩和風蛇巢。｜Clear the centaur camps north of Freewind Post, then head to Dorn and the wind serpent nests.
02-12到30級.md:802｜步驟說明｜只從多恩傳送點正前方突出的木板跳，成功會傳回多恩。｜Jump from the plank directly in front of Dorn. A successful jump teleports you back.
02-12到30級.md:810｜交通步驟｜到西邊先清尖嘯鷹身人與補給箱，再沿谷底接風巢和白沙崗哨。｜Clear the screeching harpies and supply crates to the west. Follow the valley through Highperch to Whitereach Post.
02-12到30級.md:811｜步驟說明｜與 98070 同一區，從亂風崗往西，沿鷹身人坡地到洞內找可互動的補給箱。｜Go west from Freewind Post. The crate is in the harpy cave used for 98070.
02-12到30級.md:811｜步驟說明｜遊戲實測物件 670338 的三個採集點。｜Three collection points of the measured object 670338 in the game.
02-12到30級.md:813｜步驟說明｜在洞底破壞補給箱才會刷出格林卡·血嘯，可先清洞。｜Clear the cave first. Break the crate at the back to spawn Grenka Bloodscreech.

02-12到30級.md:849｜交通步驟｜從目前的亂風崗或雷霆崖搭鳥。碎木崗哨飛點已開可直飛；初訪先飛十字路口，沿貧瘠之地北路越過莫爾杉壁壘，沿梣谷東側大道抵碎木崗哨。｜Fly from Freewind Post or Thunder Bluff. If Splintertree Post is locked, fly to the Crossroads and run north past Mor'shan Rampart into Ashenvale, then follow the east road to Splintertree.
02-12到30級.md:851｜站內交通｜奧格瑪進城飛陶拉祖；從貧瘠之地南端搭大升降梯下谷，亂風崗首次開點。雷霆崖有 5062 才繞。｜Orgrimmar flies into the city to Taurajo; from the south end of The Barrens, take The Great Lift down to the valley, and Freewind Post opens for the first time. Thunder Bluff has 5062.
02-12到30級.md:852｜站內取捨｜值得做。石爪山脈 烈日石居的信直接交大升降梯守衛。亂風崗西邊的補給箱、三種鷹身人和耐力試煉共用區域。｜Do. The letter of Stonetalon Mountains Sun Rock Retreat is directly guarded by The Great Lift of Jiaotong University. Freewind Post The supply box to the west, the area shared by three types of harpies and the endurance trial.
02-12到30級.md:853｜站內取捨｜之後順路。影片先講梣谷，再提中途跑一趟千針石林。這裡把亂風崗短訪排在梣谷主線前；閃光平原整圈留千針石林 閃光平原。｜Drop by later. The video first talks about Ashenvale, and then mentions Thousand Needles in the middle. Here, Freewind Post short visit is ranked before Ashenvale main line; The Shimmering Flats is left in the full circle with Thousand Needles The Shimmering Flats.
02-12到30級.md:854｜站內取捨｜可跳過。拉克塔護送、豹籠和西側巡邏後續較費時；有隊友或正在經過目標再做。｜Optional. Rarc Tower escort, leopard cage and west side patrol follow-up is more time-consuming; do it when you have teammates or are passing the target.
02-12到30級.md:855｜站內提醒｜若要打剃刀沼澤，入口在大升降梯前的貧瘠之地南端。未達本段預期進度，可以在亂風崗西側的尖嘯鷹身人坡地（約27, 51）補經驗。｜To hit Razorfen Kraul, the entrance is at the south end of The Barrens in front of the big The Great Lift. If you have not reached the expected progress in this section, gain experience at the Screaming Harpy Slope (approximately 27, 51) on the west side of Freewind Post.
02-12到30級.md:858｜練怪說明｜亂風崗西側谷地密度中等，普通怪；在谷底逐隻打，不必繞到鷹身人營地。｜Freewind Post The density of the valley on the west side is medium, and there are normal mobs; fight them one by one at the bottom of the valley without going around to the harpy camp.
02-12到30級.md:859｜練怪說明｜西側鷹身人坡地密度中等，普通怪；營地同時有其他鷹身人，沿坡緣挑落單，可順做尖嘯鷹身人任務。｜The density of the harpies on the west side of the slope is medium, and there are normal mobs. There are other harpies in the camp at the same time. If you pick them up along the edge of the slope, complete the Screaming Harpy quest.
02-12到30級.md:865｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only

02-12到30級.md:869｜危險說明｜升降梯落差會致死。過亂風崗橋面或北端升降梯時先等平台到位。｜The Great Lift Falls can kill. When crossing Freewind Post bridge deck or north end The Great Lift, wait for the platform to be in place.
02-12到30級.md:870｜危險說明｜鷹身人洞穴開補給箱會觸發敵人。清掉箱旁小怪並留好出口後再開。｜Opening supply boxes in the Harpy Cave will trigger enemies. Clear out the mobs next to the box and leave the exit open before opening it.

02-12到30級.md:963｜交通步驟｜剛在北側交完戰歌報告者回十字路口飛奧格瑪。其餘從目前所在的碎木崗哨、佐拉姆加前哨站或烈日石居飛奧格瑪。訓練 30 級技能後，在弗雷薩（1411 50.82, 13.54）一側搭提里斯法林地線，在布瑞爾下艇後往幽暗城。只有確定不用進幽暗城交接或訓練，才直接用保留在塔倫米爾的爐石。｜After turning in the Warsong Reports, fly from the Crossroads to Orgrimmar. Otherwise fly from your current outpost. Train level 30 skills, board the Tirisfal zeppelin at Frezza's platform (1411 50.82, 13.54) and head to Undercity from Brill. Hearth to Tarren Mill only if you need nothing in Undercity.
02-12到30級.md:965｜站內交通｜先開碎木崗哨，再開佐拉姆加；依待交任務選碎木崗哨、烈日石居、十字路口，或從佐拉姆加直接飛奧格瑪。保留塔倫米爾爐石。｜Fly Splintertree Post first, then Zoramaga; choose Splintertree Post, Sun Rock Retreat, The Crossroads according to the quests to be handed over, or fly directly from Zoramaga to Orgrimmar. Reserve Tarren Mill Hearthstone.
02-12到30級.md:966｜站內取捨｜值得做。碎木崗哨南側先驅者、西南湖元素、北側薩特各做一圈；佐拉姆加的熊怪與洞穴符咒一起解。｜Do. Splintertree Post Make a circle each for the Pioneer on the south side, the Lake Elemental on the southwestern side, and the Satyr on the north side; solve the furbolg in Zoramgar and the cave talisman together.
02-12到30級.md:967｜站內取捨｜可跳過。三隻獵物會巡邏，只在順路遇到時打。散頁沒集滿可留到日後交易，不必反覆刷。｜Optional. Three prey animals will patrol and only hunt when encountered en route. If the loose pages are not full, save them for future transactions, so you don’t have to swipe them repeatedly.
02-12到30級.md:968｜站內取捨｜之後順路。29級後若本來就要跑十字路口和奧格瑪，可先接 1145，交奧格瑪後接 1146。到千針石林 閃光平原交 1146 才能接 1147；與本段交通不順路就略過。｜Drop by later. After level 29, if you want to run The Crossroads and Orgrimmar, answer 1145 first, then Orgrimmar and then 1146. Go to Thousand Needles The Shimmering Flats and turn in 1146 to pick up 1147; if there is no traffic in this section, skip it.
02-12到30級.md:969｜站內提醒｜未到30級優先補薩特（約67, 57）或薊皮熊怪（約32, 38）。有隊伍可在佐拉姆海岸下黑暗深淵；若隊友未到齊，先繼續本段。｜Before reaching level 30, give priority to satyrs (approximately 67, 57) or thistleskin furbolgs (approximately 32, 38). A team can enter the Dark Abyss at The Zoram Strand; if all teammates are not present, continue this section first.
02-12到30級.md:972｜練怪說明｜魔草薩特營地外側密度中等，普通怪；同類巡邏與其他薩特會靠近，沿營地邊緣清，能順便收薩特之角。｜The density outside the Magic Grass Satyr camp is medium, with normal mobs; similar patrols and other Satyrs will be close to each other. Clear along the edge of the camp and collect Satyr Horns.
02-12到30級.md:973｜練怪說明｜碎木崗哨北側林地密度中等，普通怪；用開闊地逐隻打，離飛行點近，適合不想進薩特營地時補經驗。｜Splintertree Post The density of the forest on the north side is medium, and there are normal mobs; use the open area to kill them one by one, close to the flight path, which is suitable for gaining experience when you don't want to enter the Sutter camp.
02-12到30級.md:974｜練怪說明｜薩維亞營地密度中等，普通怪；留意隱匿與巡邏怪，先清外圍再走內側。適合 29 級最後一段，亦可順手補薩特之角。｜Xavian The camp has a medium density and contains normal mobs; pay attention to hidden and patrolling monsters, clear the outside first and then go inside. Suitable for the last section of level 29, also easily make up for Satyr Horns.
02-12到30級.md:980｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
02-12到30級.md:984｜危險說明｜阿斯特蘭納是聯盟城鎮，路邊有 40 級哨兵。去佐拉姆加時從鎮外繞過。｜Astranaar is an alliance town with level 40 sentries on the roadside. When going to Zoramga, go around outside the town.
02-12到30級.md:985｜危險說明｜薊皮洞內的熊怪會堵窄道。先清到出口再開箱或接盧爾護送。｜The furbolg in Thistlehide Cave will block the narrow passage. Clear to the exit first and then unpack or pick up Lur escort.

03-30到45級.md:3｜粗體註記｜34 級從荊棘谷 格羅姆高與藏寶海灣開始。｜At level 34, start with Grom'gol and Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
03-30到45級.md:25｜交通步驟｜梣谷 碎木崗哨已搭飛艇者從布瑞爾南塔進幽暗城；由卡林多中途加入時才飛奧格瑪、補技能再搭飛艇。尚未開幽暗城飛行點，找邁克爾·加勒特（1458 63.25, 48.56）。｜If you took the zeppelin from Splintertree's leg, enter Undercity from Brill's south tower. If starting in Kalimdor, fly to Orgrimmar, train and take the zeppelin. Learn Michael Garrett's flight path (1458 63.25, 48.56) if needed.

03-30到45級.md:35｜粗體註記｜丘陵洞穴 → 達拉然營地｜Foothill Caverns → Dalaran camp

03-30到45級.md:65｜交通步驟｜出塔倫米爾往東，過索拉丁之牆進阿拉希高地。｜Head east from Tarren Mill through Thoradin's Wall into Arathi Highlands.
03-30到45級.md:67｜站內取捨｜未到 31 級可在丘陵洞穴打雪怪補差額。｜If you have not reached level 31, make up the difference by killing snow monsters at The Foothill Caverns.
03-30到45級.md:68｜站內取捨｜達拉然巡邏隊與地縛護腕要交前一輪才開，集中跑西側。城市鑰匙可順手接，達拉然城副本可跳過。｜Dalaran Patrols and Bracers of Binding have to be opened one round before, so focus on the west side. Key to the City can be picked up easily, and the copy of Dalaran City optional.
03-30到45級.md:69｜站內取捨｜秘密潛入 533 要先完成拯救行動 498，留奧特蘭克山脈再接。未做過苦楚藥劑前段就跳過沿海分支。｜Infiltration 533 needs to complete The Rescue 498 first, leaving Alterac Mountains before picking up. Skip the coastal branch if you haven't done the first part of Elixir of Agony.
03-30到45級.md:70｜站內提醒｜赫爾庫拉的墓地靠近聯盟南海鎮，從城外接近。｜Helcular's Grave is close to the alliance Southshore, approaching from outside the city.
03-30到45級.md:71｜站內提醒｜30–32 級帶可與阿拉希高地 落錘鎮合併累積。缺經驗先打希爾斯布萊德西側山腳的普通雪怪（約 45, 29），也可到落錘鎮再補。｜Bands 30–32 can be combined and accumulated with Arathi Highlands Hammerfall. If you lack experience, first fight the common snow monster (about 45, 29) at the west foot of Hillsbrad, or go to Hammerfall to make up for it.
03-30到45級.md:73｜練怪說明｜西側雪人洞外坡地，密度高、普通怪。先在洞外逐隻打，避開洞口重疊怪點，30 級即可開始。｜The slope outside the Yeti Cave on the west side has a high density and normal mobs. First fight them one by one outside the cave, avoiding overlapping strange spots at the cave entrance. start at level 30.
03-30到45級.md:74｜練怪說明｜雪人洞口附近，密度高、普通怪。與洞穴雪人混在一起，先清外圈再補 31–32 級經驗。｜Near the entrance of the Yeti Cave, there is a high density of normal mobs. Mix it up with Cave Yeti, clear the outer circle first and then replenish level 31–32 experience.
03-30到45級.md:79｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:81｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:82｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:84｜危險說明｜南海鎮有 55 級聯盟衛兵。交赫爾庫拉的復仇時從鎮外到墓地，避免從鎮中穿行。｜Southshore has level 55 Alliance Guards. When turning in Helcular's Revenge, go from outside the town to the cemetery and avoid walking through the town.
03-30到45級.md:85｜危險說明｜雪人洞入口刷新集中。找赫爾庫拉魔棒可先清外圍，進洞前留一條撤退線。｜The entrance to the Snowman Cave is refreshed. To find Hercula's Rod, clear the outside first and leave a retreat line before entering the cave.
03-30到45級.md:95｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:96｜交通步驟｜抵達落錘鎮後開尤爾達飛行點 73.02, 32.70。｜Learn Urda's flight path on arrival in Hammerfall (73.02, 32.70).

03-30到45級.md:119｜步驟說明｜先在同一位醫生交 97539，才會出現補給任務。｜You must first hand in 97539 to the same doctor before the supply quest will appear.
03-30到45級.md:120｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:121｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite
03-30到45級.md:122｜交通步驟｜飛幽暗城整理技能與背包，到布瑞爾南側飛艇塔搭奧格瑪線。到奧格瑪後，已開亂風崗就直接選該飛點；未開則飛陶拉祖營地，沿南路搭大升降梯下谷底，再往東搭亂風崗升降梯。｜Fly to Undercity to train and clear your bags. Take the zeppelin south of Brill to Orgrimmar. Fly to Freewind Post if unlocked. Otherwise fly to Camp Taurajo, take the Great Lift down and ride the Freewind Post lift up.
03-30到45級.md:124｜站內取捨｜先清落錘鎮近郊迅猛龍、辛迪加與東南邊枯木。已到 32 級時，進階的 678、701 留阿拉希高地 落錘鎮。｜First clear Hammerfall, the raptors, syndicates and dead trees in the southeast. When reaching level 32, Arathi Highlands Hammerfall is left for advanced 678 and 701.
03-30到45級.md:125｜站內取捨｜病房重新補給與蛛絲縫線是永恆新增。先交 97539 才接 92519。已到 32 級可留第二趟。｜Ward Restocking and Silky Sutures are permanent additions. Hand over 97539 first and then accept 92519. If you have reached level 32, stay for the second trip.
03-30到45級.md:126｜站內提醒｜前往千針石林前若未到 32，從落錘鎮到枯木村外圍（約 68, 69）打普通枯木食人妖，避免深入多怪的營地。｜If you have not reached level 32 before Thousand Needles, fight ordinary deadwood trolls from Hammerfall to the outside of Witherbark Village (about 68, 69) to avoid going deep into the camp with many monsters.
03-30到45級.md:128｜練怪說明｜枯木村外圍，密度高、普通遠程怪。從坡緣拉出單隻，靠近原任務區，適合補到 32 級。｜Witherbark Village Peripheral, high density, common ranged monsters. Pull out a single one from the edge of the slope, close to the original quest area, suitable for upgrading to level 32.
03-30到45級.md:129｜練怪說明｜枯木村東側，密度高、普通施法怪。可打斷治療並沿屋外清，留意附近更高等的枯木獵頭者。｜Witherbark Village On the east side, there are high density and common spell-casting monsters. interrupt the treatment and clear out the house, keeping an eye out for the higher-level Witherbark Headhunter nearby.
03-30到45級.md:135｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:137｜危險說明｜枯木村屋內的巫醫會補血，屋前有較高等的獵頭者。優先沿田地邊緣清，留打斷。｜Witherbark Village The witch doctor in the house will replenish blood, and there is a higher-level headhunter in front of the house. Prioritize clearing along the field edges, leaving no interruptions.
03-30到45級.md:147｜交通步驟｜先開亂風崗奈瑟飛行點 45.14, 49.11，再沿路向東南進閃光平原。｜Learn Nyse's Freewind Post flight path (45.14, 49.11), then follow the road southeast into the Shimmering Flats.

03-30到45級.md:179｜交通步驟｜在閃光平原收完任務，沿谷底原路回亂風崗，搭升降梯上飛點，再飛石爪山脈烈日石居。從烈日石居往西南穿過焦炭谷進淒涼之地。｜After the Shimmering Flats, retrace your route and take the lift up to Freewind Post. Fly to Sun Rock Retreat, then go southwest through the Charred Vale into Desolace.
03-30到45級.md:181｜站內取捨｜閃光平原六個接任務點相近，先接齊再繞一圈。車手送件 1111 只在下一趟經棘齒城時做。交完可向碼頭管理員迪茲維格接給克拉維爾的零件（1112），留給下次經千針石林 閃光平原賽道時交。｜The Shimmering Flats The six quest points are close to each other. Connect them first and then go around in a circle. Driver delivery 1111 is only done next trip via Ratchet. After handing it over, take it to Wharfmaster Dizzywig and give it to Clavel's parts (1112), and leave it for the next time you pass the Thousand Needles The Shimmering Flats track.
03-30到45級.md:182｜站內取捨｜保留流放者馬特克 1106 到荒蕪之地 卡加斯，兄弟 5361 到淒涼之地 葬影村，奈辛瓦里 5762 到荊棘谷 格羅姆高與藏寶海灣。｜Reserved Martek the Exiled 1106 to Badlands Kargath, brothers 5361 to Desolace Shadowprey Village, Nesingwari 5762 to Stranglethorn Vale Gromgau with Booty Bay.
03-30到45級.md:183｜站內提醒｜若 1146 尚未交，略過 1147。影片提醒蟲洞內怪物等級高，打到洞口一帶就回頭。1148 若完成，留塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村途經十字路口時交。｜If 1146 has not been submitted yet, skip 1147. The video reminds you that the monsters in the wormhole are of high level and turn back when you reach the entrance. 1148 If completed, leave Dustwallow Marsh and Brackenwall Village to hand in when passing by The Crossroads.
03-30到45級.md:184｜站內提醒｜32–34 級帶可與淒涼之地 葬影村合併累積。閃光平原未到 33 可在賽道南側（約 76, 85）打烏龜、禿鷲與蠍子，再去淒涼之地。｜Bands 32–34 can be combined and accumulated with Desolace Shadowprey Village. If The Shimmering Flats has not reached 33, fight turtles, Buzzard and scorpions on the south side of the track (about 76, 85), and then go to Desolace.
03-30到45級.md:186｜練怪說明｜閃光平原賽道南側，密度高、普通怪。地勢開闊，可沿鹽地逐隻挑選，適合 32 級補經驗。｜The Shimmering Flats On the south side of the track, there are high density and normal mobs. The terrain is open and pick them one by one along the salt land. It is suitable for level 32 experience replenishment.
03-30到45級.md:187｜練怪說明｜同一片鹽地往東，密度中等、普通怪。與蜥蜴輪打，可順便收鹽殼龜殼。｜The same salt land to the east has medium density and normal mobs. When playing with the lizard, collect the Sparkleshell Tortoise shell.
03-30到45級.md:188｜練怪說明｜賽道東南，密度中等、普通怪。沿地表輪打即可，留意近處其他鹽地野獸；有蠍毒任務可一起收。｜In the southeast of the track, there are medium density and normal mobs. Just take turns along the surface, and pay attention to other salt beasts nearby; collect the scorpion poisonous quests together.
03-30到45級.md:194｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:195｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only

03-30到45級.md:200｜危險說明｜閃光平原蟲洞深處的異種蠍密集且等級較高。完成瘋狂的蟲群後從洞口原路退出。｜The Shimmering Flats The silithid scorpions deep in the wormhole are densely packed and of high level. After completing The Swarm Grows, exit from the cave entrance.

03-30到45級.md:260｜步驟說明｜交完大道劫匪原地接，留到荊棘谷 藏寶海灣的旅店交。｜Pick up here after Highway Robbery. Turn it in at the Booty Bay inn.
03-30到45級.md:262｜粗體註記｜西岸納迦與海島，完成後回葬影村｜West coast naga and islands, then return to Shadowprey Village
03-30到45級.md:263｜步驟說明｜到葬影村找吉納澤林對話拿兩條魚，和西岸行程一起跑。｜Talk to Jinar'Zillen in Shadowprey Village for two fish. Pair with west coast quests.

03-30到45級.md:277｜交通步驟｜爐石回葬影村。｜Hearth to Shadowprey Village.
03-30到45級.md:282｜交通步驟｜從葬影村飛奧格瑪，出城到杜洛塔飛艇塔（1411 50.80, 13.60），搭往荊棘谷 格羅姆高的飛艇。｜Fly from Shadowprey Village to Orgrimmar. At the Durotar zeppelin tower (1411 50.80, 13.60), board for Grom'gol in Stranglethorn Vale.
03-30到45級.md:284｜站內取捨｜大道劫匪與集骨者一起跑，順手點營火再去比布里的小屋。三段皆為任務等級 40、最低 30 級，亡命之徒留到荊棘谷 藏寶海灣交。｜Highway Robbery Run with the Bone Collector, light a campfire and go to Bibri's hut. The three stages are all quest level 40, with a minimum level of 30. On the Lam is reserved for Stranglethorn Vale and Booty Bay.
03-30到45級.md:285｜站內取捨｜吉爾吉斯線 1368／1370 順南路。已選瑪格拉姆或聲望相反時，跳過這兩步與淒涼之地 葬影村的吉爾吉斯後續。｜Kyrgyz Line 1368/1370 Shunnan Road. When Magram is selected or the reputation is reversed, skip these two steps and follow up with the Kyrgyz of Desolace Shadowprey Village.
03-30到45級.md:286｜站內取捨｜葬影村去西岸時一起做兩個水域任務與上古之書。雷斧堡壘先打聖光節杖與埃魯索斯之手，若進度不足再到第二趟補交。｜Shadowprey Village When going to the west coast, do two water quests together with Book of the Ancients. Thunder Axe Fortress first fight Sceptre of Light and Erussus. If the progress is insufficient, go to the second round to make up for it.
03-30到45級.md:287｜站內取捨｜沒遇到車隊就直接走，不原地等護送。保留荊棘谷狩獵 5763 到下一站。｜If you don't encounter a convoy, just leave without waiting for the escort. Keep Hunting in Stranglethorn 5763 for the next stop.
03-30到45級.md:288｜站內提醒｜前往荊棘谷前若未到 34，在科多墓地周圍打普通半人馬（約 56, 60–68），或在西岸打滑刃納迦（35.91, 28.84）。｜If you're not at level 34 before Stranglethorn Vale, fight regular Centaurs around the Kodo Cemetery (~56, 60–68), or fight Slitherblade Naga on the west bank (35.91, 28.84).
03-30到45級.md:290｜練怪說明｜科多墓地東側外圍，密度較低、普通怪。留意其他腐化鳥，離墓地任務近，適合順手補少量經驗。｜The eastern periphery of the Kodo Cemetery has a low density and normal mobs. Pay attention to other corrupted birds, which are close to the cemetery quest and are suitable for replenishing a small amount of experience.
03-30到45級.md:291｜練怪說明｜西岸水邊，密度高、普通怪。沿岸挑落單，留意同區巫女，西岸任務可以一起清。｜By the water on the west coast, there are high density and normal mobs. Pick out singles along the coast and pay attention to the witches in the same area. The west coast quests can be cleared together.
03-30到45級.md:292｜練怪說明｜西岸納迦區南端，密度中等、普通施法怪。把怪拉向岸邊再打，避免水下龍蝦人連帶入戰。｜At the southern end of the West Bank Naga area, there are medium density and ordinary spell-casting monsters. Pull the monster to the shore and fight again to prevent the underwater lobsterman from getting involved in the battle.
03-30到45級.md:298｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:300｜危險說明｜西岸納迦點近水下甲殼蝦人。先把施法怪拉到沙灘，避免水下同時進兩群。｜The naga point on the west coast is close to the underwater crustacean shrimp man. First pull the spell-casting monsters to the beach to avoid entering two groups underwater at the same time.
03-30到45級.md:308｜交通步驟｜在奧格瑪城外飛艇塔搭格羅姆高線，抵達後開塞斯塔飛行點 32.54, 29.35。已在荊棘谷者直接到營地。｜Take the Grom'gol zeppelin from outside Orgrimmar. Learn Thysta's flight path (32.54, 29.35). If you're already in Stranglethorn Vale, head straight to camp.

03-30到45級.md:316｜步驟說明｜石板在水下遺跡外牆，可從外側游過去，避開巡邏的精英魚人。｜Swim to the slab on the outer wall of the sunken ruins. Avoid elite murloc patrols.
03-30到45級.md:318｜標籤｜前置：暗礁海 629｜Prereq: The Vile Reef (629)
03-30到45級.md:318｜步驟說明｜水中的敵人（95773）要先交這個才接得到。｜Enemies in the Water (95773) hand this in before receive it.
03-30到45級.md:319｜交通步驟｜已開藏寶海灣飛點就從格羅姆高飛過去。初訪沿荊棘谷南向大路到藏寶海灣，開格林戈飛行點 26.87, 77.10。接完第一輪任務再飛回格羅姆高。｜Fly from Grom'gol to Booty Bay if unlocked. Otherwise follow the road south and learn Gringer's flight path (26.87, 77.10). Pick up the first batch before flying back.

03-30到45級.md:329｜步驟說明｜買來直接拿去交，別喝掉。｜Just turn it in when you buy it, don't drink it.
03-30到45級.md:330｜步驟說明｜交完可接盜卻無道（79242），去阿拉希高地東南海岸才順路。｜Pick up 79242 after turning in. Save it for the southeast Arathi Highlands coast.

03-30到45級.md:443｜交通步驟｜格羅姆高搭飛艇回奧格瑪，再飛十字路口或陶拉祖營地。｜Take the zeppelin from Grom'gol to Orgrimmar, then fly to the Crossroads or Camp Taurajo.
03-30到45級.md:445｜站內取捨｜藏寶海灣初訪就交亡命之徒並買酒完成「你在想櫻桃酒嗎？」。之後會去阿拉希高地東南離岸島，再接後續盜卻無道。｜Booty Bay After the first visit, hand in On the Lam and buy wine to complete "Cherry for Your Thoughts?". After that, I will go to the southeastern offshore island of Arathi Highlands, and then pick up the follow-up pirate but no way.
03-30到45級.md:446｜站內取捨｜祖昆達找得到吉米克斯才跑鑰匙與護送，鑰匙與遭竊貨物同區。已有人護送可直接繼續主線。[台服任務紀錄](https://wowamobi.com/quests/97329)｜Zukunda found the key and escorted him only after he found Jimmy Max. The key was in the same area as the stolen goods. If someone has escorted you, continue the main line directly. [Taiwan server quest record](https://wowamobi.com/quests/97329)
03-30到45級.md:447｜站內取捨｜藏寶海灣第 1 次到訪主要開飛點並接任務；約 35 級只交第一批：189、201、575、605、213，及已做完的 97328／97331。交 575 和 605 才開 577 和 600。｜Booty Bay visited the main flight path for the first time and accepted the quest; at about level 35, only the first batch was handed in: 189, 201, 575, 605, 213, and the completed 97328/97331. Pay 575 and 605 before opening 577 and 600.
03-30到45級.md:448｜站內取捨｜先別交 600 風險投資公司（Venture Company Mining）、628 刨花皮靴（Excelsior），留荊棘谷 藏寶海灣併南谷回收。577 完成後留荊棘谷 藏寶海灣先交，再接 628。｜Don’t hand over 600 Venture Company Mining and 628 Excelsior first, keep Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay and recycle it in Nangu. After 577 is completed, leave Stranglethorn Vale and Booty Bay first, then receive 628.
03-30到45級.md:449｜站內取捨｜42 級回訪才排血帆 595→597→599→604→608，併 576／587、621、606→607→609。先別排 348／349 熱疫、594→630 瓶中信、8551 船長的箱子、580 酒和 3721 OOX，見荊棘谷 藏寶海灣的 45 級後清單。影片的分次交原則保留，具體 ID 為路線配置。｜The level 42 return visit results in 595→597→599→604→608, and 576/587, 621, 606→607→609. Don’t rank 348/349 Fever, 594→630 Letter in a Bottle, 8551 The Captain's Chest, 580 Wine and 3721 OOX. See the post-level 45 list of Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay. The divided delivery principle of the video is retained, and the specific ID is the route configuration.
03-30到45級.md:450｜站內取捨｜先把獵龍解到 195，再和 568 一起打鞭尾迅猛龍。605 先打北邊的晶脊蜥蜴，第一趟無須繞去南谷。｜First unlock the Dragon Hunter to 195, and then fight Lashtail Raptor with 568. 605. Kill the crystal-spine lizard in the north first. There is no need to go around to the south valley on the first trip.
03-30到45級.md:451｜站內取捨｜若 34 級空白起步，先做三條獵線頭兩輪，並做格羅姆高與血頂食人妖群。深喉獵豹同時解 192／570，普通辛達爾 188 同圈處理。585 的三件戰利品留荊棘谷 藏寶海灣和裂骨項鏈一起做。荊棘谷的青山 338–342 有散頁再交。｜If you start with a blank at level 34, do the first two rounds of three hunting lines, and do Grom'gol and the Bloodcap Troll Swarm. Shadowmaw Panther can solve 192/570 at the same time, and ordinary Sin'Dall can solve 188 in the same circle. The three pieces of loot for 585 are Stranglethorn Vale, Booty Bay and Split Bone Necklace. Stranglethorn Vale's Qingshan 338–342 will be submitted if there are loose pages.
03-30到45級.md:452｜站內提醒｜35 級可組沉沒之城（The Drowned City，35–40）。先確認隊伍與相關任務，從格羅姆高西邊海底入場。｜The Drowned City (The Drowned City, 35–40) can be formed at level 35. First confirm the team and related quests, and enter from the seabed west of Gromgol.
03-30到45級.md:453｜站內提醒｜約 34–35 級先在北谷打血頂食人妖（29.76, 21.62）；36 級後轉格羅姆高東南的巨魔營地（35.55, 30.92），缺多少就在這裡補到 37 再搭飛艇。先交營地裡已完成的任務。｜At about level 34-35, first fight the bloodcap trolls at Northdale (29.76, 21.62); after level 36, go to the troll camp southeast of Grom'gol (35.55, 30.92). If you are missing anything, make up to 37 here and then take the zeppelin. Hand over the completed quests in the camp first.
03-30到45級.md:455｜練怪說明｜北谷血頂遺跡，密度中等、普通怪。沿外牆挑落單，留意附近的血頂薩滿，適合 34 級補經驗。可同趟收旋風武器任務用的血頂獠牙【僅戰士】。｜Northdale Bloodcap ruins, medium density, normal mobs. Pick out singles along the outer wall and pay attention to the nearby Bloodscalp Shaman. It is suitable for level 34 to grind XP. collect the Blood-crested Fang for Whirlwind Weapon quest [Warriors only] in the same trip.
03-30到45級.md:455｜標籤｜僅戰士｜Warrior only
03-30到45級.md:456｜練怪說明｜格羅姆高以北的林地，密度高、普通怪。沿路找單隻，避開下水後的鹽鱗精英，可順做迅猛龍獵殺。｜The woodland north of Grom'gol has a high density and normal mobs. Look for a single one along the road, avoid the salt scale elites after entering the water, and follow the velociraptor hunt.
03-30到45級.md:457｜練怪說明｜格羅姆高東南巨魔營地外圍，密度中等、普通怪。避開巫醫與稀有怪羅洛克，36 級後可就近補到 37。｜On the outskirts of the troll camp southeast of Grom'gol, there are medium density and normal mobs. Avoid the Witch Doctor and the rare monster Rolock. After level 36, make up for it to level 37 nearby.

03-30到45級.md:538｜交通步驟｜回蕨牆村，在飛行地圖選葬影村。若未顯示可達航線，就先飛十字路口轉乘。保留爐石給淒涼之地 葬影村集會所回程。｜Return to Brackenwall Village and fly to Shadowprey Village. If the route is unavailable, change flights at the Crossroads. Save your hearth for the return from Mannoroc Coven.
03-30到45級.md:540｜站內取捨｜黑色盾牌 1251、可疑的蹄印 1268、雷瑟上尉 1269 三件在同一座燒毀旅店。先接齊再進村。｜Black Shield 1251, Suspicious Hoofprints 1268, Captain Reiser 1269 The three burned down the hotel in the same building. Collect them first and then enter the village.
03-30到45級.md:541｜站內取捨｜舒心草帶 3 份再出城。月鋼寬劍已有就交，特地買或鍛造會增加折返。1270 在棘齒城交，當趟不路過就保留或略過。｜Soothing Spices Take 3 copies before leaving the city. Moonsteel Broadsword Just turn it in if you already have it. Buying or forging it specially will increase the rebate. 1270 is submitted at Ratchet. If you don’t pass by it, keep it or skip it.
03-30到45級.md:542｜站內可跳過｜挑戰莫格穆洛克（Challenge Overlord Mok’Morokk）1173。影片建議略過。這條線前幾個任務最低 38 級，37 級到站先走北沼澤群。｜Challenge Overlord Mok’Morokk 1173. the video recommends skipping this. The minimum level for the first few quests on this line is 38. When reaching level 37, go to the North Swamp Group first.
03-30到45級.md:543｜站內之後順路｜若接了 1240，可在荊棘谷 藏寶海灣交給格羅姆高的肯維雷。後續 1261 要回蕨牆村，只有再回塵泥時才續做。黑色盾牌 1276 留雷霆崖順路。｜If you receive 1240, give it to Kin'weelay in Gromgau at Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay. The follow-up 1261 will be back to Brackenwall Village, and it can only be continued when it returns to Chenni. Black Shield 1276 Leave Thunder Bluff on your way.
03-30到45級.md:544｜站內提醒｜蕨牆村和淒涼之地 葬影村共用 37→38 的經驗帶。若淒涼回訪的任務已交過，可在塵泥北邊打普通蛛怪和迅猛龍，靠塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村的北沼澤任務怪點補到 38。｜Brackenwall Village and Desolace Shadowprey Village share the experience zone of 37→38. If the quest of Desolate Return has been handed in, fight ordinary spider monsters and raptors in the north of Dust Mud, and rely on Dustwallow Marsh Brackenwall Village to get 38 monster points from the Northern Swamp quest.
03-30到45級.md:546｜練怪說明｜北沼澤枯藤地，密度高、普通怪。與其他枯藤怪混雜，沿陸地逐隻清，等級貼近離站門檻。｜The withered vine land in the northern swamp has a high density and normal mobs. Mixed with other withered vine monsters, they were cleared one by one along the land, and the level was close to the threshold of leaving the station.
03-30到45級.md:547｜練怪說明｜北沼澤東側，密度中等、普通怪。留意毒傷和迅猛龍巡邏，枯藤區有人清怪時可換點。｜On the east side of the North Swamp, there are medium density and normal mobs. Pay attention to poison wounds and raptor patrols, and change points when someone clears monsters in the withered vine area.
03-30到45級.md:548｜練怪說明｜北沼澤林緣，密度高、普通怪。旁邊有鱷魚與其他迅猛龍，沿岸挑單隻，打到 38 即可離站。｜The forest edge of the northern swamp has high density and normal mobs. There are crocodiles and other velociraptors nearby. Pick one alone along the shore and leave the station after reaching 38.

03-30到45級.md:556｜危險說明｜北沼澤的毒蜘蛛與迅猛龍巡邏路重疊。沿外側挑單隻，避開草叢內的交會點。｜The venomous spiders of the North Swamp overlap with the Velociraptor Patrol Trail. Pick a single one along the outside, avoiding the intersection in the grass.
03-30到45級.md:564｜標籤｜有前置｜Has prerequisite

03-30到45級.md:569｜步驟說明｜在白骨之谷放磁鐵箱，先退開再逐隻擊殺靠過來的幽靈。｜Set the crate down in the Valley of Bones. Step back and pull the ghosts one by one.
03-30到45級.md:569｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%

03-30到45級.md:572｜交通步驟｜仍綁在葬影村時用爐石回村；從其他站加入且綁在別處就沿路步行回飛點。再飛奧格瑪補技能。｜Hearth to Shadowprey if bound there. Otherwise run back to the flight master. Fly to Orgrimmar to train.
03-30到45級.md:574｜站內取捨｜影片有這趟回訪。37 級缺經驗時，補做東南側半人馬和附近的燃燒軍團傳送門；淒涼之地 葬影村交過埃盧梭斯之手才接得到 5581。幽靈電漿可用箱子引出怪物後逐隻處理。｜The video features this return visit. When you are lacking experience at level 37, make up the Centaur on the southeast side and the nearby Burning Legion portal; Desolace Shadowprey Village must be handed over to Hand of Iruxos to receive 5581. Ghost-o-plasm Round Up use boxes to lure monsters out and deal with them one by one.
03-30到45級.md:575｜站內取捨｜盎格庫爾 1373 的目標在悲傷沼澤。先接，留悲傷沼澤 斯通納德順路做。1374 在回村交 1373 後才接得到，留往後補。｜Ongeku The target of Er 1373 is in Swamp of Sorrows. Pick it up first, leaving Swamp of Sorrows and Stonard en route. 1374 I won't get it until I return to the village and pay 1373, so I'll make up for it later.
03-30到45級.md:576｜站內提醒｜還未到 38，就在瑪諾洛克集會所外圈（約 50.40, 70.40）打普通惡魔；若殺得慢，可回科多墓地東南的半人馬區。｜Before reach 38, fight the ordinary demons in the outer circle of Mannoroc Coven (about 50.40, 70.40); if you are slow to kill, return to the Centaur area southeast of the Kodo Cemetery.
03-30到45級.md:578｜練怪說明｜瑪諾洛克集會所北外圈，密度高、普通怪。留意周邊其他惡魔。可順便拿魔化金線血袍任務需要的次級地獄火石【僅術士】。｜Mannoroc Coven North outer circle, high density, normal mobs. Keep an eye out for other demons around you. take the Lesser Infernal stone [Warlock only] needed for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe quest.
03-30到45級.md:578｜標籤｜僅術士｜Warlock only
03-30到45級.md:579｜練怪說明｜集會所同一片外圈，密度中等、普通施法怪。用地形拉出群怪，可與次級地獄火輪打。｜The same outer circle as the assembly hall has a medium density and ordinary spell-casting monsters. Use the terrain to pull out a group of monsters, which can be used in rotation with Lesser Infernal.
03-30到45級.md:580｜練怪說明｜集會所東側，密度中等、普通怪。沿外緣找單隻，避開南面的精英領主；若外圈人多，可換到這裡補經驗。｜On the east side of the assembly hall, there are medium density and normal mobs. Look for a single one along the outer edge, avoiding the elite lords in the south; if there are many people in the outer circle, switch here to gain experience.
03-30到45級.md:586｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:588｜危險說明｜瑪諾洛克集會所南側有精英領主。若只要補經驗或材料，在東側打法師獵手即可。｜Mannoroc Coven There is an elite lord on the south side. If you just want to grind XP or materials, just fight the mage hunter on the east side.
03-30到45級.md:598｜交通步驟｜在奧格瑪城外飛艇塔搭提里斯法林地線。從布瑞爾南塔下船後到幽暗城，飛塔倫米爾並綁爐石。｜Board the Tirisfal zeppelin outside Orgrimmar. From Brill's south tower, head to Undercity, fly to Tarren Mill and set your hearth.
03-30到45級.md:599｜標籤｜有隊伍再做｜Group recommended
03-30到45級.md:599｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
03-30到45級.md:601｜步驟說明｜同任務也可找物件 懸賞啟事（1424 62.57, 20.66）。｜Also find object WANTED (1424 62.57, 20.66) in the same quest.
03-30到45級.md:602｜步驟說明｜兩名囚犯各有一把鑰匙，從敦霍爾德城堡的守衛取得後再開腳鐐。｜Loot both keys from Durnholde guards, then free the two prisoners.

03-30到45級.md:629｜交通步驟｜去完辛迪加營地後向東過索拉丁之牆，重返阿拉希高地。｜After the Syndicate camp, go east through Thoradin's Wall back into Arathi Highlands.
03-30到45級.md:631｜站內取捨｜塔倫米爾先確認 498／549，兩個前置可在敦霍爾德城堡同一趟做。進山後交 533 才接 503，高迪爾和瓦杜斯的辛迪加營地目標一起找。｜Tarren Mill first confirms 498/549, the two pre-processing can be done in the same trip on Durnholde Keep. After entering the mountain, turn in 533 and then take 503. Gol'dir and find it together with the syndicate camp target in Vadus.
03-30到45級.md:632｜站內可跳過｜意志之冠 518–521 要進精英食人魔區，並在末段回幽暗城交件，有隊伍再開整條。｜The Crown of Will 518–521 To enter the elite ogre zone, return to Undercity at the end to submit the documents. If there is a team, open the whole lane.
03-30到45級.md:633｜站內提醒｜與阿拉希高地 落錘鎮合計練到 40；到阿拉希高地 落錘鎮再看等級差額。若缺少量經驗，可先打辛迪加營地的普通成員（58.44, 70.00），再往落錘鎮。｜Use Arathi Highlands Hammerfall to reach a total of 40; go to Arathi Highlands Hammerfall and see the level difference. If you lack a lot of experience, first fight ordinary members of the syndicate camp (58.44, 70.00), and then go to Hammerfall.
03-30到45級.md:635｜練怪說明｜辛迪加營地外圍，密度高、普通怪。留意隱匿及巫師，沿營地邊緣找單隻，只補少量就往落錘鎮。｜Outside the syndicate camp, there is a high density of normal mobs. Pay attention to the stealth and wizard, and look for a single one along the edge of the camp. Only replenish a small amount and go to Hammerfall.
03-30到45級.md:636｜練怪說明｜破碎嶺外側山路，密度高、普通怪。城內另有精英，留在外圍可少繞路，適合單人補怪。｜The mountain road outside Broken Ridge has a high density and normal mobs. There are also elites in the city, so staying on the outside can save you some detours, making it suitable for one person to replenish monsters.
03-30到45級.md:641｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:643｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:644｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:646｜危險說明｜破碎嶺廢墟城內有精英巨魔。清普通蠻卒時留在外側山路，等隊伍到了再進。｜Broken Ridge Ruins There are elite trolls in the city. When clearing the barbarians, stay on the outer mountain road and wait for the team to arrive before entering.

03-30到45級.md:700｜步驟說明｜部落在落錘鎮交 688 後向薩魯克接，留到荒蕪之地。｜Turn in 688 at Hammerfall, then pick up from Zaruk. Save for Badlands.
03-30到45級.md:702｜粗體註記｜法迪爾海灣｜Faldir's Cove
03-30到45級.md:708｜步驟說明｜先清教授附近的怪，接任務後跟教授進洞再回海灣。｜Clear around the professor. Escort him into the cave, then back to Booty Bay.
03-30到45級.md:715｜步驟說明｜接 666 領取尋寶護目鏡，戴上找水下寶石；同一趟處理 662 與 664。｜Accept 666 for the goggles. Wear them for the underwater gems. Pair with 662 and 664.
03-30到45級.md:724｜交通步驟｜回落錘鎮。已開羅格瑪飛點且斯通納德飛點也已開，可直接飛羅格瑪。首次去羅格瑪而斯通納德飛點已開，先選斯通納德。尚未開斯通納德則飛格羅姆高，沿荊棘谷大道北上暮色森林，繞開夜色鎮守衛，從東口經逆風小徑進悲傷沼澤。格羅姆高飛點未開時，可經幽暗城到布瑞爾南方飛艇塔轉格羅姆高線。｜Return to Hammerfall. If Rog'mar and Stonard are unlocked, fly to Rog'mar. On a first visit, fly to Stonard instead. If Stonard is locked, fly to Grom'gol and run north through Duskwood, skirting Darkshire's guards. Go east through Deadwind Pass into Swamp of Sorrows. If Grom'gol is locked, take its zeppelin from the tower south of Brill.
03-30到45級.md:724｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜I haven't used this flight path yet, so I have to use the running one for the first time.
03-30到45級.md:726｜站內取捨｜石拳、迅猛龍與辛迪加進階任務可在回訪時一起清。低階版沒做過就跳過同名後續。禁錮之石 651 順環線摸完，652 弗茲魯克適合有隊伍才追。｜Stone Fist, Velociraptor, and Syndicate advanced quests can be cleared together during a return visit. If you haven’t done it in the low-level version, skip the follow-up with the same name. Stones of Binding 651 is touched along the circle line. 652 Fozruk is suitable for chasing after a team.
03-30到45級.md:727｜站內取捨｜法迪爾海灣一次接打撈、水下寶藏和船長的復仇。先完成 665 解鎖 666，接 666 領尋寶護目鏡，並順手做水下的 662／664。669 留到荊棘谷 藏寶海灣，670 回海灣的交件另候順路。｜Faldir's Cove is salvaged in one go, Sunken Treasure and Drowned Sorrows. Complete 665 first to unlock 666, then go to 666 to get the treasure hunting goggles, and do the underwater 662/664. 669 is left for Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay, and the delivery of 670 back to the bay is waiting for you.
03-30到45級.md:728｜站內取捨｜影片建議激流堡有餘力再做。要省跑圖，先做水晶和落錘近郊，激流堡後段 643–646 可跳。｜The video suggests Stromgarde Keep do it when you have the energy to spare. To save on running the map, first make the crystal and hammer-fall suburbs. Stromgarde Keep can be jumped in the later part 643-646.
03-30到45級.md:729｜站內提醒｜途經斯通納德先開飛點。悲傷沼澤任務留悲傷沼澤 斯通納德。｜Passing Stonard, drive to the flying point first. The Swamp of Sorrows quest is left to Swamp of Sorrows Stonard.
03-30到45級.md:730｜站內提醒｜前往大河林地前若未到 40，先清落錘鎮東側乾鬚峽谷的普通狗頭人（約 84, 31）。怪物開始轉灰時，改打枯木村外圍的普通枯木食人妖（約 68, 69）。｜If you have not reached level 40 before Riverglades, first clear the ordinary kobolds (about 84, 31) in Gansu Canyon on the east side of Hammerfall. When the monster begins to turn gray, fight the ordinary Deadwood Troll outside Witherbark Village (about 68, 69).
03-30到45級.md:732｜練怪說明｜落錘鎮東側枯鬚峽谷深處，密度中等、普通怪。洞道狹窄且可能碰到稀有地卜師弗林塔格，從入口逐段推進。｜Hammerfall The east side of Drywhisker Gorge is deep, with medium density and normal mobs. The cave is narrow and you may encounter the rare geomancer Flintag, so advance step by step from the entrance.
03-30到45級.md:733｜練怪說明｜枯鬚峽谷洞道，密度高、普通怪。與勘探員混合，可和水晶任務同趟，留意洞內回頭時的重生。｜Drywhisker Gorge Cave, high density, normal mobs. Mixed with the prospector, go on the same journey with the crystal quest, and pay attention to the rebirth when you turn back in the cave.
03-30到45級.md:734｜練怪說明｜落錘鎮西北水元素區，密度高、普通怪。比狗頭人稍高等，可打到 40。可同趟收集旋風武器任務的元素符咒【僅戰士】。｜Hammerfall The northwest water element area has high density and normal mobs. Slightly higher than kobolds and can hit level 40. collect the elemental charms of Whirlwind Weapon quest in the same trip [Warriors only].
03-30到45級.md:734｜標籤｜僅戰士｜Warrior only
03-30到45級.md:740｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:742｜危險說明｜激流堡的守衛會在門洞集結。交符印鏈前先分開拉守衛，別從屋內同時開兩群。｜The guards of Stromgarde Keep will gather at the door. Before crossing the talisman chain, pull the guards separately. Don't attack two groups at the same time from inside the house.
03-30到45級.md:743｜危險說明｜法迪爾海灣沉船有水下怪，進船前先戴尋寶潛水鏡並注意氧氣。｜Faldir's Cove There are underwater monsters in the sunken ship. Wear treasure hunting goggles and pay attention to oxygen before entering the ship.
03-30到45級.md:751｜交通步驟｜斯通納德｜Stonard
03-30到45級.md:751｜步驟說明｜由悲傷沼澤地面路線抵達時，向布雷依克開點；已直達羅格瑪的角色略過。｜Unlock Breyk's flight path if arriving overland. Skip if you came straight to Rog'mar.

Otherwise enter Riverglades from Swamp of Sorrows and take the southern road north past Terral's Watch (2548 about 60, 64; video 26:56–27:13). If you flew from Hammerfall, go straight to the flight master.

03-30到45級.md:862｜交通步驟｜已開卡加斯就從羅格瑪直飛。初訪沿影片 27:55–28:03 所示路線，從暮光營地北面的西側山口進荒蕪之地，往西北到卡加斯開飛點。爐石仍綁羅格瑪供後續回訪。｜Fly from Rog'mar to Kargath if unlocked. On a first visit, use the west pass north of the Twilight camp to enter Badlands, then go northwest to Kargath (video 27:55–28:03). Keep your Rog'mar hearth for the return.

03-30到45級.md:864｜站內取捨｜第一次先清農場、豺狼人、河岸及羅格瑪周邊野獸。Chogg’Zac 95427 和後續送頭線留有隊伍再做，博德羅克的野豬和採石可直接接。42 級以上的暮光和海岸留大河林地博德羅克與火線港，照影片分兩次跑。｜For the first time, clear Farm, Jackal, Riverbank and Rog'mar surrounding beasts. Leave the team to do Chogg’Zac 95427 and the subsequent headline. Bolder'ok’s wild boar and quarry can be directly connected. For Twilight and Shore Stays above level 42, Riverglades, Bolder'ok and Powderfuse Port, the photos are taken in two runs.
03-30到45級.md:866｜站內取捨｜在這站先開羅格瑪飛點，往返卡加斯或斯通納德可少跑地面。補給可找 Toka。｜First drive Rog'mar at this station, and travel to and from Kargath or Stonard to avoid traveling on the ground. Supplies can be found at Toka.
03-30到45級.md:867｜站內提醒｜交完當站任務若未到 41，在 Na’zok 農場南側（70.62, 33.08）補普通野豬，或在羅格瑪南側野獸區（約 61, 50）續打。博德羅克的進階暮光任務留大河林地博德羅克與火線港。｜If you have not reached level 41 after completing the station quest, replenish the ordinary wild boars on the south side of Na’zok Farm (70.62, 33.08), or continue to fight in the wild beast area (about 61, 50) on the south side of Rog'mar. The advanced twilight quests of Bolder'ok remain Riverglades Bolder'ok and Powderfuse Port.
03-30到45級.md:869｜練怪說明｜羅格瑪南側草地，資料庫點位密集、普通怪。附近有 41–42 級精英野獸，沿路挑單隻；可同步補 96107 的羽毛。｜Rog'mar The south side of the grassland has dense database points and normal mobs. There are level 41-42 elite beasts nearby, pick one en route; replenish 96107 feathers at the same time.
03-30到45級.md:869｜標籤｜台服客戶端｜zhTW client
03-30到45級.md:870｜練怪說明｜羅格瑪以南的遠境堡斥候區，密度高、普通怪。留意牧師與其他斥候一起入戰，沿河外圍清並順做 94483。｜The Farholde Scout area south of Rog'mar has a high density and normal mobs. Watch for the priest to join the battle with other scouts, and clear out the area along the river and do 94483.
03-30到45級.md:870｜標籤｜台服客戶端｜zhTW client
03-30到45級.md:871｜練怪說明｜南岸偏西，密度中等、普通施法怪。先打斷治療，別同時拉斥候；已走 94483 西段時可順手補。｜To the west of the south bank, there are medium density and ordinary spell-casting monsters. Interrupt the treatment first, don't pull the scout at the same time; make up for it when you have already left the western section of 94483.

03-30到45級.md:937｜交通步驟｜已學騎術就由卡加斯直飛格羅姆高；從格羅姆高再往藏寶海灣。尚未學時依種族前往騎術訓練師，若人在奧格瑪或幽暗城附近，才搭飛艇去格羅姆高。｜If you know Riding, fly from Kargath to Grom'gol, then on to Booty Bay. Otherwise visit your racial riding trainer. If you're near Orgrimmar or Undercity, take the Grom'gol zeppelin.
03-30到45級.md:939｜站內取捨｜石元素與荒蕪試劑 2258 共享一部分怪點，先接齊再打。山狗下顎骨要 30，接著一路清，夠等就走。｜Rock Elemental shares some strange points with Desolation Reagent 2258, so connect them first and then fight. The mandible of the mountain dog costs 30, then clear it all the way, and then leave after enough.
03-30到45級.md:940｜站內取捨｜冰霜之油、發條式同步協調陀螺儀和藥水都已備好才做 713–715。破碎的聯盟 793 留更高等或有隊伍。｜Frost Oil, Gyrochronatom and potions are ready before doing 713–715. Broken Alliances 793 Stay higher or have a team.
03-30到45級.md:941｜站內之後順路｜1420 向赫格拉姆報到（Report to Helgrum）留斯通納德，2202／2418 等副本任務只在有奧達曼團時做。｜1420 Report to Helgrum leaves Stonard, 2202/2418 and other copy quests only when there is a Uldaman group.
03-30到45級.md:942｜站內提醒｜影片把 40 級學騎術放在這次主城轉場。已滿 40 且有金幣，可以在路過本族訓練師時先學。參見文末「職業任務」及「40 級各族騎術」。｜The film puts the level 40 learning of riding skills in this main city transition. If you have reached 40 and have gold coins, learn it first when passing by the trainer of your clan. See "Professional Quests" and "Level 40 Riding Skills of All Races" at the end of the article.
03-30到45級.md:943｜站內提醒｜離開卡加斯前若未到 42，在荒蕪之地西南打普通巨型石元素（約 6.65, 73.85）。石元素點擁擠時，沿卡加斯東南山脊打山狗和禿鷲。｜If you have not reached level 42 before leaving Kargath, play ordinary Greater Rock Elemental southwest of Badlands (about 6.65, 73.85). When Rock Elemental is crowded, hunt mountain dogs along the southeast ridge of Kargath and Buzzard.
03-30到45級.md:945｜練怪說明｜卡加斯南方山壁，密度高、普通怪。附近有火煙食人魔，沿岩壁清外側；42 級前覺得吃力就改打山脊。｜Kargath The southern mountain wall has high density and normal mobs. There are Fire Ogres nearby, so clear the outside along the rock wall; before level 42, if you find it difficult, go to the ridge instead.
03-30到45級.md:946｜練怪說明｜卡加斯東南山脊，密度中等、普通怪。避開精英與稀有巡邏，適合 41 級單練或石元素區擁擠時換點。｜Kargath Southeast ridge, medium density, normal mobs. Avoid elite and rare patrols, suitable for level 41 solo training or changing points when the Rock Elemental area is crowded.
03-30到45級.md:947｜練怪說明｜卡加斯東南坡地，密度中等、普通怪。可與山脊巡行者輪打；有禿鷲翅膀或胃囊任務時一併收。｜Kargath Southeast slope, medium density, normal mobs. Can be played in rotation with the Ridge Walker; collect it together when you have Buzzard wings or stomach pouch quests.
03-30到45級.md:953｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only

03-30到45級.md:965｜交通步驟｜到格羅姆高後先搭飛行點往藏寶海灣，開下一批任務；若上一站出發點離格羅姆高近，可先取營地的任務。｜On arrival at Grom'gol, fly to Booty Bay for the next quest batch. Pick up camp quests first if you started nearby.

03-30到45級.md:1053｜交通步驟｜交完血帆與討債後，從所在的藏寶海灣或格羅姆高選斯通納德。還沒開斯通納德飛點就先飛格羅姆高，循暮色森林東口、逆風小徑的地面路線。｜After the Bloodsail and debt quests, fly to Stonard from Booty Bay or Grom'gol. If locked, fly to Grom'gol and take the road through eastern Duskwood and Deadwind Pass.
03-30到45級.md:1055｜站內取捨｜藏寶海灣第 2 趟先交 669／600／628 等已完成任務。血帆 595→597→599 先跑近岸短段，開 604 同做 576／587；交 604 才接 608 打三船首領。討債 609 需先交 606→607。影片要求逐環回港，這幾個解鎖點照走。｜On your second Booty Bay visit, turn in 669, 600, and 628. Do Bloodsail 595 → 597 → 599 near shore, then pair 604 with 576 and 587. Turn in 604 before accepting 608 for the three captains. Finish 606 → 607 to unlock 609.
03-30到45級.md:1056｜站內先別交｜若已完成 348 荊棘谷熱疫（Stranglethorn Fever）或 8551 船長的箱子（The Captain’s Chest），保留到 45 級後的港口整理；尚未做則後續有隊伍或剛好經過目標再接。348 是 45 級任務，8551 是 47 級任務。｜If 348 Stranglethorn Fever or 8551 The Captain's Chest (The Captain’s Chest) has been completed, keep it until the port arrangement after level 45; if it has not been completed yet, there will be a subsequent team or just pass the target before picking it up. 348 is a level 45 quest and 8551 is a level 47 quest.
03-30到45級.md:1057｜站內先別排｜594→630 瓶中信（Message in a Bottle）是 45 級才可接的海島支線。580 威士忌斯利姆的酒（Whiskey Slim’s Lost Grog，任務等級 50）留辛特蘭蒐集。3721 你自己的 OOX（An OOX of Your Own，任務等級 50）留三張地圖的護送都解完再回港。｜594→630 Message in a Bottle is an island branch that can only be accessed at level 45. 580 Whiskey Slim’s Lost Grog (quest level 50) left The Hinterlands to collect. 3721 An OOX of Your Own (quest level 50) Leave all the escorts on the three maps before returning to the port.
03-30到45級.md:1058｜站內取捨｜可在血帆船上先接 624 科泰羅的謎題（Cortello’s Riddle），到悲傷沼澤 斯通納德時順路解第一段。628 和 600 沒做完就順路補，避免為單件又飛一次。先處理岸上的 609 再上船。｜First pick up 624 Cortello's Riddle (Cortello’s Riddle) on the blood sailboat, and then pick up the first section at Swamp of Sorrows Stonard. If 628 and 600 are not finished, make up for them en route to avoid having to fly again for a single piece. Deal with the 609 on shore first before boarding the ship.
03-30到45級.md:1059｜站內提醒｜荊棘谷 藏寶海灣至大河林地博德羅克與火線港合計練到 45。若此站想先補少量經驗，收完血帆三船後打岸邊的普通血帆海盜（約 32, 79）。｜Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay to Riverglades Bolder'ok and Powderfuse Port can be trained to a total of 45. If you want to gain a little experience at this station first, after collecting the three ships with blood sails, hit the ordinary The Bloodsail Buccaneers on the shore (about 32, 79).
03-30到45級.md:1061｜練怪說明｜藏寶海灣外海灘，密度高、普通怪。先清岸上，留意其他玩家也在解血帆任務；船線做完可就近補經驗。｜Booty Bay Outer beach, high density, normal mobs. Clear the shore first, and pay attention to other players who are also solving the blood sail quest; after completing the ship line, gain experience nearby.
03-30到45級.md:1062｜練怪說明｜血帆南側岸邊，密度高、普通施法怪。先清同群近戰，再拉術士；岸上循環可省上船時間。｜On the south bank of the Blood Sail, there are high density of ordinary spell-casting monsters. Clear the melee group first, then recruit the warlock; cycling on shore can save time on boarding the ship.
03-30到45級.md:1068｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:1074｜危險說明｜莫什奧格丘陵的巨魔種類多且有精英。打格羅姆高進攻計畫時從山腳拉，避免一次進營地。｜There are many types of trolls in Mosh'og Hills and some are elite. When playing The Offense of Grom'gol, pull from the bottom of the mountain to avoid entering the camp at once.
03-30到45級.md:1075｜危險說明｜血帆船上樓梯窄、出口少。登船前清岸邊，逐層打完再下船。｜The stairs on the Blood Sailboat are narrow and there are few exits. Before boarding the ship, clear the shore and clear it layer by layer before disembarking.
03-30到45級.md:1085｜交通步驟｜在斯通納德確認布雷依克飛行點 46.07, 54.83。｜Check that Breyk's Stonard flight path is unlocked (46.07, 54.83).

03-30到45級.md:1110｜步驟說明｜先清籠邊與出口的怪，開籠後跟加林走，交件在路線末段的保險箱。｜Clear the cage and exit. Escort Galen and turn in at the safe at the end.

03-30到45級.md:1118｜交通步驟｜從斯通納德直飛大河林地羅格瑪。若從本段中途加入且未開羅格瑪飛點，循大河林地通往羅格瑪的地面路線，抵達後先開飛點。｜Fly from Stonard to Rog'mar in Riverglades. Joining midway without the flight path? Run there by road and unlock it on arrival.
03-30到45級.md:1120｜站內取捨｜加林的逃亡 1393 是影片提到的護送，沿路清怪再開籠。交件在保險箱，毋須回籠邊。｜Galen's Escape 1393 is the escort mentioned in the video. clear the monsters en route and then unlock the cage. The items are delivered in the safe and do not need to be returned to the safe.
03-30到45級.md:1121｜站內之後順路｜1116 夢境之塵（Dream Dust in the Swamp）在這裡打，回藏寶海灣交；1373 盎格庫爾（Ongeku）在這裡打，回淒涼之地交；625 留下一次塵泥沼澤。｜1116 Dream Dust in the Swamp is played here and returned to Booty Bay; 1373 Ongeku is played here and returned to Desolace; 625 leaves one Dustwallow Marsh.
03-30到45級.md:1122｜站內取捨｜缺乏補給 698→699、海中的威脅 1422→1426→1427→1428、1430 新鮮的螃蟹腿（Fresh Meat）留 47 級後的東南海岸回訪，影片在約 30:50 才走這一帶。｜Lack of Surplus 698→699, Threat From the Sea 1422→1426→1427→1428, 1430 Fresh Meat Return visit to the East Coast after level 47. South Seas The film only goes to this area at about 30:50.
03-30到45級.md:1123｜站內提醒｜西側送完科泰羅卷軸再去避難營地，和水晶任務一起回收兩條迷失者支線。若要補少量經驗，可打淚水之池外圈的普通沼澤怪（約 60, 55），或下一站到東風海岸再補。｜After delivering the Kotello Scroll on the west side, go to The Harborage, and collect the two lost branch lines together with the crystal quest. If you want to replenish a small amount of experience, fight the ordinary swamp monsters in the outer circle of Pool of Tears (about 60, 55), or go to the east wind coast at the next stop to replenish it.
03-30到45級.md:1125｜練怪說明｜淚水之池北側外圈，密度中等、普通怪。從陸側拉，避免引到同區綠色龍人；靠近原路線，適合短暫補怪。｜Pool of Tears In the northern outer circle, the density is medium and normal mobs. Pull it from the land side to avoid being led to Green Wyrmkin in the same area; it is close to the original route, suitable for short-term monster replenishment.
03-30到45級.md:1126｜練怪說明｜斯通納德東南魚人區，密度中等、普通怪。先挑營地外落單的魚人，避免追進同群怪，適合 42–43 級。｜Stonard The southeastern murloc area has medium density and normal mobs. Pick the lone murloc outside the camp first to avoid chasing monsters from the same group. It is suitable for levels 42–43.
03-30到45級.md:1127｜練怪說明｜同一片魚人區南緣，密度中等、普通怪。留意同區更高等的神諭者，44 級前可與噴墨魚人輪打。｜On the southern edge of the same fish-man area, there are medium density and normal mobs. Pay attention to the higher-level Oracles in the same area. Before level 44, take turns with the Inkjet Murlocs.
03-30到45級.md:1133｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
03-30到45級.md:1135｜危險說明｜找加林之前先清籠旁和營地出口。打開籠後再拉怪容易同時顧不到護送與自己的血量。｜Before looking for Galin, clear the cage and the camp exit. It is easy to not take care of the escort and your own health when you pull the monster after opening the cage.
03-30到45級.md:1143｜粗體註記｜博德羅克與北邊暮光營地｜Bolder'ok and the northern Twilight camp
03-30到45級.md:1145｜交通步驟｜已交暮光不再並帶著巨人之地，才往北線找鈍拳。做完北線先回羅格瑪交鈍拳的命令，再往西去暮光之罩。跳過這條鏈時從羅格瑪直接往東到火線港。｜Take the north loop to Clugfist only after turning in Twilight No More! and taking Land of Giants. Return to Rog'mar with Clugfist's Decree before heading west to Twilight's Shroud. If skipping the chain, go east from Rog'mar to Powderfuse Port.
03-30到45級.md:1145｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
