03-30到45級.md:1237｜站內取捨｜北線與暮光之罩整條選做。已做暮光不再的角色可先回博德羅克，交鈍拳的命令後在羅格瑪接迷途的戰士。火線港第一次清海盜順手拿走私貨物，第二次收火藥桶與殺投彈手並送走私快遞，交完再出海炸船。海怪線要繞洞穴，經驗不足且 NPC 有提供任務時再做。｜The entire northern line and Twilight's Shroud are optional. Characters who have completed Twilight No More can return to Bolder'ok first, hand in Clugfist's Decree, and then pick up The Wayward Warrior at Rog'mar. Powderfuse Port For the first time, the pirates took away the smuggled goods. For the second time, they collected the gunpowder barrels and killed the bombardiers and sent the smuggling express. After delivering the goods, they went out to sea to blow up the ship. The sea monster line needs to go around the cave, only if you are inexperienced and the NPC provides a quest.
03-30到45級.md:1239｜站內可跳過｜Bloodmaster’s Ring 競技場、94768、95882 和克羅多克要塞留有隊伍再做。｜Bloodmaster’s Ring Arena, 94768, 95882 and Krol'dok Stronghold are reserved for teams.
03-30到45級.md:1240｜站內提醒｜不足 45 就在東風海岸（約 84, 35–43）沿岸打東海海盜與火槍手，港口附近可以補給。40–45 級有隊伍可下克羅多克要塞（Krol’dok Stronghold），先接羅格瑪的 94968／94972。｜If you have less than 45, fight Eastsea Buccaneer and the Musketeers along the east wind coast (approximately 84, 35–43), and supplies can be found near the port. If there is a team at level 40-45, play Krol'dok Stronghold (Krol’dok Stronghold), and first receive Rog'mar’s 94968/94972.
03-30到45級.md:1241｜站內交通｜到 45 級後在火線港碼頭（2548 80.60, 54.60）搭中立船到塔納利斯 熱砂港（1446 68.60, 23.00），再往加基森。若要留在東部王國，可沿路回羅格瑪飛行點。從塔納利斯抵港的部落角色同樣要由陸路去羅格瑪開飛點。｜After reaching level 45, take the neutral ship at Powderfuse Port Pier (2548 80.60, 54.60) to Tanaris Steamwheedle Port (1446 68.60, 23.00), and then go to Gadgetzan. If you want to stay at Eastern Kingdoms, return to Rog'mar flight path en route. Tribe characters arriving from Tanaris must also go to the flight path Rog'mar by land.
03-30到45級.md:1243｜練怪說明｜火線港北側東風海岸，資料庫點位密集、普通怪。與火槍手混合，沿沙灘逐隻拉；可同步完成 95119。｜Powderfuse Port On the north side of the Dongfeng Coast, there are dense database points and normal mobs. Mix with the Musketeers and pull each one along the beach; can be completed 95119.
03-30到45級.md:1244｜練怪說明｜東風海岸中段，資料庫點位密集、普通遠程怪。與海盜交錯，近戰可利用地形拉到岸側；適合補到 45 級。｜In the middle section of the Dongfeng Coast, there are dense database points and common ranged monsters. Intersect with pirates and use the terrain to pull to the shore in melee combat; suitable for reaching level 45.

03-30到45級.md:1251｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
03-30到45級.md:1253｜危險說明｜偵察大師伐加斯是精英。組到隊伍再靠近，先把周圍巡邏分開。｜Scoutmaster Vargas is elite. After forming a team and then getting closer, separate the surrounding patrols first.
03-30到45級.md:1254｜危險說明｜東風水濱的火槍手容易在遠處加入戰鬥。清海盜時沿沙灘拉開，炸船前清上船路。｜Eastwind Shore's Musketeers tend to join the fight from a distance. When clearing out pirates, they pull out along the beach and clear the way to the ship before blowing up the ship.

04-45到60級.md:16｜交通步驟｜在大河林地 火線港 2548 80.60, 54.60 搭熱砂港線，在塔納利斯 1446 68.60, 23.00 下船。從奧格瑪出發且已開加基森飛行點可搭鳥；初訪可由亂風崗經閃光平原南坡步行到加基森。｜Take the Steamwheedle Port boat at Powderfuse Port (2548 80.60, 54.60) to Tanaris (1446 68.60, 23.00). From Orgrimmar, fly to Gadgetzan if unlocked. Otherwise take the south ramp out of the Shimmering Flats from Freewind Post.

04-45到60級.md:26｜步驟說明｜砂槌營地順路做，屆時回熱砂港交。｜Do at Dunemaul Compound. Turn in at Steamwheedle Port.

04-45到60級.md:27｜交通步驟｜熱砂港沿大道往西到加基森。找部落飛行管理員布科雷克·怒拳（1446 51.60, 25.44）開飛行點，向旅店老闆菲茲格瑞博（1446 52.51, 27.91）暫綁爐石。到費拉斯莫沙徹營地再改綁。｜Follow the road west to Gadgetzan. Learn the Horde flight path from Bulkrek Ragefist (1446 51.60, 25.44) and set your hearth with Innkeeper Fizzgrimble (1446 52.51, 27.91). Rebind in Camp Mojache later.

04-45到60級.md:55｜步驟說明｜先留，悲傷沼澤 斯通納德與東風海岸在藏寶海灣交。｜Stay first, Swamp of Sorrows Stonard and Dongfeng Coast at Booty Bay.
04-45到60級.md:56｜交通步驟｜回加基森交廢土第二批與通緝；爐石已綁加基森就直接回。｜Return to Gadgetzan for the second Wastewander batch and the wanted quests. Hearth if bound there.
04-45到60級.md:60｜站內取捨｜第一次熱砂港把海盜帽、擊殺、通緝與貨箱一起清。TUGs 先排菲拉斯再回頭清港口海盜；本路線從火線港乘船到熱砂港，可先清海岸並保留同樣的影片站序。｜For the first time, Steamwheedle Port cleared the pirate hat, kills, WANTED and the cargo box together. TUGs: Feralas first and then return to clear the port pirates; this route takes a boat from Powderfuse Port to Steamwheedle Port, clear the coast first and keep the same video station sequence.
04-45到60級.md:61｜站內取捨｜3520 留菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地做；97530 留砂槌營地；2874 留到前往悲傷沼澤時在荊棘谷 藏寶海灣交。｜3520 will be left at Feralas Camp Mojache; 97530 will be left at Dunemaul Compound; 2874 will be left at Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay when going to Swamp of Sorrows.
04-45到60級.md:62｜站內提醒｜未到下一站所需等級，廢土營地 59.40,24.71、落帆海灣入口 70.90,42.48 的一般怪可循環打。已組祖爾法拉克可帶 2865、2768、3042，塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地交。｜If you have not reached the level required for the next stop, fight the normal mobs at 59.40, 24.71 in the wasteland camp and 70.90, 42.48 at the Lost Rigger Cove entrance. The grouped Zul'Farrak can carry 2865, 2768, 3042, Tanaris Gadgetzan and Dunemaul Compound.
04-45到60級.md:65｜練怪說明｜落帆海灣入口，普通怪密集，海賊任務容易撞隊。沿外側往海灘清，可同步收海盜任務掉落。｜At the entrance of Lost Rigger Cove, normal mobs are densely packed, and it is easy to collide with the pirate quest. Clear along the outside towards the beach to collect pirate quest drops.
04-45到60級.md:66｜練怪說明｜碼頭外沿的普通怪，海賊入口被搶怪時換點。從外緣拉，避免同時引到碼頭守怪。｜The normal mobs on the outer edge of the pier will be replaced when the pirate entrance is robbed by monsters. Pull from the outer edge to avoid attracting monsters at the dock at the same time.
04-45到60級.md:72｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:75｜危險說明｜卡利夫會巡邏，身邊可能帶護衛。先清沿途廢土強盜，等他走到開闊處再打。｜Kalif will patrol, possibly with an escort. Clear Wastewander Bandit en route first, then wait until he reaches an open area and then attack.
04-45到60級.md:83｜交通步驟｜已有莫沙徹飛點可從加基森直接飛。初訪照影片從加基森北行上閃光平原，經千針石林沿西路入菲拉斯。｜Fly from Gadgetzan to Camp Mojache if unlocked. On a first visit, head north into the Shimmering Flats and take the west road through Thousand Needles into Feralas.
04-45到60級.md:83｜步驟提醒｜還沒開這個飛行點，第一次要用跑的｜I haven't used this flight path yet, so I have to use the running one for the first time.

04-45到60級.md:84｜步驟說明｜向夏恩開飛行點。｜Open flight path to Shyn.
04-45到60級.md:85｜交通步驟｜向旅店老闆格盧爾（1444 74.80, 45.18）綁爐石。｜Set your hearth with Innkeeper Greul (1444 74.80, 45.18).

04-45到60級.md:97｜步驟說明｜在戈杜尼營地的藍色土丘旁使用任務鏟子。｜Use the quest shovel next to the blue mound at Gordunni Camp.
04-45到60級.md:98｜步驟說明｜點北側地面的戈杜尼卷軸。｜Click Gordunni Scroll on the ground on the north side.
04-45到60級.md:107｜步驟說明｜計時一小時。先去南邊木爪嶺，打完五隻立即回交。｜One-hour timer. Kill five in Woodpaw Hills to the south, then return immediately.

04-45到60級.md:122｜步驟說明｜深痕谷洞內外的雪人掉厚重的雪人皮。｜Feral Scar Vale Snowmen inside and outside the cave drop thick snowman skins.
04-45到60級.md:122｜標籤｜掉率 60%｜Drop rate: 60%
04-45到60級.md:123｜交通步驟｜打完深痕谷，爐石回莫沙徹營地集中交。｜After Feral Scar Vale, hearth to Camp Mojache and turn in together.
04-45到60級.md:128｜步驟說明｜到營地西北的恐怖圖騰聚落，打角後回營。｜Get the horns at the Grimtotem camp northwest of Camp Mojache, then return.
04-45到60級.md:128｜標籤｜掉率 80%｜Drop rate: 80%

04-45到60級.md:134｜交通步驟｜從莫沙徹飛奧格瑪（通常經陶拉祖等已開飛點）。爐石維持莫沙徹，清完悲傷沼澤東岸後可用來直接回費拉斯。｜Fly from Camp Mojache to Orgrimmar, usually via Camp Taurajo or other unlocked stops. Keep your Camp Mojache hearth for after the eastern Swamp of Sorrows loop.
04-45到60級.md:139｜步驟說明｜留菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡回莫沙徹交。｜Leave Feralas Camp Mojache and Rage Scar Hold to return to Mosaic.
04-45到60級.md:141｜站內取捨｜木爪豺狼前置一路做到 2903，開菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡東南祖卡什兩個可一起做的任務。｜Reach 2903 all the way to the front of the Wooden Claw Jackal, and open two quests, Feralas Camp Mojache and Rage Scar Hold Southeast Zu'kash, that can be done together.
04-45到60級.md:142｜站內取捨｜有撿到 OOX-22/FE 定位器可留在背包；護送與海岸巨人／水元素留待回訪菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地。｜If you pick up the OOX-22/FE locator, keep it in your backpack; escort it with Shore Strider/water element for return visit Feralas Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:143｜站內提醒｜未到 47 級可補深痕谷雪人 55.29,53.76，或營地北側戈杜尼巨魔 75.13,34.86；打完拉回營地交件。｜If you have not reached level 47, replenish Feral Scar Vale Snowman 55.29, 53.76, or Gordunni Ogre 75.13, 34.86 on the north side of the camp; after defeating it, return to the camp and submit the documents.
04-45到60級.md:146｜練怪說明｜深痕谷外坡，普通雪人較集中，可連打並收雪人皮。洞口有同任務玩家，沿坡輪替。｜Feral Scar Vale On the outer slope, ordinary snowmen are concentrated. beat them continuously and collect their skins. There are players with the same quest at the entrance of the cave, taking turns along the slope.
04-45到60級.md:147｜練怪說明｜深痕谷西南，普通雪人等級稍高。從外側拉近戰怪，避開密集洞口。｜Feral Scar Vale In the southwest, the average snowman has a slightly higher level. Draw the monster closer from the outside and avoid the dense holes.
04-45到60級.md:153｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only

04-45到60級.md:156｜危險說明｜莫沙徹北邊的戈杜尼營地混有法師和蠻兵。挖鈷礦前先清撤退路，不要一路往營地深處跑。｜The Gordunni camp north of Mosache is a mix of mages and barbarians. Before digging for cobalt, clear the retreat path and do not run all the way deep into the camp.
04-45到60級.md:164｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛棘齒城，搭船到藏寶海灣。爐石留莫沙徹。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Ratchet and take the boat to Booty Bay. Keep your Camp Mojache hearth.
04-45到60級.md:166｜粗體註記｜藏寶海灣順手交件｜Booty Bay turn-ins along the way
04-45到60級.md:170｜步驟說明｜悲傷沼澤 斯通納德若已收齊夢境之塵才交。｜Swamp of Sorrows Stonard Only hand in Dream Dust in the Swamp if you have collected all.
04-45到60級.md:170｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:171｜步驟說明｜留辛特蘭 惡齒村與辛薩羅在辛特蘭海岸拾酒，荊棘谷 藏寶海灣經藏寶海灣再交。｜Pick up the grog on the Hinterlands coast. Turn in when you revisit Booty Bay.
04-45到60級.md:173｜粗體註記｜斯通納德到東南海岸｜Stonard to the southeast coast
04-45到60級.md:175｜交通步驟｜由藏寶海灣飛悲傷沼澤斯通納德。若未開該點，沿荊棘谷北路經暮色森林東緣和逆風小徑到斯通納德，找布雷依克（1435 46.07, 54.83）開飛行點。｜Fly from Booty Bay to Stonard. If locked, run north through Stranglethorn Vale, then along eastern Duskwood and through Deadwind Pass. Learn the flight path from Breyk (1435 46.07, 54.83).
04-45到60級.md:178｜步驟說明｜先在淚水之池西南沼澤打鹽齒鱷魚，不夠可沿岸找。｜Kill Saltjaw Crocolisks southwest of the Pool of Tears. Check the shore for more.

04-45到60級.md:194｜步驟說明｜交完 1427 要走回卡塔爾接下一段。順著海岸往北補魚人智者，交前確認三種各十隻。｜After 1427, see Katar. Find Oracles farther north. Check all three kill counts.

04-45到60級.md:196｜交通步驟｜沿同路西返斯通納德，向達爾交螃蟹腿。｜Retrace your route west to Stonard and turn the crab legs in to Dar.
04-45到60級.md:198｜交通步驟｜交完後用爐石回莫沙徹營地。爐石未綁莫沙徹時飛藏寶海灣，搭棘齒城船再飛莫沙徹。｜Hearth to Camp Mojache after the turn-in. Otherwise fly to Booty Bay, take the Ratchet boat and fly to Camp Mojache.
04-45到60級.md:200｜站內取捨｜悲傷沼澤 斯通納德已做北側的迷失者與護送。這趟只補海岸；先交 698／699 才開魚人鏈，螃蟹在去程收、回程交。｜Swamp of Sorrows Stonard has done the Lost and Escort on the north side. This trip only covers the coast; pay 698/699 before opening the fish chain, collect crabs on the outbound trip and pay on the return trip.
04-45到60級.md:201｜站內提醒｜隊伍要進沉沒的神廟，可以先處理悲傷沼澤 斯通納德接的 1429；交點實際在辛特蘭，該線留辛特蘭 惡齒村與辛薩羅以後。若未滿 47 級，東風海岸一般巨型海蟹可在 91.00,70.80 附近補；接近 49 時補等優先打下一站較高等的怒痕雪人。｜For Sunken Temple, pick up 1429 in Stonard and turn it in during the Revantusk/Jintha'Alor leg. Below 47, grind non-elite crabs on the east coast near 91.00, 70.80. Near 49, save grinding for the Rage Scar yetis on the next leg.
04-45到60級.md:204｜練怪說明｜悲傷沼澤東岸的普通螃蟹，分布很密、可剝皮。只適合剛進站或差一小截，與海岸任務玩家共用。｜Swamp of Sorrows Common crabs on the east coast are densely distributed and can be peeled. It is only suitable for those who have just entered the station or are just a short distance away, and can be shared with coastal quest players.
04-45到60級.md:205｜練怪說明｜若接近 49，等下一站飛菲拉斯再打。怒痕堡普通雪人等級較合適，外坡能分開拉，洞口容易碰到任務隊。｜If it is close to 49, wait until the next stop is Feralas before calling again. Rage Scar Hold The level of the ordinary snowman is more suitable. The outer slope can be pulled separately, and the quest team can easily be encountered at the entrance of the cave.

04-45到60級.md:253｜站內提醒｜影片回費拉斯時接近 49 級；需要補等時，可在怒痕堡 55.73,33.05 至 54.39,33.10 外圈循環打怒痕雪人，優先單拉。｜When the video returns to Ferras, it is close to level 49; if make up for it, beat the Wrath-Scarred Snowman in the outer circle at Rage Scar Hold 55.73,33.05 to 54.39,33.10, and give priority to pulling it alone.

04-45到60級.md:257｜練怪說明｜同一營地的高等普通雪人，可混打補到 49。窄洞容易同時拉到兩隻，先清門邊。｜Advanced ordinary snowmen in the same camp can be increased to 49. It is easy to pull two people in a narrow hole at the same time, so clear the door first.

04-45到60級.md:339｜站內取捨｜有隊伍可下祖爾法拉克，四項副本任務可同場做。無隊伍直接略過四項及 4787。｜If you have a team, download Zul'Farrak, and four dungeon quests can be done at the same time. No team directly skips four items and 4787.
04-45到60級.md:340｜站內取捨｜先交 32 與 7732；4494 需 50 級，若已到門檻可在暗巷區確認，完整後續留塔納利斯 加基森與破碎石柱。｜Submit 32 and 7732 first; 4494 requires level 50. If you have reached the threshold, confirm it in the dark alley area. After completing it, keep Tanaris, Gadgetzan and Broken Pillar.
04-45到60級.md:341｜站內提醒｜未滿50，砂槌營地 40.75,50.67 的普通巨魔集中且掉布；想在灼熱峽谷升級就先保留這一小段經驗缺口。｜Under 50, the ordinary trolls in Dunemaul Compound 40.75, 50.67 are concentrated and drop cloth; if you want to upgrade in Searing Gorge, keep this small experience gap first.
04-45到60級.md:344｜練怪說明｜砂槌營地外側，普通近戰怪多，掉布並與食人魔任務重疊。有人搶怪可沿外圍移動。｜On the outside of Dunemaul Compound, there are many ordinary melee monsters, which drop cloth and overlap with ogre quests. Someone who grabs monsters can move along the periphery.
04-45到60級.md:345｜練怪說明｜西側異種蠍巢外的普通怪密集且等級較高。只沿巢口單拉，窄道容易引到一群。｜The normal mobs outside the scorpion nest on the west side are densely packed and of high level. Just pull along the nest mouth, and the narrow path will easily attract a group.

04-45到60級.md:353｜危險說明｜森提帕爾蟲巢入口容易連拉。只在巢口外沿空地打，不要為了一隻追進窄道。｜The entrance to the Sentipal Hive is easy to pull. Only hunt in the open space outside the nest mouth, do not chase one into the narrow channel.
04-45到60級.md:361｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛棘齒城，跨海前到棘齒城碼頭接安戈洛導引；再坐船到藏寶海灣並飛荒蕪之地卡加斯。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Ratchet. Pick up the Un'Goro lead-in at the docks before taking the boat to Booty Bay. Fly to Kargath.
04-45到60級.md:362｜步驟說明｜最低 49 級；安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地安戈洛火羽山打，貧瘠之地 棘齒城回棘齒城交。｜Requires 49. Do at Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro. Turn in at Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:363｜交通步驟｜由卡加斯向西南沿道路進灼熱峽谷，走北側大道到瑟銀哨塔。｜Take the southwest road out of Kargath into Searing Gorge, then follow the northern road to Thorium Point.

04-45到60級.md:424｜站內交通｜先在瑟銀哨塔開部落飛點，完成後可飛幽暗城或落錘鎮，再接辛特蘭。｜Unlock the Horde flight path at Thorium Point. Fly to Undercity or Hammerfall before the Hinterlands.
04-45到60級.md:425｜站內取捨｜四組殺怪可沿同一圈完成，7728 掉落不足先交別組；7701 與 7722 在同一洞內，能組隊再順路清。｜Four groups of monsters can be killed along the same circle. If 7728 does not drop enough, separate groups first. 7701 and 7722 are in the same hole. If they can form a group, they can clear them en route.
04-45到60級.md:426｜站內取捨｜瑟銀哨塔交完已達 50 可以離站。火炬後半與東南木製廁所各需額外折返，缺經驗再做。｜Thorium Point After payment, the number has reached 50 and leave the station. The second half of the Torch and the southeast Wooden Outhouse each require additional turns, so do it if you lack experience.
04-45到60級.md:427｜站內提醒｜尚差少量經驗，在大熔爐東側外圈 44.76,38.72 打重型作戰傀儡，或回北坡 41.21,23.33 打普通黑鐵工頭。｜There is still a little experience left, so fight the heavy combat puppet at 44.76, 38.72 on the east side of The Cauldron, or return to the north slope and fight the ordinary black iron foreman at 41.21, 23.33.
04-45到60級.md:430｜練怪說明｜大熔爐東緣的普通魔像，沿高處外圈打，可同步解擊殺。任務玩家多時別下熔爐底。｜The Cauldron The ordinary golem on the east edge can be killed by hitting it along the outer circle of the high place. Don't bet on Forge when you have a lot of quests.
04-45到60級.md:431｜練怪說明｜瑟銀哨塔南側的普通黑鐵怪，回飛點前可連打並補任務掉落。營地內可能連拉。｜Thorium Point The ordinary black iron monster on the south side can be defeated and dropped in quests before the return point. There may be tension in the camp.
04-45到60級.md:436｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:438｜危險說明｜工頭瑪托留斯在熔渣之池一帶的黑鐵礦洞深處。用隊伍逐段清通道，獨行可跳過懸賞。｜Foreman Martorius is deep in the black iron mines near The Slag Pit. Use a team to clear passages section by section, and skip bounties if you go alone.
04-45到60級.md:446｜交通步驟｜從灼熱峽谷飛惡齒村。未開點先飛塔倫米爾，從敦霍爾德城堡北側山口進辛特蘭，沿大道往東，下海岸往南到惡齒村。｜Fly from Searing Gorge to Revantusk Village. If locked, fly to Tarren Mill and use the pass north of Durnholde Keep. Follow the Hinterlands road east, then go south along the coast.

04-45到60級.md:506｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜7862 要打 80 隻精英，沒有現成隊伍便略。辛薩羅難以單刷時，先做沿岸與內陸任務。｜Optional|7862 defeat 80 elites, so there is no ready-made team. Jintha'Alor If it is difficult to clear the area alone, do the coastal and inland quests first.
04-45到60級.md:507｜站內取捨｜先別交｜580 到藏寶海灣交；3123 到莫沙徹營地交；2641、4787 留塔納利斯 加基森與破碎石柱。｜Don’t pay it yet | 580 should be handed over to Booty Bay; 3123 should be handed over to Camp Mojache; 2641 and 4787 should be reserved for Tanaris, Gadgetzan and Broken Pillar.
04-45到60級.md:508｜站內提醒｜未到 52 級可在辛特蘭沿岸補海龜、梟獸，或與隊伍清辛薩羅。｜Below level 52, collect turtles and wild beasts along the coast of The Hinterlands, or clear Jintha'Alor with your team.
04-45到60級.md:512｜練怪說明｜惡齒村北側海灘的普通龜，可沿岸直線輪打和剝皮。和採龜肉的玩家共用，無需闖辛薩羅精英區。｜Revantusk Village Common turtles on the northern beach can be beaten and skinned in a straight line along the coast. Shared with players who collect turtle meat, no need to enter the Jintha'Alor elite area.
04-45到60級.md:518｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only

04-45到60級.md:521｜危險說明｜辛薩羅上層有成群邪枝精英與治療怪。組隊沿階梯逐層清，未組隊留在海岸。｜Jintha'Alor There are groups of evil branch elites and healing monsters on the upper level. Those who formed a team walked along the stairs step by step, and those who did not formed a team stayed on the coast.
04-45到60級.md:522｜危險說明｜加莫里塔是沿岸巡邏的精英海龜。補普通海龜時留意牠，沒有隊伍就讓開。｜Gammerita is an elite sea turtle patrolling the coast. Keep an eye on it when you're patching up regular turtles, and get out of the way if there's no team.
04-45到60級.md:530｜交通步驟｜從惡齒村飛悲傷沼澤斯通納德，沿南方道路進詛咒之地。到北部兩名血法師（50.55, 14.20／50.64, 14.30）。｜Fly from Revantusk Village to Stonard, then follow the road south into the Blasted Lands. Visit the two Bloodmages in the north (50.55, 14.20 and 50.64, 14.30).

04-45到60級.md:555｜站內取捨｜值得做｜五個採集一起打。全交共需顎骨 ×5、野豬肺 ×6、蠍螯 ×6、蜥蜴腦 ×11、禿鷲砂囊 ×14。每次交任務會扣材料。｜Do | Five collections to do together. A total of 5 jaw bones, 6 wild boar lungs, 6 scorpion claws, 11 lizard brains, and 14 Buzzard gizzards are required for the full cross. Materials will be deducted every time you turn in a quest.
04-45到60級.md:556｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜先交掉落較快的任務。禿鷲或蜥蜴競爭激烈時，留下未完成的 2601 或 2603，繼續荊棘谷 藏寶海灣。｜Optional|Hand in the faster quests first. When Buzzard or lizard competition is fierce, leave unfinished 2601 or 2603 and continue with Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay.
04-45到60級.md:557｜站內提醒｜想補經驗可留在北部 46–53, 15–27 沿山坡打野獸。南面有較高等敵人。｜If you want to gain experience, stay in the north at 46–53, 15–27 and hunt wild beasts along the hillside. There are higher level enemies to the south.
04-45到60級.md:561｜練怪說明｜血法師營地東側有一整片普通蠍，順收蠍鉗並可剝皮。怪多時由路邊往外打，避開精英巡邏。｜There is a whole patch of common scorpions on the east side of the blood mage camp. easily close the scorpion pincers and skin them. Monsters often attack from the roadside to avoid elite patrols.

04-45到60級.md:569｜危險說明｜血法師營地以南的怪群等級比北坡高。只做北部收集時留在山坡外圈。｜The levels of monsters south of the Blood Mage Camp are higher than those on the northern slope. Only do northern collections when staying on the outer circle of the hillside.
04-45到60級.md:577｜步驟說明｜悲傷沼澤 斯通納德與東風海岸接、辛特蘭 惡齒村與辛薩羅在辛特蘭撿酒。｜Accept on the Stonard/Eastwind Shore stop. Collect grog in the Hinterlands.

04-45到60級.md:589｜站內取捨｜值得做｜本趟優先交 50 級的 580。荊棘谷 格羅姆高與藏寶海灣、荊棘谷 藏寶海灣的低等任務已分次處理；仍在日誌而且已完成的，也可在同一趟港口回交。｜Do | This trip gives priority to paying 580 for level 50. The low-level quests of Stranglethorn Vale Gromgau and Booty Bay, Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay have been processed in batches; those that are still in the log and have been completed can also be returned at the same port.

The Captain's Chest 8551 and Stranglethorn Fever 348 ​​If you want to leave the city and then come back, do it when you lack experience or have a team.

04-45到60級.md:594｜練怪說明｜藏寶海灣這一站以交件和搭船為主。缺 53 級可沿原路到下一站艾薩拉再打普通血精靈，任務點易撞隊，可在營地外圈補。｜Booty Bay This stop is mainly for delivery and boating. If you are missing level 53, follow the same path to the next stop Azshara and then fight ordinary blood elves. The quest point is easy to collide with the team, so make up for it outside the camp.

04-45到60級.md:659｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜3542 交幽暗城的安德隆·甘特（1458 54.81, 76.33），可留東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂轉場。城市寄回任務要重返艾薩拉，本路線可省掉。｜Then drop by | 3542 to transfer Undercity to Andron Gant (1458 54.81, 76.33), and leave Eastern Plaguelands Light's Hope Chapel for transfer. The city return quest requires returning to Azshara, so this route optional.
04-45到60級.md:660｜站內提醒｜未滿 53 級時可補埃達拉斯廢墟納迦或薩拉斯營地血精靈，打怪時順手找任務掉落。｜If you are below level 53, replenish the Ruins of Eldarath Naga or Thalassian Base Camp Blood Elf, and find the drops from quests when fighting monsters.
04-45到60級.md:664｜練怪說明｜薩拉斯營地普通血精靈等級正合適，順收血精靈任務掉落。營地內可能連拉法系，從外緣打。｜Thalassian Base Camp The level of ordinary blood elves is just right, and it will be dropped by collecting blood elves. It is possible to continuously pull the magic system in the camp and fight from the outside edge.
04-45到60級.md:665｜練怪說明｜埃達拉斯廢墟的普通納迦，路過可順收納迦任務。貼廢墟外牆單拉，避開內側密集法系。｜Ruins of Eldarath is an ordinary naga. If you pass by, successfully collect the naga quest. Attach Ruins to the outer wall with a single pull to avoid the dense legal system on the inside.

04-45到60級.md:682｜交通步驟｜使用初訪已開的莫沙徹營地飛行點。若由這一站開始且未開點，可先飛千針石林亂風崗，沿谷底大路向西進菲拉斯，再找夏恩開點。｜Fly to Camp Mojache if unlocked. Joining here with no flight path? Fly to Freewind Post, follow the valley west into Feralas and learn the Camp Mojache flight path from Shyn.

04-45到60級.md:714｜練怪說明｜北泉鷹身人營地外圍的普通怪，若正在做北泉任務可順收掉落。單為經驗不必從營地折返，留到下站。｜Northspring Harpy The normal mobs outside the camp can be easily collected if you are doing the Beiquan quest. Just for the experience, there is no need to turn back from the camp, stay until the next stop.
04-45到60級.md:715｜練怪說明｜若鷹身人點被佔，可改打東南側普通猩猩；空地好退，沿外側避開多隻連拉。｜If the harpy point is occupied, attack the ordinary orangutan on the southeast side instead; the open space is easy to retreat to, so avoid multiple consecutive pulls along the outside.

04-45到60級.md:756｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜3444 要折返棘齒城；此站可只做 3380 和 3161。若為副本鏈而接 3444，可在貧瘠之地 棘齒城取石環後另約一趟回交。｜Optional | 3444 needs to be returned to Ratchet; this site can only do 3380 and 3161. If you connect 3444 for a copy link, make another appointment to return it after picking up the stone ring at The Barrens Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:757｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜4504 和有前置的 4496 都在安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地做。4324 燃燒平原 烈焰峰與黑石山交。｜Later, 4504 and 4496 with front-end are all made in Un'Goro Crater Marshal's Refuge. 4324 Burning Steppes Flame Crest intersects with Blackrock Mountain.

04-45到60級.md:761｜練怪說明｜哈札里巢外的普通蠍，等級較接近本段，密度足。留在地表，洞口附近容易連拉。｜The ordinary scorpions outside Hazali's nest are closer to this level and have sufficient density. If left on the surface, it will be easy to pull around the hole.

04-45到60級.md:830｜站內取捨｜先別交｜3908 留冬泉谷；4502、4147 留棘齒城。4292、三座水晶塔、猩猩、火羽山救援與究根問底留安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地。｜Don’t pay it yet | 3908 will be reserved for Winterspring; 4502 and 4147 will be reserved for Ratchet. 4292, three crystal towers, orangutans, Fire Plume Ridge rescue and Finding the Source stay Un'Goro Crater Marshal's Refuge.
04-45到60級.md:831｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜4300 若已打齊爪子，下次經奧格瑪找傑斯雷蒙（1454 55.52, 34.08）交。4507 需在南邊孵化並打王，可跳過。｜Then drop by | 4300. If you have all the claws, please pay via Orgrimmar next time to Jes'rimon (1454 55.52, 34.08). 4507 needs to be hatched and killed in the south, skip it.
04-45到60級.md:832｜站內提醒｜若差一點到 54 級，可在北部焦油怪（51.77, 25.14）或馬紹爾營地東邊雙帆龍（50.78, 19.90）補經驗。｜If you are close to reaching level 54, gain experience at the tar monster in the north (51.77, 25.14) or Diemetradon east of Marshal's Refuge (50.78, 19.90).
04-45到60級.md:836｜練怪說明｜營地南側的普通焦油怪，可順收黏稠焦油。刷新靠水邊，沿岸單拉並留意魔暴龍巡邏。｜The ordinary tar monster on the south side of the camp can absorb thick tar. Refresh near the water, pull alone along the coast and pay attention to the Devilsaur patrol.
04-45到60級.md:837｜練怪說明｜東北猩猩洞口的普通猩猩。與猩猩任務重疊，洞內易連拉，外圈有人就回焦油池。｜Common orangutans at the entrance of Northeastern Orangutan Cave. Overlapping with the orangutan quest, it is easy to pull in the cave, and if there are people in the outer circle, return to the tar pool.

04-45到60級.md:889｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜3906、4062 要去黑石山或多一趟荒蕪之地，單練缺時間可略。想打黑石深淵可另外接後續。｜Optional|3906, 4062. If you want to go to Blackrock Mountain or make an extra trip to Badlands, skip it if you are short of time for single practice. If you want to call Blackrock Depths, follow up separately.
04-45到60級.md:890｜站內提醒｜差經驗就打索瑞森廢墟周圍的黑鐵矮人和傀儡；黑石深淵可組隊，先在卡加斯與烈焰峰把地城任務接齊。｜If you are short of experience, fight the Dark Iron dwarves and puppets around Ruins of Thaurissan; Blackrock Depths can form a team. First, complete the dungeon quests in Kargath and Flame Crest.
04-45到60級.md:894｜練怪說明｜索瑞森廢墟外側的普通傀儡，沿外牆可連打並補廢墟擊殺。留意混在廢墟間的施法怪。｜Ruins of Thaurissan The ordinary puppets on the outside can be hit continuously along the outer wall and supplemented with Ruins kills. Watch out for spellcasters mixed in with Ruins.
04-45到60級.md:895｜練怪說明｜同一片廢墟的普通矮人，可順路補布料及擊殺。施法怪與巡邏可能一起進戰，從斷牆外拉。｜Ordinary dwarves in the same piece of Ruins can mend cloth and kill them en route. Spellcasters and patrols may enter the battle together, pulling from outside the broken wall.
04-45到60級.md:902｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:904｜危險說明｜通往黑石深淵的礦場走道狹窄，征服者派隆會在路上巡邏。先清入口的普通怪再動手。｜The mine walkway leading to Blackrock Depths is narrow, and Overmaster Pyron will patrol the road. Clear out the normal mobs at the entrance first and then take action.
04-45到60級.md:905｜危險說明｜索瑞森廢墟施法怪和巡邏會一起進戰。從斷牆外拉，別站在兩條巡邏路交叉處。｜Ruins of Thaurissan Spellcasting monsters and patrols will enter the battle together. Pull from outside the broken wall, and don't stand at the intersection of the two patrol roads.

04-45到60級.md:920｜步驟說明｜永恆版書籍。禮拜堂內靠後左側，取書後在幽暗城交。｜The Forever book is at the back left of the chapel. Turn it in in Undercity.

04-45到60級.md:922｜交通步驟｜由禮拜堂飛幽暗城，若手上有圖書館任務可順路交。｜Fly from Light's Hope Chapel to Undercity. Turn in library quests if you have any.
04-45到60級.md:923｜步驟說明｜QuestieDB 與 Wowhead 單一任務頁列奧蘭；Wowhead 永恆版圖書館指南另列歐文·薩得（1458 73.40, 33.00），兩人都在幽暗城法師區。先依遊戲可交提示。｜Oran and Owen Thadd are in Undercity's Magic Quarter. Check which offers the turn-in.
04-45到60級.md:924｜交通步驟｜留在東部王國。下一站從幽暗城往東到亡靈壁壘。｜Stay in the Eastern Kingdoms. The next leg goes east from Undercity to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:926｜站內取捨｜值得做｜首次到東瘟疫先開聖光之願飛行點，禮拜堂書在同一處。提里奧、納薩諾斯和達隆郡主要任務留到後段。｜Do | If you go to Eastern Plague for the first time, open the Light's Hope Chapel flight path first, and the chapel book is in the same place. The main quests of Tirion, Nathanos, and Darrowshire are left to the later stages.
04-45到60級.md:927｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜6164 要繞到恐懼谷，純轉場可略過。若影片拾的是禮拜堂裡的書，對應永恆版 84398。｜Optional|6164 To wrap around to Terrordale, pure transition optional. If the book in the chapel is picked up in the video, it corresponds to the eternal version 84398.
04-45到60級.md:928｜站內提醒｜未滿 54 級可在聖光之願外沿道路打普通瘟疫怪，或到下一站清費爾斯通農場（約 38, 56）的普通亡靈。｜If you are under level 54, fight ordinary plague monsters along the road outside Light's Hope, or go to the next stop to clear out the ordinary undead of Felstone Field (approximately 38, 56).
04-45到60級.md:932｜練怪說明｜聖光之願西南的普通腐肉蟲，沿路能單拉，也可順收弗丁任務需要的腐肉蟲肉。避開北邊高等亡靈群。｜The ordinary Carrion Grub in the southwest of Holy Light's Hope can be pulled alone en route, and it can also collect the Carrion Grub meat required for Fording's quest. Avoid the group of higher undead to the north.
04-45到60級.md:933｜練怪說明｜禮拜堂西側空地的普通蝙蝠，補經驗後可快速回補給。與瘟疫蝙蝠任務重疊，遇到玩家時往南轉。｜The ordinary bats in the open space on the west side of the chapel can quickly replenish supplies after replenishing experience. Overlaps with Plaguebat quest, turn south when encountering a player.
04-45到60級.md:939｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:941｜危險說明｜走恐懼谷找收據冊時，屋內和樓梯上的亡靈可能同時拉到。先清樓下再上樓。｜When walking Terrordale to find the receipt book, the undead in the house and on the stairs may be pulled at the same time. Clear the downstairs first and then go upstairs.
04-45到60級.md:949｜交通步驟｜從幽暗城出城，沿提里斯法林地東路到亡靈壁壘（1420 83.13, 68.94）。保留幽暗城的飛行點，方便本段末尾交城內支線。｜Leave Undercity and follow Tirisfal's east road to the Bulwark (1420 83.13, 68.94). Keep Undercity's flight path available for city turn-ins at the end.
04-45到60級.md:950｜步驟說明｜接完就在德靈頓旁的箱子領瓶中火，與任務提供的天譴軍旗都要帶上。｜Take Bottled Flame from the chest by Derington. Bring the Scourge Banner too.
04-45到60級.md:951｜步驟說明｜先用瓶中火燒帳篷，再使用軍旗。｜Use bottle fire to burn the tent first, then use the military flag.
04-45到60級.md:952｜步驟說明｜先用瓶中火燒帳篷，再使用軍旗。｜Use bottle fire to burn the tent first, then use the military flag.
04-45到60級.md:958｜交通步驟｜從壁壘向東進費爾斯通農場，先收天譴大鍋樣本，再繞詹妮絲的房子與馬廄。｜Go east from the Bulwark to Felstone Field. Take the Scourge Cauldron sample, then check Janice's house and the stables.
04-45到60級.md:959｜步驟說明｜先確認身上有范蒂絲給的空瓶。｜First make sure you have the empty bottle given by Fandis.

04-45到60級.md:961｜步驟說明｜拿到樣本後，在同一口大鍋接回程。｜After getting the sample, pick it up in the same cauldron for the return journey.
04-45到60級.md:963｜步驟說明｜包裹位於馬廄內，靠近後與物件互動。｜Interact with the package inside the stable.
04-45到60級.md:965｜步驟說明｜選部落版 5023，返回幽暗城交；本地只取包裹。｜Choose Horde quest 5023. Collect the package here and turn it in at Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:966｜交通步驟｜由費爾斯通農場往東到達爾松之淚。這裡先解房屋日記與鑰匙，天譴大鍋留下一趟。｜Go east from Felstone Field to Dalson's Tears. Do the farmhouse diary and key now. Save the Scourge Cauldron for next time.
04-45到60級.md:970｜步驟說明｜日記讀完再找遊蕩的骷髏。開廁所後農夫會出現。｜Read the journal, then find a Wandering Skeleton. Open the outhouse to spawn the farmer.
04-45到60級.md:971｜步驟說明｜日記讀完再找遊蕩的骷髏。開廁所後農夫會出現。｜Read the journal, then find a Wandering Skeleton. Open the outhouse to spawn the farmer.

04-45到60級.md:976｜交通步驟｜沿安多哈爾外緣逐塔走，再回壁壘。塔門有高等守衛時先等巡邏離開。｜Circle Andorhal, visiting each tower, then return to the Bulwark. Wait for high-level guards to patrol away before approaching the doors.
04-45到60級.md:977｜步驟說明｜在門口即可使用火炬，毋須進塔打守衛。｜Use the torch at the door, no need to enter the tower to fight the guards.
04-45到60級.md:981｜交通步驟｜回幽暗城，先在公會登記處附近交城內包裹。｜Return to Undercity and turn in the package near the guild registrar.
04-45到60級.md:987｜步驟說明｜先保留半個護符，西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘到費爾斯通農場交。｜Keep the half amulet. Turn in at Felstone Field on the Bulwark visit.
04-45到60級.md:988｜交通步驟｜幽暗城外的飛艇塔搭往奧格瑪的飛艇。｜Take the Orgrimmar zeppelin from the tower outside Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:990｜站內交通｜要去亡靈壁壘須步行。西側往提里斯法林地或幽暗城，走城外飛艇回奧格瑪。｜Walk to get to The Bulwark. Go to Tirisfal Glades or Undercity on the west side, and take the zeppelin outside the city back to Orgrimmar.
04-45到60級.md:991｜站內取捨｜值得做｜費爾斯通農場的瘟疫鍋和包裹在同一處，回城可把 5023、5049 一起交。｜Do | Felstone Field’s plague cauldron and package are in the same place. hand in 5023 and 5049 together when you return to the city.
04-45到60級.md:992｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜本趟完成第一口鍋，達爾松之淚的 5231 與安多哈爾的通靈學院任務留下一輪。傑雷米亞的好運護符 5050／5051 後段回西瘟疫才做。｜Then en route | I completed the first pot of this trip, leaving one round of Dalson's Tears’s 5231 and Andorhal’s Scholomance quests. Jeremiah's Good Luck Charm 5050/5051 was only made after returning to the Western Plague in the later period.
04-45到60級.md:993｜站內提醒｜未到55級，可補費爾斯通農場外圍的普通骷髏和食屍鬼（約38, 56）；避開安多哈爾內的高等精英。｜If you have not reached level 55, supplement the ordinary skeletons and ghouls (about 38, 56) outside Felstone Field; avoid the high-level elites in Andorhal.
04-45到60級.md:996｜練怪說明｜費爾斯通農場普通亡靈，瘟疫鍋路線順路，農田外比屋群好拉。任務玩家多時在外圍移動。｜Felstone Field Ordinary undead, the plague pot route is en route, and it is easier to pull outside the farmland than among the houses. quest players often move around the perimeter.
04-45到60級.md:997｜練怪說明｜同農場普通食屍鬼，能補上骷髏刷新空檔。不要追怪進安多哈爾。｜Same as Farm. Ordinary ghoul, can fill in the gap between skeleton refresh. Don't chase monsters into Andorhal.

04-45到60級.md:1005｜標籤｜僅盜賊｜Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1007｜危險說明｜安多哈爾中央有 61 級精英『召喚者』阿拉基。標記哨塔時沿城邊走，不要穿中央廣場。｜There is a level 61 elite "Summoner" Araki in the center of Andorhal. All Along the Watchtowers When walking along the edge of the city, do not go through the central square.
04-45到60級.md:1015｜步驟說明｜艾薩拉 瓦羅莫克接，並在安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地打齊白色暴掠龍爪。｜Accept at Valormok. Farm White Ravasaur Claws in Un'Goro.

04-45到60級.md:1016｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛梣谷碎木崗哨，沿大道西行後從梣谷北路進費伍德森林，先停南端的翡翠聖地。｜Fly to Splintertree Post, follow the road west, then take the north road into Felwood. Stop first at Emerald Sanctuary.
04-45到60級.md:1018｜步驟說明｜血琥珀在費伍德北段；下一站順路打鐵木樹人，晚一點回南端交。｜Collect Blood Amber in north Felwood. Kill treants next. Turn in back south.
04-45到60級.md:1021｜步驟說明｜完成後木喉熊怪聲望上升。若還是敵對，後續到北營地再補。｜Earn Timbermaw rep. If still hostile, grind at the northern camp later.
04-45到60級.md:1023｜步驟說明｜先接，下一站到費伍德最北邊交。｜Pick it up first, then pick it up at the northernmost point of Felwood at the next stop.
04-45到60級.md:1024｜交通步驟｜沿主路往北先經加德納爾，再到血毒崗哨。｜Follow the main road north through Jaedenar to Bloodvenom Post.
04-45到60級.md:1025｜交通步驟｜血毒崗哨｜Bloodvenom Post
04-45到60級.md:1025｜步驟說明｜向布拉卡爾開飛行點。｜Open flight path to Brakkar.
04-45到60級.md:1029｜交通步驟｜沿主路北行一小段到碎痕谷，完成腐蝕調查，再走西側薩特月井和南端獸人營地回翡翠聖地。｜Follow the road north to Shatter Scar Vale for the corruption survey. Loop back to Emerald Sanctuary via the western satyr moonwell and southern orc camp.
04-45到60級.md:1030｜步驟說明｜務必走到任務勘查區，單殺元素不會完成全部目標。｜Walk to the quest exploration area, single kill elements will not complete all objectives.
04-45到60級.md:1031｜步驟說明｜此處和加德納爾中央另一口月井是兩個不同目標。｜Here and the other port Moonwell in the center of Jaedenar are two different targets.
04-45到60級.md:1032｜步驟說明｜目標在南端營地深處；沿坡道清掉周邊怪再拉。｜Target is deep in the south camp. Clear along the ramp before pulling.
04-45到60級.md:1032｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1035｜步驟說明｜下趟用空水壺到加德納爾中央月井裝水。｜Use the empty water bottle to fill with water at Jaedenar center Moonwell next trip.
04-45到60級.md:1036｜交通步驟｜回血毒崗哨，交水樣與洛爾的爪子；視需要在這裡補給。｜Return to Bloodvenom Post to turn in the water sample and Rell's claw. Restock if needed.
04-45到60級.md:1040｜站內交通｜血毒崗哨開飛行點，下站仍由此出發。若途經梣谷碎木崗哨，沿大道繞過聯盟城鎮的守衛。｜Bloodvenom Post opens the flight path, and the next station will still start from this point. If passing through Ashenvale Splintertree Post, follow the avenue to bypass the guards in the alliance town.
04-45到60級.md:1041｜站內取捨｜值得做｜南部死木熊怪直接開木喉聲望；加德納爾、南段洛爾和碧火薩特月井可連著跑。｜Do |The Southern Dead Wood Furbolg directly opens Timbermaw reputation; Jaedenar, Southern Lore and Jade Fire Satyr Moonwell can be run in succession.
04-45到60級.md:1042｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜4102 先接，北邊拿齊血琥珀。採完後晚點再回南部交，省下立刻折返一趟。｜Then drop by | 4102 and pick up Blood Amber from the north. After harvesting, return to the south later to save the trip back immediately.
04-45到60級.md:1043｜站內提醒｜未到55級時，優先在碎痕谷外圈（約41, 42）打普通元素，或補木喉聲望的死木熊怪。｜Before reaching level 55, give priority to the dead wood furbolgs in the outer circle of Shatter Scar Vale (approximately 41, 42) with ordinary elements or to supplement Timbermaw's reputation.
04-45到60級.md:1046｜練怪說明｜碎痕谷外圈的普通元素，和熱能擊殺任務重疊。入口有任務玩家時從外側向內輪打。｜Shatter Scar Vale The ordinary elements in the outer circle overlap with the thermal kill quest. When there is a quest at the entrance, players will take turns from the outside to the inside.
04-45到60級.md:1047｜練怪說明｜同一片普通元素點，有較高等的變種，與熱能野獸混打。地形窄，留意成對刷新。｜The same piece of ordinary element points has a higher variant, mixed with Entropic Beast. The terrain is narrow, so pay attention to refreshing them in pairs.
04-45到60級.md:1052｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1056｜危險說明｜碎痕谷熱能元素會在坑邊成對刷新。從坡口單拉，別往坑底跨到下一群。｜Shatter Scar Vale Thermal energy elements will be refreshed in pairs near the pit. Pull alone from the slope, don't step to the bottom of the pit to the next group.
04-45到60級.md:1065｜步驟說明｜下站冬泉谷打梟獸，後續回血毒崗哨交。｜Kill owlbeasts in Winterspring, then turn in at Bloodvenom Post.
04-45到60級.md:1066｜交通步驟｜先往南去加德納爾中央月井，取水後走回翡翠聖地交件。之後才回碧火薩特月井放出小貓。｜Go south to Jaedenar's central moonwell, collect water and turn it in at Emerald Sanctuary. Release the kitten at the Jadefire moonwell afterward.
04-45到60級.md:1069｜步驟說明｜留到棘齒城南面的水之先知伊斯倫交。｜Stay at Islen Waterseer south of Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1070｜步驟說明｜放貓後別走太快或飛走；到溫娜身邊須先點小貓交還，才能交任務。｜Walk with the kitten. Click it by Winna before turning in.
04-45到60級.md:1072｜交通步驟｜離開血毒崗哨，沿主路北上鐵木森林與死木村，最北端在木喉洞口找納菲恩。｜Follow the main road north from Bloodvenom Post through Irontree Woods and Deadwood Village. Find Nafien at the Timbermaw entrance.
04-45到60級.md:1073｜步驟說明｜收齊先保留，下次回南費伍德再向梅貝絲交。｜Save the items for Maybess when you next visit south Felwood.

04-45到60級.md:1074｜步驟說明｜需已在莫沙徹營地接取；菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地回營地交。｜Requires pickup at Camp Mojache. Turn in there.
04-45到60級.md:1078｜步驟說明｜北營地清完再確認聲望，仍敵對就加刷死木怪直到冷淡。｜Check Timbermaw rep after the north camp. If hostile, grind Deadwood until Unfriendly.
04-45到60級.md:1080｜步驟說明｜從洞內往冬泉谷出口走，出洞找薩爾法。｜Go from the cave to the exit Winterspring and exit the cave to find Salfa.
04-45到60級.md:1081｜交通步驟｜木喉熊怪聲望到「冷淡」後進洞，沿冬泉谷出口走。洞內不打木喉熊怪。｜At Unfriendly with Timbermaw Hold, enter the tunnel and take the Winterspring exit. Avoid attacking the Timbermaw furbolgs.
04-45到60級.md:1083｜站內交通｜血毒崗哨補給後沿大道向北。洞內看分岔，走往冬泉谷的出口。｜Bloodvenom Post After supplies, go north along the avenue. Look at the fork in the cave and go to the exit Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1084｜站內取捨｜值得做｜北部鐵木森林一起解血琥珀與墮落的力量，最後才刷死木熊怪聲望。｜Do |North Irontree Woods Solve Blood Amber and Corrupted Power together, and finally gain the reputation of the Woodbolg.
04-45到60級.md:1085｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜已打完 4102 先留物品，往後回翡翠聖地再交。5158 留棘齒城。｜Stop by later|Completed 4102 Please keep the items first and return them to Emerald Sanctuary later. 5158 Leave Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1086｜站內提醒｜木喉聲望達「冷淡」即可安全走洞。若聲望仍是敵對，或未到56級，可在北死木村（約62, 8）補熊怪。｜If Timbermaw's reputation reaches "Indifference", safely exit the cave. If the reputation is still hostile, or has not reached level 56, replenish furbolgs in the north at Deadwood Village (approximately 62, 8).
04-45到60級.md:1089｜練怪說明｜北死木村普通熊怪，去木喉要塞前順打，可補聲望及羽毛。營帳間容易連拉，先清外圈。｜North Deadwood Village is an ordinary furbolg. Go to Timbermaw Hold and fight it to gain reputation and feathers. It is easy to pull the tents together, so clear the outer ring first.
04-45到60級.md:1090｜練怪說明｜同村靠大道的普通熊怪，遇到聲望團可沿路側挑落單怪。不要打木喉守衛。｜Ordinary furbolgs in the same village are close to the road. When encountering a reputation group, pick off single monsters along the road. Don't fight the Timbermaw guard.
04-45到60級.md:1095｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1097｜危險說明｜木喉要塞仍對你敵對時，洞內的守衛可能成群加入戰鬥。先打外面的死木熊怪升到冷淡再穿洞。｜Timbermaw Hold While still hostile to you, the guards in the cave may join the fight in groups. First hit the dead wood furbolg outside to raise it to indolence and then pierce the hole.

04-45到60級.md:1107｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1108｜交通步驟｜從洞口向南去冰火溫泉，先接多諾瓦的熊怪任務，再去西部冬泉熊怪營地。｜Head south from the tunnel to Frostfire Hot Springs and pick up Donova's furbolg quests before going to the western Winterfall camp.

04-45到60級.md:1128｜步驟說明｜留往東瘟疫之地聖光之願禮拜堂交。｜Leave it to Eastern Plaguelands Light's Hope Chapel.

04-45到60級.md:1132｜步驟說明｜下一段需要雪怪角，晚一趟再接 977。｜The next section requires Snow Monster Point, so pick up 977 on a later trip.

04-45到60級.md:1142｜站內交通｜初到永望鎮開鳥點並綁爐石。下一站飛菲拉斯莫沙徹營地。若未開飛行點，可先飛千針石林亂風崗，沿大路西行到菲拉斯開點。｜Unlock Everlook's flight path and set your hearth. Next, fly to Camp Mojache. If its flight path is locked, fly to Freewind Post and follow the road west into Feralas.
04-45到60級.md:1143｜站內取捨｜值得做｜冰火溫泉的多諾瓦任務先交齊，梟獸沿路清；永望鎮雪怪、奇美拉可在同趟做。｜Do | Frostfire Hot Springs Donova quests should be completed first, and the owl beasts should be cleared en route; Everlook Wendigo and Chimera can be done in the same trip.
04-45到60級.md:1144｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜尤西烏斯是精英，8464 須往西折返洞口。有隊伍或還缺進度再做。｜Optional | Ursius is an elite, 8464 must turn back to the west to the cave entrance. Do it if you have a team or lack of progress.
04-45到60級.md:1145｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜永望鎮報告與尼古拉斯公爵的書先放任務欄，東部王國下一輪一起交。｜Then drop by | Everlook Report and Duke Nicholas's book will be placed on the taskbar first, and Eastern Kingdoms will be handed in together in the next round.
04-45到60級.md:1146｜站內提醒｜還不到56級就打永望鎮東邊的普通雪怪（約64, 40）或東側冬泉村外圍熊怪，避開巡邏精英。｜If you are not yet level 56, fight the ordinary snow monsters on the east side of Everlook (about 64, 40) or the furbolgs on the east side of Winter Spring Village to avoid the patrolling elites.
04-45到60級.md:1149｜練怪說明｜永望鎮東側的普通雪人，靠補給點且可順收毛皮。洞口常有同任務玩家，先沿山腳打。｜Everlook The ordinary snowman on the east side relies on supply points and can collect fur smoothly. There are often players with the same quest at the entrance of the cave, so fight along the foot of the mountain first.
04-45到60級.md:1150｜練怪說明｜冬泉村外圈的普通熊怪，補木喉聲望與相關掉落。村內施法怪容易連拉，避開精英巡邏。｜Ordinary furbolgs in the outer circle of Winterspring Village can restore Timbermaw's reputation and related drops. Spellcasting monsters in the village are easy to pull in succession, avoiding elite patrols.
04-45到60級.md:1156｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1158｜危險說明｜永望鎮北邊有精英碎齒熊尤西烏斯巡邏。單打普通熊時繞開，已組隊再做牠的任務。｜Everlook There is elite Ursius of the Shardtooth patrolling to the north. Avoid it when fighting an ordinary bear alone, and then complete its quest if you have formed a team.
04-45到60級.md:1159｜危險說明｜冬泉村內的薩滿祭司和巡邏熊怪容易成群。缺經驗就沿村外找落單守衛。｜The shamans and patrolling furbolgs in Winterfall tend to form groups. If you lack experience, look for lone guards outside the village.
04-45到60級.md:1167｜交通步驟｜從永望鎮飛莫沙徹營地；這一趟先回營地交菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡的費伍德支線，已接視靈藥劑再去北邊。｜Fly from Everlook to Camp Mojache. Turn in the Camp Mojache and Rage Scar Hold leads from Felwood. Head north for Videre Elixir if you picked up the quest.
04-45到60級.md:1168｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已完成｜If Felwood Bloodvenom Post  and Timbermaw Hold have been completed
04-45到60級.md:1169｜交通步驟｜若身上有 3909，沿菲拉斯大道向西至岔路，再朝雙塔山與北邊的烏鴉風廢墟。｜If you have 3909, follow the road west to the fork, then go toward the Twin Colossals and Ravenwind Ruins.
04-45到60級.md:1170｜標籤｜若冬泉谷 永望鎮已接｜If Winterspring Everlook is connected
04-45到60級.md:1170｜步驟說明｜格雷甘交換藥劑是 4041 的對話流程；本趟只取藥，別喝，留給冬泉谷多諾瓦交。｜Get Gregan's elixir for 4041. Don't drink it. Take it to Donova in Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1171｜交通步驟｜打算補海岸支線才去被遺忘的海岸。若手上有菲拉斯定位器，可先去深痕谷洞穴接護送，再順路走到海岸。｜Only visit the Forgotten Coast for the optional quests. If you have the Feralas beacon, pick up the Feral Scar Vale cave escort on the way.

04-45到60級.md:1183｜交通步驟｜回莫沙徹營地飛棘齒城。已完成 2767 且想交件時，可由棘齒城搭船往返藏寶海灣；其餘直接在棘齒城辦交接。｜Return to Camp Mojache and fly to Ratchet. If 2767 is ready, take the boat to Booty Bay for the turn-in and come back. Otherwise turn in at Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1185｜站內交通｜主要轉場為永望鎮飛莫沙徹、莫沙徹飛棘齒城。若已安排藏寶海灣交件，可用棘齒城對開的船補交。｜The main transitions are Everlook flying to Mosache, and Mosache flying to Ratchet. If Booty Bay has been arranged for delivery, it can be made up by ship Ratchet.
04-45到60級.md:1186｜站內取捨｜值得做｜菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地與怒痕堡接、費伍德做的 4120 是回村就能交的任務。｜Do | Feralas Camp Mojache and Rage Scar Hold, Felwood’s 4120 is a quest that can be handed in when you return to the village.
04-45到60級.md:1187｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜海岸支線在西側，定位器沒掉就不找；只有想補經驗或要去雙塔山時才把海岸並入。｜Optional|The coast side quest is on the west side. If the locator is not missing, don’t look for it; only add the coast if you want to gain experience or go to The Twin Colossals.
04-45到60級.md:1188｜站內提醒｜此站沒有必須單獨練等的門檻。若差56，先到下一站交件，再把經驗差留給後段同等怪區。｜There is no requirement to practice alone on this site. If the difference is 56, go to the next station to submit the documents first, and then leave the experience difference to the same monster area in the later stage.
04-45到60級.md:1191｜練怪說明｜若已在北泉交件，可清營地外圍的普通鷹身人，順收北泉任務掉落。怪等偏低，若還差一大截就去冬泉谷。｜If you have already submitted the documents at Beiquan, clear the ordinary harpies outside the camp and collect the quest drops from Beiquan. The strange level is on the low side. If it is still a long way off, go to Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1192｜練怪說明｜若差 56 級，上一站離開永望鎮前優先在這片補。普通雪人集中，外坡比洞口好拉。｜If there is a level difference of 56, give priority to making up for it here before leaving Everlook at the previous station. Ordinary snowmen are concentrated, and the outer slope is easier to pull than the entrance of the cave.
04-45到60級.md:1198｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only

04-45到60級.md:1201｜危險說明｜被遺忘的海岸巨人要先用壓縮器縮小再打。等海元素走開後逐隻處理。｜The Forgotten Coast The giant needs to be reduced with a compressor before playing. Wait for Sea Elemental to go away and deal with them one by one.

04-45到60級.md:1210｜交通步驟｜到棘齒城後先交工程任務，再沿岸往南找水之先知伊斯倫。｜Turn in the engineering quest in Ratchet, then follow the coast south to Islen Waterseer.
04-45到60級.md:1211｜標籤｜若安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地已採滿灰燼｜If Un'Goro Crater Marshal's Refuge is full of ashes

04-45到60級.md:1215｜標籤｜若費伍德森林 血毒崗哨與木喉要塞已接｜If Felwood Bloodvenom Post  and Timbermaw Hold are connected
04-45到60級.md:1216｜標籤｜需先完成5158｜Requires quest 5158
04-45到60級.md:1216｜步驟說明｜保留淨化水。後段回費伍德翡翠聖地再交格雷塔。｜Keep the purified water for Greta at Emerald Sanctuary later.
04-45到60級.md:1217｜交通步驟｜回棘齒城飛奧格瑪，搭城外前往提里斯法林地的飛艇。抵達後沿提里斯法林地東路前往亡靈壁壘。｜Fly from Ratchet to Orgrimmar and take the Tirisfal Glades zeppelin. On arrival, follow the east road to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1219｜站內交通｜棘齒城飛奧格瑪後，換城外幽暗城方向飛艇。抵達提里斯法林地，沿東路到亡靈壁壘。｜After Ratchet flies to Orgrimmar, change to the zeppelin in the direction of Undercity outside the city. Arrive at Tirisfal Glades and take the east road to The Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1220｜站內取捨｜值得做｜已完成安戈洛灰燼和車間支線就一起交給莉芙，海岸再接伊斯倫回費伍德的信。｜Do | Completed Un'Goro Ash and the workshop branch will be handed over to Liv, and then Islon will be picked up on the coast to return Felwood's letter.
04-45到60級.md:1221｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜若身上沒有棘齒城可交任務，可由菲拉斯直接飛奧格瑪轉飛艇。｜Optional|If you don’t have Ratchet to hand in the quest, fly directly from Feralas to Orgrimmar and transfer to the zeppelin.
04-45到60級.md:1222｜站內提醒｜棘齒城的怪等級偏低。未到 56 級可在轉飛艇前飛回永望鎮打東側普通雪人（約 64, 40），或到西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘在費爾斯通農場（約 38, 56）打普通亡靈。｜The monster level of Ratchet is low. If you have not reached level 56, fly back to Everlook and fight the ordinary snowmen on the east side (about 64, 40) before transferring to the zeppelin, or go to Western Plaguelands The Bulwark and fight the ordinary undead at Felstone Field (about 38, 56).
04-45到60級.md:1225｜練怪說明｜棘齒城只辦交接。缺 56 級時沿原路搭飛艇，到下一站費爾斯通農場再打。普通骷髏多，從田埂拉，避開血色巡邏。｜Ratchet only handles handover. If you are short of level 56, take the zeppelin along the original path and go to the next stop Felstone Field and try again. There are many ordinary skeletons, so pull them from the field ridge to avoid the Scarlet patrol.
04-45到60級.md:1231｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1232｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:1240｜交通步驟｜從棘齒城飛奧格瑪並轉乘飛艇，抵達提里斯法林地後，沿幽暗城外的大路往東走到亡靈壁壘。｜Fly from Ratchet to Orgrimmar and take the zeppelin to Tirisfal Glades. Follow the main road east from outside Undercity to the Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1249｜步驟說明｜先清鍋邊的普通亡靈，靠近鍋會引出護鍋者。｜Clear normal undead around the cauldron. Approach to spawn the guardian.
04-45到60級.md:1249｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%

04-45到60級.md:1273｜站內交通｜第 1 步由飛艇塔往亡靈壁壘。打完蓋羅恩農場後沿主路向東去東瘟疫。｜Step 1: Go from the zeppelin tower to The Bulwark. After beating Gahrron's Withering, go east along the main road to Eastern Plague.
04-45到60級.md:1274｜站內取捨｜值得做｜瘟疫之鍋按接續順序做，嚎哭鬼屋順路完成兩段野生動物。｜Do | Scourge Cauldron Do it in the following order, The Writhing Haunt complete two sections of wild animals en route.
04-45到60級.md:1275｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5236 留西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘，5901 在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂完成、回西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘交。｜Don't turn it in yet | 5236 will be left in Western Plaguelands The Bulwark, 5901 will be completed in Eastern Plaguelands Light's Hope Chapel and returned to Western Plaguelands The Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1276｜站內提醒｜同為 56–57 級帶，接著去東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂。壁壘旁接了 964 才開始累積骸骨碎片。打算自備通靈學院鑰匙的角色，交完就接 5514，並帶兩塊瑟銀錠帶去塔納利斯 加基森，再進安戈洛環形山。｜Also for the 56–57 level band, go to Eastern Plaguelands Light's Hope Chapel. The barrier was next to 964 before it started accumulating Skeletal Fragments. For characters who plan to bring their own Scholomance key, pick up 5514 after handing it over, and bring two pieces of Thorium Bar to Tanaris Gadgetzan, and then enter Un'Goro Crater.
04-45到60級.md:1279｜練怪說明｜達爾松之淚的普通骷髏，跑瘟疫鍋可順收骸骨碎片。北側會遇到血色巡邏，打外側。｜Grind normal skeletons at Dalson's Tears for Skeletal Fragments on the cauldron loop. Avoid the Scarlet patrol north of the farm.
04-45到60級.md:1280｜練怪說明｜嚎哭鬼屋附近的普通食屍鬼，等級較合適，和下一口鍋同路。屋門口密集，從田邊開始。｜The Writhing Haunt The common ghoul nearby, with a suitable level, goes the same way as the next pot. The doorways of houses are densely packed, starting from the edge of the fields.
04-45到60級.md:1284｜危險說明｜達爾松之淚北側有血色巡邏。收瘟疫鍋材料時從田埂拉骷髏，別往北穿營地。｜Dalson's Tears There is a Scarlet patrol on the north side. When collecting plague pot materials, pull the skeletons from the field ridge. Do not go north through the camp.
04-45到60級.md:1292｜交通步驟｜過西界後沿索多里爾河岸找提里奧，接齊再向南上主路。｜Cross the western border and find Tirion along the Thondroril River. Pick up his quests, then head south to the main road.
04-45到60級.md:1301｜步驟說明｜拾取零件時可能出現鬼魂，先清門口。｜Ghosts may appear when picking up parts, so clear the door first.
04-45到60級.md:1305｜步驟說明｜腐質只有約 10 分鐘有效期，收齊後當場研磨。｜The rot lasts about 10 minutes. Grind it on the spot once you have enough.
04-45到60級.md:1311｜交通步驟｜確認聖光之願禮拜堂的部落飛行點已開；首次到訪找喬吉亞（1423 70.53, 47.55）。接著沿路北上打瘟疫木林一圈。｜Unlock Light's Hope Chapel with Georgia (1423 70.53, 47.55) if needed. Then head north for a loop through Plaguewood.
04-45到60級.md:1312｜步驟說明｜沿瘟疫木林外圍找蟻丘，避開斯坦索姆門口的精英。｜Check termite mounds along Plaguewood's edge. Avoid elites by Stratholme.
04-45到60級.md:1315｜標籤｜掉率 80%｜Drop rate: 80%
04-45到60級.md:1317｜步驟說明｜殺完要點剛出現的靈魂，單純擊殺不會累計。｜Click each spawned soul after the kill. Kills alone don't count.
04-45到60級.md:1324｜步驟說明｜要做完提里奧的三個狩獵任務才會出現。｜It will only appear after completing Tirion's three hunting quests.
04-45到60級.md:1325｜步驟說明｜要做完提里奧的三個狩獵任務才會出現。｜It will only appear after completing Tirion's three hunting quests.
04-45到60級.md:1326｜步驟說明｜要做完提里奧的三個狩獵任務才會出現。｜It will only appear after completing Tirion's three hunting quests.
04-45到60級.md:1327｜交通步驟｜完成後從禮拜堂飛幽暗城，再搭飛艇去奧格瑪。｜After the loop, fly from Light's Hope Chapel to Undercity and take the Orgrimmar zeppelin.
04-45到60級.md:1329｜站內交通｜在交 6030 與接 5211 後開禮拜堂飛行點；末步飛幽暗城後轉飛艇。｜After handover 6030 and pick-up 5211, open the chapel flight path; the last step is to fly Undercity and then transfer to the zeppelin.
04-45到60級.md:1330｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5901 與 5152 回西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘交。｜Don’t hand over yet | 5901 and 5152 return Western Plaguelands The Bulwark.
04-45到60級.md:1331｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜暗翼蝠（Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...，6135）在東瘟疫，是精英巡邏目標；按影片的取捨略過。｜Skipable|Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee..., 6135) is the target of elite patrols in the Eastern Plague; skip it according to the video selection.
04-45到60級.md:1332｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜6024 要在墓穴與祖爾瑪夏間來回，5781 點墓土後會引來一群傭兵，趕路可以略過。｜Skipable | 6024 To go back and forth between the tomb and Zulmasha, after 5781 points of the tomb soil will attract a group of mercenaries, skip it if you are in a hurry.
04-45到60級.md:1333｜站內提醒｜進度落後可在瘟疫木林外圍（約 29, 28）打普通蝙蝠、犬與食屍鬼。要到 57 級可等菲拉斯 亂羽高地前補。｜If you are behind on progress, fight ordinary bats, dogs and ghouls outside the Plague Wood (about 29, 28). To reach level 57, wait for Feralas Frayfeather Highlands.
04-45到60級.md:1336｜練怪說明｜瘟疫木林外圍的普通亡靈。可順路補居民靈魂相關任務，避開較高等的縫合憎惡及巡邏。｜Ordinary undead on the outskirts of the Plague Wood. complete quests related to the souls of residents en route and avoid higher-level suture abominations and patrols.
04-45到60級.md:1337｜練怪說明｜同區道路外的普通瘟疫犬，等級貼近本段、空地較好拉。有人清亡靈時可改沿外圈找狗。｜The ordinary Plaguehound outside the road in the same area has a grade close to this section and is easier to pull in the open space. When someone clears the dead, they can look for dogs along the outer circle instead.
04-45到60級.md:1343｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1345｜危險說明｜瘟疫木林靠近斯坦索姆的一側有高等縫合憎惡和巡邏。採白蟻或找食屍鬼時走外圍。｜The side of Plaguewood near Stratholme has Greater Stitched Abominations and patrols. Go outside when hunting for termites or looking for ghouls.
04-45到60級.md:1354｜交通步驟｜從奧格瑪飛雷霆崖，在城下接信差的引導，再往長者高地找大德魯伊。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Thunder Bluff. Pick up the courier's lead-in at the base, then find the Arch Druid on Elder Rise.
04-45到60級.md:1355｜步驟說明｜此為部落前往永夜港的引導；做過 1004 或 1018 的角色可直接找哈繆爾。｜Horde breadcrumb to Nighthaven. Go straight to Hamuul if you've done 1004 or 1018.
04-45到60級.md:1356｜步驟說明｜此為部落前往永夜港的引導；做過 1004 或 1018 的角色可直接找哈繆爾。｜Horde breadcrumb to Nighthaven. Go straight to Hamuul if you've done 1004 or 1018.
04-45到60級.md:1357｜步驟說明｜此為部落前往永夜港的引導；做過 1004 或 1018 的角色可直接找哈繆爾。｜Horde breadcrumb to Nighthaven. Go straight to Hamuul if you've done 1004 or 1018.
04-45到60級.md:1359｜交通步驟｜從雷霆崖飛血毒崗哨，往北繞死木村到 1448 60.20, 5.84 的死木蒸鍋，接著走木喉要塞往月光林地岔路。｜Fly to Bloodvenom Post. Go north through Deadwood Village to the cauldron (1448 60.20, 5.84), then take the Timbermaw Hold fork to Moonglade.
04-45到60級.md:1367｜交通步驟｜月光林地｜Moonglade
04-45到60級.md:1367｜步驟說明｜往月光林地西南側，向法斯托恩開部落飛行點。｜Go to the southwest of Moonglade and open the tribal flight path towards Faustron.
04-45到60級.md:1368｜交通步驟｜再穿木喉要塞去冬泉谷。｜Cross Timbermaw Hold again to reach Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1370｜站內交通｜第 2 步飛雷霆崖，第 7 步飛費伍德並走木喉要塞，在月光林地西南開飛行點，再步行進冬泉谷。｜In step 2, fly to Thunder Bluff. In step 7, fly to Felwood and go to Timbermaw Hold. unlock the flight path southwest of Moonglade, and then go to Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1371｜站內取捨｜值得做｜先接 1124 和 5527，希利蘇斯南風村能接著做同一區的任務。｜Do | Connect 1124 and 5527 first, Silithus Southwind Village can continue to do the quests in the same area.
04-45到60級.md:1372｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5085 到冬泉谷 永望鎮交；5527 在希利蘇斯 塞納里奧要塞拾取，留月光林地 永夜港交。｜Don't turn it in yet | 5085 is handed in to Winterspring Everlook; 5527 is picked up in Cenarion Fortress at Silithus, and Moonglade Nighthaven is left to hand in.
04-45到60級.md:1373｜站內提醒｜木喉熊怪若還會主動攻擊，先在要塞外打死木熊怪或完成費伍德森林 翡翠聖地與血毒崗哨至冬泉谷 永望鎮的聲望任務；通過要塞後可立刻接冬泉谷 永望鎮。｜If the Timbermaw is still actively attacking, first kill the Timberbolg outside the fortress or complete the reputation quests Felwood Emerald Sanctuary and Bloodvenom Post to Winterspring Everlook; immediately pick up Winterspring Everlook after passing the fortress.
04-45到60級.md:1376｜練怪說明｜永夜港交完可由木喉要塞回費伍德側入口補。普通死木熊怪密集，還能補木喉聲望；避開木喉守衛與帳篷內的連拉。｜After Nighthaven is delivered, Timbermaw Hold can be returned to Felwood side entrance for refill. Ordinary dead wood furbolgs are densely packed, which can also replenish Timbermaw's reputation; avoid Timbermaw guards and the chain pulls in the tent.
04-45到60級.md:1377｜練怪說明｜若已穿過要塞，冬泉谷一側先打沿路普通熊怪。可在多諾瓦附近補少量，主要怪群仍在永望鎮以東。｜If you have passed through the fortress, Winterspring first fight the ordinary furbolgs along the road. A small amount can be replenished near Donova, and the main monster group is still east of Everlook.
04-45到60級.md:1382｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1384｜危險說明｜若從月光林地走木喉要塞轉冬泉谷，先確認木喉聲望。敵對時先繞或回費伍德補聲望。｜If you go from Moonglade to Timbermaw Hold to Winterspring, first confirm the reputation of Timbermaw. When hostile, go around or return to Felwood to replenish your reputation.
04-45到60級.md:1392｜交通步驟｜出木喉要塞沿路往東，先到溫泉找多諾瓦，再進永望鎮。｜Head east from Timbermaw Hold. Visit Donova at Frostfire Hot Springs before entering Everlook.
04-45到60級.md:1399｜步驟說明｜只有洞內成年的女族長、雪人王掉落，低階雪人留給前段任務。｜Only the cave's adult matriarchs and patriarchs drop it. Skip the lower-level yetis.
04-45到60級.md:1399｜標籤｜掉率 10%｜Drop rate: 10%
04-45到60級.md:1401｜步驟說明｜接完先在永望鎮對萊加奇（61.54, 38.61）使用機械雪人，另外兩人安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地順路。｜Use the Mechanical Yeti on Legacki in Everlook (61.54, 38.61), then on two in Un'Goro.
04-45到60級.md:1402｜交通步驟｜選做取蛋或已組好厄運之槌隊伍時才飛菲拉斯莫沙徹營地；兩項都跳過就從永望鎮直飛加基森。｜Fly to Camp Mojache only for the optional egg or a ready Dire Maul group. Otherwise fly straight from Everlook to Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:1404｜站內交通｜第 1 步從木喉要塞出來先停溫泉，末步依是否要繞菲拉斯 亂羽高地選航線。｜The first step is to stop at the hot spring after coming out of Timbermaw Hold. The last step is to choose a route depending on whether you want to go around Feralas or Frayfeather Highlands.
04-45到60級.md:1405｜站內取捨｜先別交｜3912 在塔納利斯 加基森解。5086 到費伍德森林 鐵木森林刷物品，回冬泉谷 冰火溫泉交。｜Don't pay it yet | 3912 is solved in Tanaris Gadgetzan. 5086 Go to Felwood Irontree Woods to brush items and return to Winterspring Frostfire Hot Springs to hand in.
04-45到60級.md:1406｜站內取捨｜值得做｜5163 會沿同一路線跑三張圖，接了就先在永望鎮用一次。｜Do | 5163 will run three pictures along the same route. After receiving it, use it once in Everlook.
04-45到60級.md:1407｜站內提醒｜還差 57 級就先在冰薊嶺（約 66, 43）打普通雪人，或在菲拉斯 亂羽高地打角鷹獸。｜If you are still short of level 57, first fight the ordinary snowman at Ice Thistle Hills (about 66, 43), or fight the hippogryph at Feralas Frayfeather Highlands.
04-45到60級.md:1410｜練怪說明｜冰薊嶺洞口的普通雪人，任務需要的角也會掉。人多可打外坡，洞內留意連拉。｜Ice Thistle Hills The ordinary snowman at the entrance of the cave will also lose the corners required for the quest. If there are many people, hit the outer slope, but pay attention to the continuous pull inside the cave.
04-45到60級.md:1411｜練怪說明｜同一帶的高等普通雪人，補到 57 的經驗較合適。隊友先清窄道，避免兩隻同時進戰。｜For high-level ordinary snowmen in the same area, it is more appropriate to grind XP to 57. Teammates clear the narrow path first to avoid two enemies entering into battle at the same time.
04-45到60級.md:1417｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1419｜危險說明｜冰薊丘的洞道窄，57–58 級雪人會在轉角連拉。缺經驗先打洞口外側。｜The cave in Ice Thistle Hill is narrow, and level 57–58 snowmen will pull around corners. If you lack experience, drill the outside of the hole first.
04-45到60級.md:1427｜交通步驟｜從莫沙徹營地沿南路到亂羽高地；點角鷹獸蛋（55.91, 76.03 或 58.62, 75.53），拿 1 顆就回飛點。｜Take the south road from Camp Mojache to the Frayfeather Highlands. Loot one Hippogryph Egg (55.91, 76.03 or 58.62, 75.53), then return to the flight master.
04-45到60級.md:1427｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1428｜交通步驟｜取蛋者回莫沙徹營地飛加基森。跳過菲拉斯的角色到加基森直接開始安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地。｜If you collected an egg, return to Camp Mojache and fly to Gadgetzan. If you skipped Feralas, start the Marshal's Refuge leg from Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:1430｜站內交通｜第 1 步為南下取蛋的停靠點，第 2 步飛加基森。｜The first step is the stopping point for heading south to get the eggs, and the second step is flying Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:1431｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜超級測蛋器（The Super Egg-O-Matic）的一次性交件，已做過或已達 57 級且想省跑圖時，可以直接飛加基森。｜Optional|The Super Egg-O-Matic is a one-time delivery. If you have already done it or reached level 57 and want to save running maps, fly directly to Gadgetzan.
04-45到60級.md:1432｜站內提醒｜未到 57 級可在亂羽高地（約 57, 76）打普通角鷹獸，或者冬泉谷 永望鎮打冰薊雪人後直接搭機。｜If you have not reached level 57, fight ordinary hippogryphs at Frayfeather Highlands (approximately 57, 76), or fight Ice Thistle Yeti at Winterspring Everlook and then take the plane directly.
04-45到60級.md:1435｜練怪說明｜菲拉斯短訪只有角鷹獸蛋支線。缺 57 級可在上一站離開永望鎮前補，冰薊嶺雪人等級較高；洞口可能有人搶。｜Feralas The short interview only has the hippogryph egg branch. If you are missing level 57, make up for it before leaving Everlook at the previous station. Ice Thistle Hills is a snowman with a higher level; there may be people grabbing it at the entrance of the cave.
04-45到60級.md:1441｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1442｜標籤｜僅法師,薩滿,牧師,聖騎士,術士,德魯伊｜Mage/Shaman/Priest/Paladin/Warlock/Druid only
04-45到60級.md:1450｜交通步驟｜先在加基森完成墓園交接。做機械雪人任務的角色也留在鎮內，等使用過雪人再走南路。｜Finish the graveyard steps in Gadgetzan first. Stay in town until you've used the Mechanical Yeti if you're on that quest.
04-45到60級.md:1451｜步驟說明｜用菲拉斯 亂羽高地撿的 1 顆蛋；已做過就直接跳過。｜Use Feralas Frayfeather Highlands to pick up 1 egg; skip it if you have already done it.
04-45到60級.md:1451｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1452｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1453｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
04-45到60級.md:1454｜步驟說明｜喝下會死亡；先用靈魂完成交談，再回墓園復活。｜Drinking it kills you. Talk while dead, then resurrect at the graveyard.
04-45到60級.md:1460｜交通步驟｜先對加基森的斯普琳科（1446 51.06, 26.87）使用機械雪人，再沿南路入環形山。｜Use the Mechanical Yeti on Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (1446 51.06, 26.87), then take the south road into Un'Goro.
04-45到60級.md:1463｜步驟說明｜打開托爾瓦的麻袋，先放肉塊，再用費洛蒙引出拉克維。｜Open Torva's sack, put the meat pieces first, and then use pheromones to elicit Lar'korwi.

04-45到60級.md:1473｜步驟說明｜前兩人沿冬泉谷 永望鎮及本段轉場完成；在這裡對奎克希爾使用後留冬泉谷 霜語峽谷交。｜Use the yeti on Quixxil here after the first two targets. Turn in at Frostwhisper Gorge.
04-45到60級.md:1476｜步驟說明｜有反應才算完成，不用跳進熔岩。｜It's completed when you have a reaction, no need to jump into the lava.
04-45到60級.md:1479｜步驟說明｜護送前先清洞口；林格倒下時用斯普拉格的水壺叫醒他。｜Clear the cave entrance before escorting. Wake Ringo with Spraggle's Canteen.
04-45到60級.md:1493｜步驟說明｜進洞時先清外層猩猩，尤爾查本身為普通怪。｜Clear the gorillas at the cave entrance. U'cha is a normal mob.
04-45到60級.md:1493｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1495｜交通步驟｜由安戈洛西北坡進希利蘇斯，沿路直上塞納里奧要塞。｜Use Un'Goro's northwest ramp into Silithus. Follow the road to Cenarion Hold.
04-45到60級.md:1497｜站內交通｜第 1、11 步經加基森，沿途用機械雪人，末步走西北坡去希利蘇斯。｜Steps 1 and 11 pass through Gadgetzan, use mechanical snowmen en route, and take the northwest slope to Silithus for the final step.
04-45到60級.md:1498｜站內取捨｜先別交｜980 到冬泉谷 冰火溫泉交，5163 到永望鎮交；3942 留費伍德森林 鐵木森林。｜Don’t pay it yet | 980 should be paid to Winterspring Frostfire Hot Springs, 5163 should be paid to Everlook; 3942 should be reserved for Felwood Irontree Woods.
04-45到60級.md:1499｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜2741 只在撿到蛋且還能交時出發；沒撿的不用折返。｜Optional|2741 Only set out when you have picked up the eggs and can still hand them in; if you haven't picked up the eggs, you don't have to turn back.
04-45到60級.md:1500｜站內提醒｜同為 57–59 級帶。要補進度可打火羽山普通元素或北側猩猩，留意平原巡邏的魔暴龍。｜Both are in the 57–59 band. To make up for the progress, fight Fire Plume Ridge normal element or the northern orangutan, and pay attention to the Devilsaur patrolling the plains.
04-45到60級.md:1503｜練怪說明｜火羽山的普通元素，等級較高且可順做火山任務。沿山腰拉，別進入魔暴龍巡邏的平原。｜The common element of Fire Plume Ridge has a higher level and can be used for volcano quests. Pull along the mountainside and don't enter the plains where Devilsaur patrols.
04-45到60級.md:1504｜練怪說明｜馬紹爾營地附近的普通焦油怪，差一點就升級時可從營地出發打幾輪。沿池邊單拉。｜Marshal's Refuge fight a few rounds of nearby tar monsters from the camp when they are almost upgraded. Single pull along the edge of the pool.
04-45到60級.md:1509｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1512｜危險說明｜火羽山南側平原有 54–56 級精英魔暴龍。護送林格前先觀察路線，走山腰避開平原。｜Fire Plume Ridge There is a level 54–56 Elite Devilsaur in the southern plain. Observe the route before escorting Ringe, and avoid the plains by walking on the mountainside.
04-45到60級.md:1520｜交通步驟｜塞納里奧城堡｜Cenarion Hold
04-45到60級.md:1520｜步驟說明｜抵達塞納里奧要塞後，向魯克·馴風者開部落飛行點。｜After arriving at Cenarion Hold, open the Horde flight path towards Runk Windtamer.
04-45到60級.md:1521｜交通步驟｜可在旅店（1451 51.89, 39.16）綁爐石，跑完勇士之墓後用。｜Set your hearth at the inn (1451 51.89, 39.16) if you want to use it after Valor's Rest.

04-45到60級.md:1547｜步驟說明｜亡靈死後可能生出異種蠍，先處理再拉下一隻。｜Undead can spawn a silithid when killed. Kill it before the next pull.
04-45到60級.md:1550｜步驟說明｜清塔梯的怪再開物件，塔裡視線窄。｜Clear the tower stairs before opening the object. Watch your line of sight.
04-45到60級.md:1550｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
04-45到60級.md:1553｜交通步驟｜回塞納里奧要塞；若這站已綁爐石，這時可用。｜Return to Cenarion Hold. Hearth if bound here.
04-45到60級.md:1556｜交通步驟｜從要塞飛回奧格瑪，在杜洛塔轉提里斯法飛艇。｜Fly from Cenarion Hold to Orgrimmar, then take the Tirisfal zeppelin from Durotar.
04-45到60級.md:1558｜站內交通｜第 1 步開塞納里奧要塞飛行點，最後一步轉飛艇回東部王國。｜The first step is to drive to the Cenarion Fortress flight path, and the last step is to transfer the zeppelin back to Eastern Kingdoms.
04-45到60級.md:1559｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5527、6844 留到月光林地交。｜Don’t turn it in yet | 5527 and 6844, save them for Moonglade.
04-45到60級.md:1560｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜8282 要從要塞再跑一次地圖最南端；8283 要殺精英，練等路線可略過。｜Optional|8282 run from the fortress to the southernmost point of the map again; 8283 kill elites, so skip the training route.
04-45到60級.md:1561｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜影片提及的暗翼蝠 6135 在東瘟疫；希利蘇斯這站也略過組隊精英。｜Optional|The Darkwing Bat 6135 mentioned in the video is in the Eastern Plague; Silithus This site also skips the team elite.
04-45到60級.md:1562｜站內提醒｜未滿 59 級仍可先到西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘；要補則留在要塞東北（約 55, 29）打普通蠍、蜘蛛或西南暮光教徒（約 38, 44）。｜If you are under level 59, still go to Western Plaguelands The Bulwark first; if you want to supplement, stay in the northeast of the fortress (about 55, 29) and fight ordinary scorpions, spiders or southwest Twilight Cultists (about 38, 44).
04-45到60級.md:1565｜練怪說明｜暮光營地外側普通教徒，等級正合適、掉暮光裝，可順做教徒任務。會遇到收裝玩家，從營邊清。｜Twilight Base Camp is an ordinary cultist on the outside, with the right level and the twilight equipment, so he can complete the cultist quest. You will encounter players who want to collect them, so clear them from the edge of the camp.
04-45到60級.md:1566｜練怪說明｜要塞東北空地的普通怪，等級稍低但密度好，與採任務材料同路。若暮光營地人多可替換。｜The normal mobs in the open space in the northeast of the fortress have a slightly lower level but good density, and they go the same way as collecting quest materials. If there are many people, Twilight Base Camp can be replaced.

04-45到60級.md:1575｜危險說明｜南風村塔頂會觸發異種蠍群。先清塔內和樓梯，把退路留到觸發後。｜Southwind Village The top of the tower will trigger a swarm of silithid scorpions. Clear the tower and stairs first, leaving the escape route until after the trigger.
04-45到60級.md:1583｜交通步驟｜由提里斯法飛艇塔往亡靈壁壘，再走費爾斯通農場、安多哈爾與北山伐木場。｜Go from the Tirisfal zeppelin tower to the Bulwark, then through Felstone Field, Andorhal and Northridge Lumber Camp.

04-45到60級.md:1599｜步驟說明｜安多哈爾市中心有精英巫妖，走外側到旅店。｜There are elite lichs in the center of Andorhal. Go outside to the inn.
04-45到60級.md:1603｜步驟說明｜假書可能引出敵人；看封面並避開市中心精英。｜Fake books may attract enemies; look at the cover and avoid inner-city elites.
04-45到60級.md:1613｜步驟說明｜桶會引來敵人，開完就撤離。｜The barrel will attract enemies, so evacuate after opening it.
04-45到60級.md:1615｜交通步驟｜回幽暗城飛艇塔，搭飛艇回奧格瑪，再往費伍德。｜Return to the Undercity zeppelin tower. Take the Orgrimmar zeppelin and continue to Felwood.
04-45到60級.md:1617｜站內交通｜第 1 步進亡靈壁壘，最後一步從幽暗城外搭飛艇。｜The first step is to The Bulwark, and the last step is to take the zeppelin from Undercity.
04-45到60級.md:1618｜站內取捨｜值得做｜費爾斯通和安多哈爾連著做，末段白蟻回程剛好一起交。｜Do |Firestone and Andorhal are done together, and the final part of the termite return journey happens to be done together.

04-45到60級.md:1620｜站內提醒｜未到 59 級可在安多哈爾東側外圍（約 46, 64）或瘟疫農場打普通亡靈，再轉費伍德。｜If you have not reached level 59, fight ordinary undead in the eastern outskirts of Andorhal (about 46, 64) or plague Farm, and then transfer to Felwood.
04-45到60級.md:1623｜練怪說明｜安多哈爾東緣的普通亡靈，回農場前能連打，請避開城內精英和多怪屋群。｜The ordinary undead on the eastern edge of Andorhal can be beaten continuously before returning to Farm. Please avoid the elites and monster houses in the city.
04-45到60級.md:1624｜練怪說明｜蓋羅恩農場的普通怨靈，若仍在東邊可就近補，等級較高。從農場外圍繞，避免房屋內連拉。｜Gahrron's Withering ordinary wraiths, if they are still in the east, replenish them nearby, the level is higher. Surround it from the outside of Farm to avoid pulling inside the house.

04-45到60級.md:1642｜交通步驟｜由奧格瑪飛梣谷碎木崗哨，沿大路向北進費伍德，先到翡翠聖地與附近路邊。｜Fly from Orgrimmar to Splintertree Post. Follow the north road into Felwood and stop near Emerald Sanctuary.
04-45到60級.md:1650｜步驟說明｜先清通道再深入；洞內座標可能重疊。｜Clear the passage first and then go deeper; the coordinates in the cave may overlap.

04-45到60級.md:1661｜站內交通｜第 1 步由梣谷北上，末步走木喉要塞去月光林地。｜The first step is from Ashenvale to the north, and the last step is from Timbermaw Hold to Moonglade.
04-45到60級.md:1662｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜5242 要為深處三個目標再走一次暗影堡，單人不順就略過。｜Skipable | 5242 go through Shadow Hold again for the three deep targets. If you don't go well alone, just skip it.
04-45到60級.md:1663｜站內取捨｜先別交｜5086 帶到冬泉谷 冰火溫泉交。｜Don't pay it yet|5086 and bring it to Winterspring Frostfire Hot Springs.
04-45到60級.md:1664｜站內提醒｜未滿 60 級可在鐵木森林（約 49, 25）打劇毒元素和鐵木樹人，也可把差額留給冬泉谷。｜If you are under level 60, fight poisonous elements and ironwood trees at Irontree Woods (about 49, 25), or leave the difference to Winterspring.
04-45到60級.md:1667｜練怪說明｜鐵木森林水池邊普通元素，能同步收劇毒水滴。等級偏低只補小差額，池邊任務玩家多時前往冬泉谷。｜Irontree Woods is a common element beside the pool and can be collected with Toxic Horror Droplet. If the level is low, only a small difference will be made up. Players often go to Winterspring for poolside quests.
04-45到60級.md:1668｜練怪說明｜北路旁普通樹人，若水池被佔可接著打，靠道路方便繼續往木喉要塞。留意營地內施法怪。｜There are ordinary trees beside the north road. If the pool is occupied, continue to fight. Use the convenient road to continue to Timbermaw Hold. Watch out for spellcasting monsters in the camp.
04-45到60級.md:1675｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1677｜危險說明｜暗影堡的火盆分散在狹窄洞道。先清一段再滅火，撤退時沿原路走。｜Shadow Hold The braziers are scattered in the narrow cave. Clear a section first and then extinguish the fire. When retreating, follow the original path.
04-45到60級.md:1685｜交通步驟｜出木喉要塞走大路往永夜港，把希利蘇斯帶來的兩件物品交掉。｜Leave Timbermaw Hold and follow the main road to Nighthaven. Turn in both items from Silithus.
04-45到60級.md:1695｜交通步驟｜帶著 980 或 5086 時，由月光林地原路穿木喉要塞往冬泉谷，先到溫泉。兩件都沒有且跳過多諾瓦的支線時，才從法斯托恩（1450 32.09, 66.61）飛永望鎮。｜With 980 or 5086, go back through Timbermaw Hold to the Winterspring hot springs. If you have neither and are skipping Donova, fly to Everlook from Faustron (1450 32.09, 66.61).
04-45到60級.md:1697｜站內交通｜第 1 步步行到永夜港，末步先按手上任務選溫泉或永望鎮。｜The first step is to walk to Nighthaven. In the last step, choose hot spring or Everlook according to the quest at hand.
04-45到60級.md:1698｜站內取捨｜值得做｜永夜港兩位 NPC 的交接在同一座村。｜Do | Nighthaven The handover between two NPCs takes place in the same village.
04-45到60級.md:1699｜站內取捨｜之後順路｜5526 要進厄運之槌東區，留副本行程。｜Later, I will stop by | 5526 to enter Dire Maul East District, so leave a copy of the itinerary.
04-45到60級.md:1700｜站內提醒｜仍在 59–60 級帶，做完直接進冬泉谷 霜語峽谷。｜Still in the 59-60 level zone, go directly to Winterspring Frostwhisper Gorge after finishing it.
04-45到60級.md:1703｜練怪說明｜月光林地交件後沿要塞轉冬泉谷，到霜語峽谷北口打普通熊。怪等貼近 60，避開谷底精英。｜After turning in Moonglade, turn along the fortress to Winterspring and go to the north entrance of Frostwhisper Gorge to fight ordinary bears. Monsters wait close to 60 and avoid the bottom elite.
04-45到60級.md:1707｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1710｜危險說明｜從月光林地轉冬泉谷時，木喉聲望仍敵對的角色不要直接穿洞，先從費伍德側處理聲望。｜When converting from Moonglade to Winterspring, characters whose reputation is still hostile to Timbermaw should not pierce the hole directly, but deal with the reputation from the Felwood side first.
04-45到60級.md:1718｜交通步驟｜由木喉要塞出來先到溫泉找多諾瓦，交安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地、費伍德森林 鐵木森林帶來的任務，再去永望鎮和南部山谷。直飛永望鎮且跳過溫泉任務者從烏米開始。｜From Timbermaw Hold, see Donova at the hot springs. Turn in the Marshal's Refuge and Irontree Woods quests, then head to Everlook and the southern valley. If you flew straight to Everlook, start with Umi.
04-45到60級.md:1724｜步驟說明｜主路信使會成隊，單人可找木喉入口或死木蒸鍋附近的落單信使。｜Find a lone courier near Timbermaw's entrance or the Deadwood cauldron.

04-45到60級.md:1733｜步驟說明｜到峽谷入口即可，避開深處的精英。｜Just go to the entrance of the canyon and avoid the elites in the depths.
04-45到60級.md:1735｜交通步驟｜還沒到 60 級時留在峽谷北口外，刷普通瘋狂的裂齒熊。｜Below level 60? Grind normal Crazed Shardtooth bears outside the gorge's north entrance.
04-45到60級.md:1737｜站內交通｜第 1 步先到溫泉，交完永望鎮的雪人後往南，末步在峽谷北口外補怪。｜The first step is to go to the hot spring, hand in the snowman Everlook, then go south, and the last step is to collect monsters outside the north entrance of the canyon.
04-45到60級.md:1738｜站內取捨｜值得做｜5087 優先找落單的信使；4842 是探索，和影片的補怪點同路。｜Do | 5087 gives priority to finding the lone messenger; 4842 is exploration, which is the same as the point of replenishing monsters in the film.
04-45到60級.md:1739｜站內取捨｜可跳過｜5121 是精英；單人直接以普通熊怪補等。｜Optional | 5121 is an elite; single player can directly use ordinary furbolgs to make up for the level.
04-45到60級.md:1740｜站內提醒｜未滿 60 級就照影片在霜語峽谷北側打熊。QuestieDB 的普通瘋狂的裂齒熊點（約 57.63, 70.83／66.68, 70.57），避開谷底精英。｜If you are under level 60, follow the video of hunting a bear on the north side of Frostwhisper Gorge. QuestieDB's regular crazy Cracktooth Bear points (~57.63, 70.83/66.68, 70.57), avoiding the Valley Elite.
04-45到60級.md:1743｜練怪說明｜霜語峽谷北口西側的普通熊，近戰、能單拉和剝皮。清完往東線輪替，別進谷底精英區。｜Frostwhisper Gorge An ordinary bear on the west side of the north entrance, capable of melee combat, single pulling and skinning. After clearing, head to the eastern front to rotate, and don't enter the elite area at the bottom.
04-45到60級.md:1744｜練怪說明｜峽谷北口東側的普通熊，西側有人或尚未刷新就沿坡轉來。沿坡拉回道路，避開谷底精英。｜There are ordinary bears on the east side of the north entrance of the canyon. There are people on the west side or they come along the slope before they are refreshed. Pull back up the slope and avoid the valley bottom elite.
04-45到60級.md:1750｜標籤｜僅獵人,戰士,盜賊｜Hunter/Warrior/Rogue only
04-45到60級.md:1752｜危險說明｜霜語峽谷內有 59–60 級精英霜槌巨人，北口補熊時沿坡單拉，別把怪帶進谷底。｜Frostwhisper Gorge contains level 59-60 elite Frostmaul Giants. When replenishing bears at the north entrance, pull them along the slope. Don't bring the monsters into the valley bottom.
04-45到60級.md:1753｜危險說明｜暗語峽谷有 57–60 級精英赫達琳殺戮者。奇怪的源頭在北口觸發，完成就回道路。｜Darkwhisper Gorge has level 57–60 elite Hedaline Slayers. Strange Sources triggers at the north exit, return to the road when completed.

04-45到60級.md:2046｜站內永恆交通複查｜核對火線港與熱砂港的雙向船線，補上塔納利斯端碼頭及加基森首訪地面路線。加基森、莫沙徹、瑟銀哨塔、永望鎮、月光林地與希利蘇斯飛行管理員或旅店依 QuestieDB 的 NPC 名稱、座標更新。[永恆版大河林地航線](https://www.wowhead.com/forever/guide/riverglades-zone-overview)｜Check the two-way ship routes of Powderfuse Port and Steamwheedle Port, and add the Tanaris terminal terminal and the first visit ground route of Gadgetzan. Gadgetzan, Mosacher, Thorium Point, Everlook, Moonglade and Silithus flight controllers or hotels are updated according to the NPC name and coordinates in QuestieDB. [WoW Forever Riverglades Route](https://www.wowhead.com/forever/guide/riverglades-zone-overview)
04-45到60級.md:2047｜站內永恆交通複查｜斯通納德、莫沙徹和聖光之願的回訪先確認飛行點，補首訪地面替代路線。從莫沙徹飛棘齒城後再決定是否搭船交護送，預設少一次跨洲來回。｜For the return visits of Stonard, Moshache and Holy Light's Hope, first confirm the flight path and make up the alternative ground route for the first visit. After flying to Ratchet from Mosache, decide whether to take a boat for escort. By default, you will save one cross-continent round trip.
04-45到60級.md:2048｜站內永恆交通複查｜莫沙徹爐石冷卻時走大路回營地。暴掠龍爪留奧格瑪順路交，加基森先完成墓園和機械雪人再南下，省各一趟同城折返。｜If your hearth is on cooldown, take the road back to Camp Mojache. Turn in the Ravasaur claws in Orgrimmar. Finish the graveyard and Mechanical Yeti in Gadgetzan before heading south.
05-副本.md:8｜副本動線｜入口清穴居人→首廳岔路右上坡，打奧格弗林特並找瑪爾→回主路過十字熔岩橋打塔拉加曼→沿路清火刃教徒→右坡打巴札蘭，盡頭打耶戈什。｜Clear troggs at the entrance → take the first hall's right ramp to Oggleflint and Maur → cross the lava bridge for Taragaman → clear Burning Blade cultists → Bazzalan up the right ramp, then Jergosh at the end.
05-副本.md:11｜副本入口｜奧格瑪 1454 52.60, 49.00｜Orgrimmar 1454 52.60, 49.00
05-副本.md:18｜站內前置接取路線｜在貧瘠之地 十字路口開飛行點後，飛雷霆崖找拉哈羅接 5722／5723，飛奧格瑪找索爾先做 5726／5727，再去暗巷區接 5761；若此輪已開幽暗城飛點，可在飛艇跨海時先向瓦里瑪薩斯領 5725。｜After The Barrens The Crossroads opens the flight path, fly Thunder Bluff to find Rahauro to pick up 5722/5723, fly Orgrimmar to find Thrall and do 5726/5727 first, then go to the dark alley area to pick up 5761; if this round has already started Undercity flying point can lead 5725 to Varimathras first when the zeppelin crosses the sea.

05-副本.md:60｜站內取捨｜進本前確認 5728 已解鎖。只打怒焰一次，暗巷區就近交 5761；雷霆崖、幽暗城的交件可分配到跨城主線。｜Make sure 5728 is unlocked before entering. Only fight Fury Flame once, and the dark alley area will be close to 5761; the deliveries of Thunder Bluff and Undercity can be assigned to the cross-city main line.
05-副本.md:61｜站內說明｜正式門在奧格瑪暗影裂口底部；先進城內暗影裂口，再沿通道到藍色門。｜The official door is at the bottom of the shadow rift at Orgrimmar; first enter the shadow rift in the city, and then follow the passage to the blue door.
05-副本.md:66｜副本動線｜入口→安威瑪休憩地打法德林→黑鐵召喚師旁打瑪格瑪圖斯→走廊清巡邏的掠奪者→諸王聖物庫打杜爾根。｜Entrance → Fadlin at Anvilmar's Rest → Magmatus by the Dark Iron summoner → the patrolling Reaver → Durgan in the royal vault.
05-副本.md:69｜副本入口｜鐵爐堡 1455 27.63, 47.83｜Ironforge 1455 27.63, 47.83
05-副本.md:78｜站內前置接取路線｜從貧瘠之地轉往東部王國後，只有專程成就隊才從幽暗城經銀松、希爾斯布萊德、阿拉希南下濕地，經丹奧加茲到丹莫羅再進鐵爐堡。部落前置接取點未查到。｜After transferring from The Barrens to Eastern Kingdoms, only special-trip achievement teams can go south from Undercity via Silverpine, Hillsbrad, and Arathi to Wetlands, via Dun Algaz to Dun Morogh and then enter Ironforge. Tribe front access point not found.
05-副本.md:78｜標籤｜接取錨點 02-第8站｜Pick up anchor point 02-Stop 8
05-副本.md:83｜站內說明｜本機永恆版的 96391、96393、96394、96395、96403、98423 都標聯盟；部落沒有可核實的接取路線。｜The native Eternal versions of 96391, 96393, 96394, 96395, 96403, and 98423 are all labeled Alliance; Horde has no verifiable access route.
05-副本.md:87｜站內說明｜可進本打法德林·安威瑪、瑪格瑪圖斯、掠奪者、杜爾根·喪鐘錘等首領。這趟以掉落或成就為主。｜Enter the dungeon to fight bosses such as Fadelin Anvilmar, Magmatus, Plunder, Durgan Deathstroke Hammer, etc. This trip is mainly about drops or achievements.
05-副本.md:91｜站內說明｜部落交件未查到。｜Tribal submission not found.
05-副本.md:93｜站內取捨｜練級可略過。若要做傳承成就，先約隊再去，聯盟首都守衛與 PvP 規則會增加進門難度。｜Leveling optional. If you want to achieve inheritance achievements, you must first make a team appointment before going there. Alliance capital guards and PvP rules will make it more difficult to enter.
05-副本.md:94｜站內說明｜城內由王座廳側門進舊鐵爐堡通道；穿到底才到副本門。暴雪確認部落可進，但需進聯盟領地。｜In the city, enter the old Ironforge passage through the side door of the throne room; go through to the end to reach the dungeon door. Blizzard confirmed that the Horde can enter, but they need to enter the alliance territory.
05-副本.md:99｜副本動線｜入口→國王巷打枯牙→沿路清亡靈→擊敗男爵並取紋章→墓園打拉斯梅爾，順路找西側的愛德華。市集的被遺棄者與墓園西南煙囪的維克托可選。｜Entrance → Witherfang in King's Alley → clear undead → kill the Baron and loot the crest → Rath'mael in the cemetery and Edward to the west. The Forsaken in the market and Victor by the southwest chimney are optional.
05-副本.md:102｜副本入口｜幽暗城 1458 72.41, 11.37｜Undercity 1458 72.41, 11.37
05-副本.md:110｜站內前置接取路線｜先在提里斯法林地 布瑞爾向林奈確認 356 的進度。林奈另有 99156 版本【僅獸人,不死族】。前往銀松森林前，從布瑞爾下飛艇可順路拜訪林奈與克里斯多夫；瑟伯切爾先向塔比薩領 92401，並完成 447→450→451；幽暗城鍊金房找格雷夫與莫賓。這六類任務等副本階段再交。｜First confirm the progress of 356 with Linnaeus at Tirisfal Glades Brill. Linnaeus also has version 99156 [orcs, undead only]. before Silverpine Forest, get off the zeppelin from Brill and visit Linnaeus and Christopher; The Sepulcher first get 92401 from Tabitha, and complete 447→450→451; Undercity find Grave and Mobin in the alchemy room. These six types of quests will be handed in during the dungeon stage.

05-副本.md:167｜站內取捨｜部落在 16–20 級可優先排一場。沒有清過銀松配方線的角色，可先做銀松森林 瑟伯切爾再組本，讓枯牙一起計入。｜Tribes at levels 16–20 can prioritize one game. For characters who have not cleared the Silver Pine recipe line, first make Silverpine Forest The Sepulcher and then assemble the set, so that the withered teeth will be included in the calculation.
05-副本.md:168｜站內說明｜入口在幽暗城上方、提里斯法地表的王城廢墟。用幽暗城地圖座標，在進王城後上左側石階；不要走到地下電梯。｜The entrance is above Undercity, in the royal city Ruins on the surface of Tirisfal. Use the Undercity map coordinates and go up the stone steps on the left after entering the Royal City; do not go to the underground elevator.
05-副本.md:173｜副本動線｜入口淺水找安娜科德拉→河西打考布萊恩→回水道往東打皮薩斯、斯卡姆、瑟芬迪斯、永生的沃爾丹→四牙王都倒後回入口護送信徒，打穆坦努斯。兩翼沿路採毒蛇花、收變異皮革和哀嚎香精，並清變異怪。｜Anacondra in the entrance shallows → Cobrahn west of the river → Pythas, Skum, Serpentis and Verdan to the east → return to the entrance after all four Fanglords, escort the Disciple and kill Mutanus. Gather Serpentbloom, Deviate Hides and Wailing Essence while clearing deviates in both wings.
05-副本.md:176｜副本入口｜貧瘠之地 1413 46.00, 36.30｜The Barrens 1413 46.00, 36.30
05-副本.md:184｜站內前置接取路線｜在貧瘠之地 十字路口找圖加完成 870→877→880，然後去雷霆崖找哈繆爾、納拉與札瑪；棘齒城先交 865 再接 1491 和 959。最後去洞口上方石台找納爾派克與厄布魯。｜Find Tuga in The Barrens The Crossroads to complete 870→877→880, then go to Thunder Bluff to find Hamuir, Nala and Zama; Ratchet first hand over 865 and then pick up 1491 and 959. Finally, go to the stone platform above the cave entrance to find Nalpak and Ebru.

05-副本.md:221｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖可查 Lady Anacondra；另一點 28.1,31.8（第 1 圖 30.50, 43.20）、Lord Cobrahn（第 1 圖 15.60, 58.50）、Lord Pythas（第 1 圖 85.60, 28.40）、Lord Serpentis（第 1 圖 61.60, 53.80）。｜Map 1: Anacondra 30.5,43.2; Cobrahn 15.6,58.5; Pythas 85.6,28.4; Serpentis 61.6,53.8.
05-副本.md:221｜步驟位置｜淺水找安娜科德拉，河西考布萊恩，河東另兩王｜Find Anacondra in the shallows, Cobrahn west and the other two bosses east.
