05-副本.md:238｜站內取捨｜沒交 865 就看不到 1491；少一條不必讓全隊在門口等。已先完成貧瘠之地 十字路口綠洲鏈，照既有進度從 1489 接續。｜If you don't hand in 865, you won't be able to see 1491; if you don't have one, you don't have to make the whole team wait at the door. The The Barrens The Crossroads oasis chain has been completed first, and continues from 1489 according to the existing progress.
05-副本.md:239｜站內說明｜外洞洞口約 1413 47.70, 35.00；由繁茂綠洲進石洞穿過通道，門在更深處。納爾派克、厄布魯在外洞上方的小洞，接完再下去。｜The entrance to the outer cave is about 1413 47.70, 35.00; enter the stone cave from the lush oasis and pass through the passage. The door is deeper. Nalpak and Ebru are connected to the small hole above the outer hole and then go down.
05-副本.md:244｜副本動線｜入口礦道→拉克佐→斯尼德伐木場順撿木材→基爾尼格熔爐→炸門進船塢→重拳先生→綠皮隊長→艾德溫·范克里夫。廚師在船下層。只需木材可在斯尼德房取完後退出。｜Mine tunnel → Rhahk'Zor → Sneed and the lumber → Gilnid's forge → blast the door to the docks → Mr. Smite → Captain Greenskin → Edwin VanCleef. Cookie is on the lower deck. Leave after Sneed if you only need the lumber.
05-副本.md:247｜副本入口｜西部荒野 1436 38.20, 77.50｜Westfall 1436 38.20, 77.50
05-副本.md:255｜站內前置接取路線｜前往銀松森林時，先在提里斯法林地 班達利昂要塞找丹妮莎接 91858，順路做完銀松、芬里斯島前置【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。滿 20 級在瑟伯切爾向露蜜娜接 95036 並找崔凡拿筆記【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。從貧瘠之地 棘齒城搭船去藏寶海灣，沿荊棘谷北上暮色森林，再向西到月溪鎮。｜When going to Silverpine Forest, first find Denissa at Tirisfal Glades Bandarion Keep to pick up 91858, and complete Silver Pine and Fenris Isle preset [Undead only] [Paladin only] en route. At level 20, go to Lumina at The Sepulcher to get 95036 and go to Cui Fan to get the notes [Undead only] [Paladin only]. Take a boat from The Barrens Ratchet to Booty Bay, go north along Stranglethorn Vale to Duskwood, and then west to Moonbrook.

05-副本.md:291｜站內取捨｜純練級可略過這趟。做 95036 打到斯尼德房間收齊木料即可【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。隊伍想拿尾王裝備可繼續打完。｜For pure leveling, skip this trip. Do 95036 to get to the Sneed room and collect all the wood [Undead only] [Paladin only]. If the team wants to get the final boss equipment, they can continue the fight to the end.

05-副本.md:292｜站內說明｜月溪鎮的礦井入口約 1436 42.40, 70.40，先進建築下樓，再循坑道到 38.20, 77.50 的正式門。聯盟接的迪菲亞任務不列入部落。｜The entrance to the mine at Moonbrook is about 1436 42.40, 70.40. Go downstairs in the advanced building and then follow the tunnel to the official gate at 38.20, 77.50. Defias quests received by the Alliance are not included in the Horde.
05-副本.md:297｜副本動線｜入口打雷希戈爾並放出阿達曼特→庭院右側找文森特→穿過宴會廳與城牆→芬魯斯房取書→沿塔路清怪，打狼王南杜斯→上樓打阿魯高並查桌面。｜Kill Rethilgore and free Adamant → find Vincent on the right side of the courtyard → banquet hall and ramparts → Fenrus's room for the book → clear the tower to Wolf Master Nandos → kill Arugal upstairs and check his table.
05-副本.md:300｜副本入口｜銀松森林 1421 44.70, 67.80｜Silverpine Forest 1421 44.70, 67.80
05-副本.md:308｜站內前置接取路線｜前往銀松森林前，路過幽暗城時在鍊金區先接 1013，到瑟伯切爾找哈德瑞克和達拉爾接 1098、1014。可在貧瘠之地 陶拉祖營地東側接 1740【僅術士】。先做死亡礦坑章節的 91858 至 95036，保留 95036【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。往希爾斯布萊德途中，回東部王國後可先飛銀松森林 瑟伯切爾，再向南走。｜Before Silverpine Forest, when passing by Undercity, pick up 1013 in the chain gold area. Go to The Sepulcher to find Hadrick and Dalal to pick up 1098 and 1014. Can be connected to 1740 [Warlock only] on the east side of The Barrens Camp Taurajo. Do 91858 to 95036 of chapter Deadmines first, and keep 95036 [Undead only] [Paladin only]. en route to Hillsbrad, after returning to Eastern Kingdoms, first fly to Silverpine Forest The Sepulcher, and then go south.

05-副本.md:333｜站內取捨｜1013 與 1014 都要回外面交；1098 在本內交給文森特。22 級前隊伍若不穩，可先做羅德隆廢墟或哀嚎洞穴。｜1013 and 1014 must be returned outside; 1098 must be handed over to Vincent inside. If the team is unstable before level 22, do Ruins of Lordaeron or Wailing Caverns first.
05-副本.md:334｜站內說明｜瑟伯切爾南下，沿焚木村北側坡道進堡，過外門走到庭院旁真正的副本門。想打達拉然城隱藏首領，另從阿魯高桌上取 Black Tome，再去安伯米爾大廳的地脈裝置製成 Tome of Dalaran。｜The Sepulcher Go south, enter the castle along the north ramp of Pyrewood Village, go through the outer door and walk to the real copy door next to the courtyard. If you want to fight the hidden boss Dalaran City, take the Black Tome from the Arugal table, and then go to the Leyline Device in the Ambermill lobby to make the Tome of Dalaran.
05-副本.md:339｜副本動線｜從東側入口往西穿沼澤打鹽脊→沿草叢小徑打灌木迅猛龍與暗齒→走西南側營區清龍喉→南行至挖掘場啟動守護者旁面板，打倒守護者後拾聖物。｜From the east entrance, head west through the marsh to Saltspine → take the brushy trail for Thicket Raptors and Shadetooth → clear Dragonmaw in the southwest camp → activate the panel at the dig site and loot the relic from the Relic Guardian.
05-副本.md:342｜副本入口｜溼地 1437 47.79, 56.16｜Wetland 1437 47.79, 56.16
05-副本.md:350｜站內前置接取路線｜石爪山脈 烈日石居已滿24可從石爪山飛奧格瑪，暗巷區找博斯坦接 95697。塔倫米爾離站後，先往阿拉希落錘鎮找薩魯克接 95663，再過薩多爾大橋與丹莫德，走瑟根石一帶山路找亡靈衛兵密探；接 95682 後才進本。｜Stonetalon Mountains Sun Rock Retreat If you are 24 or older, fly Orgrimmar from Stone Claw Mountain. Find Borstan in the dark alley area to pick up 95697. After Tarren Mill leaves the station, go to Arashi Hammerfall to find Zaruk and then pick up 95663, then pass Thandol Span and Dun Modr, then take the mountain road along Thelgen Rock to find Deathstalker Agent; pick up 95682 before entering.

05-副本.md:378｜站內說明｜正式藍色門在維爾加挖掘場東南方的高坡。集合石、亡靈衛兵密探與副本門是不同點。｜The formal blue door is on the high slope southeast of Whelgar's Excavation Site. The collection stone, Deathstalker Agent and the copy door are different.
05-副本.md:383｜副本動線｜沿水洞到加摩拉的海龜池，從水下側洞找塞爾瑞德→經薩利維絲女士和格里哈斯特的岔洞到暮光營區找洛古斯。暮光營區順路收碎片。【僅術士】從月神祭壇廢墟橋下點石、打阿奎尼斯並取水球→回聖所打克爾里斯→全隊準備好再逐一點火，進阿庫麥爾巢穴。｜Follow the flooded cave to Ghamoo-ra's pool and find Thaelrid in the underwater side cave → past Lady Sarevess and Gelihast to Lorgus Jett in the Twilight camp. Warlocks loot shards there. Use the stone under the bridge for Aquanis and his globe → Kelris → get the group ready before lighting all four braziers for Aku'mai.

05-副本.md:393｜站內前置接取路線｜在石爪山脈 烈日石居找蘇納曼接 6562，留到梣谷 佐拉姆加前哨站找耶努薩克雷。貧瘠之地 棘齒城與陶拉祖營地可先接 1740【僅術士】。在銀松森林 瑟伯切爾接好 95036 並留在日誌【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。到梣谷 佐拉姆海岸先接 6563／6921，外洞取得便箋時先回前哨交再進本。再接 95042【僅不死族】【僅聖騎士】。｜Find Tsunaman at Stonetalon Mountains Sun Rock Retreat to pick up 6562, stay at Ashenvale Zoramgar Outpost to find Je'neu Sancrea. The Barrens Ratchet and Camp Taurajo can be connected to 1740 [Warlock only] first. Pick up 95036 at Silverpine Forest The Sepulcher and leave in the log [Undead only] [Paladin only]. Go to Ashenvale The Zoram Strand and pick up 6563/6921 first. When you get the note from the outer cave, return to the outpost and turn it in before entering the book. Then pick up 95042 [Undead only] [Paladin only].

Pass through the cave along the waterway, and go deep into the cave to find the dungeon door. Kurll The braziers around Reese will each trigger a wave of monsters, which are divided into points.
05-副本.md:436｜副本動線｜入口走廊清十字軍並收心臟→審訊室打韋沙斯，找拷問架上的沃瑞爾→穿過露天墓園，下墓穴階梯打血法師薩爾諾斯。｜Clear Crusaders and loot hearts in the entry hall → kill Vishas and find Vorrel on the rack → cross the open cemetery and descend to Bloodmage Thalnos.

05-副本.md:447｜站內前置接取路線｜經希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾時可先開飛行點；從幽暗城沿提里斯法林地北路到修道院。先完成剃刀沼澤 1109（若先跑千針石林才去剃刀沼澤，把 1113 留到轉往奧特蘭克山脈途中接；墓地可先打沃瑞爾），在幽暗城煉金區找法拉尼爾；離開墓地之後要到奧特蘭克湖岸與塔倫米爾。｜When passing through Hillsbrad Foothills Tarren Mill, unlock the flight path first; from Undercity, follow the north road Tirisfal Glades to the monastery. Complete Razorfen Kraul 1109 first (if you run Thousand Needles first before Razorfen Kraul, leave 1113 to pick up en route to Alterac Mountains; fight Worrell in the cemetery first), find Faranir in the alchemy area of Undercity; after leaving the cemetery, go to the shores of Lake Rank and Ott Tarren Mill.

05-副本.md:473｜副本動線｜進本在下水道入口接哥布林任務→打阿崔希斯，想打林恩再進符文密室→從右路上街，沿途收構裝體核心並到城堡左側樓上書架找書→紫羅蘭城堡會客室開傳送門，擊敗大法師之影。離本前回下水道入口找瑞克希交書。｜Pick up the goblin quests at the sewer entrance → kill Atrexis, then optionally enter the rune chamber for Lynn → take the right path to the street and loot construct cores → get the book upstairs left of the Citadel → portal to the Violet Parlor for the Archmage's Shade. Turn the book in to Rexxie by the entrance.

05-副本.md:484｜站內前置接取路線｜塔倫米爾可先接梅里薩拉的 96986，經幽暗城時向馬丁醫生接 96988。希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾到30級向沃迪恩接 544／93680，沿洛丹米爾湖東南到收容所，同一趟取血石和污穢鑰匙；回塔倫米爾交後接 545，完成再接 92434。繞湖岸向莫德菈的影像報到，接 96984 後把下水道鑰匙留在身上。｜Tarren Mill can first connect to 96986 of Melisara, and then connect to 96988 of Dr. Martin via Undercity. Hillsbrad Foothills Tarren Mill Go to level 30 and pick up 544/93680 from Wardian. Follow Lordamere Lake southeast to the shelter. Get the Blood Stone and the Filth Key on the same trip; return to Tarren Mill and pick up 545, and then pick up 92434 after completion. Go around the lakeshore to check in with Modra's image, then leave the sewer key with you.

05-副本.md:523｜站內取捨｜部落前置從30級起，建議先做好開門任務再招募。隊伍有鑰匙可先確認誰能開門；有自己的鑰匙便於再訪。隊伍想打隱藏首領 Lyn the Ignored，再帶從影牙城堡起手製成的 Tome of Dalaran。｜The prerequisite for the Horde starts from level 30. complete the opening quests before recruiting. If the team has a key, they can first confirm who can open the door; if they have their own key, they can easily visit again. The team wants to fight the hidden boss Lyn the Ignored, and then bring the Tome of Dalaran made from Shadowfang Keep.
05-副本.md:524｜站內說明｜莫德菈影像與正式門在不同點；走洛丹米爾湖的下水道側。戶外達拉然城門與城內 NPC 通行受陣營規則限制。｜The image of Modera is at a different point than the formal door; take the sewer side of Lordamere Lake. The passage between the outdoor Dalaran City gate and NPCs in the city is restricted by camp rules.
05-副本.md:529｜副本動線｜過入口畫廊到左手小室取書→經前庭打馴犬者洛克希→在長廊末段與杜安前的書架分別取書→擊敗奧法師杜安，開身後箱取血色十字軍鑰匙。｜Take the book from the small left room past the gallery → kill Houndmaster Loksey → collect the books from the last corridor and the shelf before Doan → kill Arcanist Doan and loot the Scarlet Key from the strongbox behind him.
05-副本.md:532｜副本入口｜提里斯法林地 1420 85.20, 32.10｜Tirisfal Glades 1420 85.20, 32.10
05-副本.md:540｜站內前置接取路線｜阿拉希高地 落錘鎮回幽暗城再去圖書館；千針石林 亂風崗先做多恩 1149→1150→1151。已走過石爪山脈 烈日石居時，可在梣谷南線由隧道去布勞格，再到幽暗城找帕科瓦。路過雷霆崖時可順接 1049【僅獸人,牛頭人,食人妖】。可在 千針石林 閃光平原、塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村跑塔貝薩和提爾斯的前置，書可之後回東部王國時補拿【僅法師】。｜Arathi Highlands Hammerfall return to Undercity and then go to the library; Thousand Needles Freewind Post Do Dorne first 1149→1150→1151. When you have passed Stonetalon Mountains Sun Rock Retreat, take the south line of Ashenvale from the tunnel to Braug, and then go to Undercity to find Pakova. When passing Thunder Bluff, take 1049 [orcs, tauren, and trolls only]. run Tabetha and Tiers in Thousand Needles, The Shimmering Flats, Dustwallow Marsh Brackenwall Village, and replenish [Mage only] when you return to Eastern Kingdoms later.

05-副本.md:596｜站內說明｜1048 橫跨三翼，完整做／交列在大教堂。｜1048 spans three wings and is completed in the cathedral.
05-副本.md:599｜副本動線｜開門進軍械庫→沿營房和長廊到底→在大廳打赫洛德→清後續進場的血色學員。｜Open the Armory door → follow the barracks and hall to Herod → clear the Scarlet Trainees after he dies.
05-副本.md:602｜副本入口｜提里斯法林地 1420 85.20, 32.10｜Tirisfal Glades 1420 85.20, 32.10
05-副本.md:609｜站內前置接取路線｜由阿拉希高地 落錘鎮飛幽暗城，可與圖書館同趟；在幽暗城皇家區瓦里瑪薩斯處接 1048，需 33 級；若在圖書館已接，保留任務並帶上血色十字軍鑰匙。從幽暗城走提里斯法林地北路到修道院。｜Fly from Arathi Highlands Hammerfall to Undercity, take the same flight with the library; pick up 1048 at Undercity Royal District Varimathras, level 33 is required; if you have picked up at the library, keep the quest and bring the The Scarlet Crusade key. From Undercity take Tirisfal Glades North Road to the monastery.
05-副本.md:609｜標籤｜接取錨點 03-第16站｜Pick up anchor point 03-Stop 16
05-副本.md:611｜副本入口｜由大堂朝四門看，右數第二道鎖門；座標是室外修道院入口，進大堂後依門序找實際傳送門。｜Looking from the lobby towards the four doors, you will see the second locked door from the right; the coordinate is the entrance to the outdoor monastery. After entering the lobby, follow the door sequence to find the actual portal.
05-副本.md:615｜交通步驟｜在幽暗城確認 1048 已接，若未接依圖書館段補接。｜Check for 1048 in Undercity. If missing, see the Library section for the pickup.
05-副本.md:619｜交通步驟｜擊殺勇士赫洛德，記入深入血色修道院 1048；旋風時近戰拉開。｜Kill Herod for Into The Scarlet Monastery (1048). Melee should back out during Whirlwind.
05-副本.md:623｜交通步驟｜深入血色修道院先留著，接著打大教堂；四名首領都完成才回幽暗城交。｜Keep Into The Scarlet Monastery for Cathedral. Turn it in at Undercity after all four bosses.
05-副本.md:623｜步驟說明｜軍械庫後保留，繼續大教堂。｜After the Armory remains, continue to the Cathedral.
05-副本.md:625｜站內取捨｜已有鑰匙的隊伍可直接清軍械庫。｜Teams that already have the key can clear the armory directly.
05-副本.md:626｜站內說明｜帶血色十字軍鑰匙，或請隊友中開鎖技能達 １７５ 點的盜賊開門。｜Bring the The Scarlet Crusade key, or ask a thief with a lockpicking skill of 175 points among teammates to open the door.
05-副本.md:629｜副本動線｜穿過噴泉庭院上階梯→正殿打莫格萊尼→懷特邁恩復活莫格萊尼→擊敗兩人。｜Cross the fountain courtyard and go up the steps → kill Mograine in the Cathedral → wait for Whitemane to resurrect him → kill both.
05-副本.md:632｜副本入口｜提里斯法林地 1420 85.20, 32.10｜Tirisfal Glades 1420 85.20, 32.10
05-副本.md:640｜站內前置接取路線｜由阿拉希高地 落錘鎮飛幽暗城，滿 35 可和圖書館、軍械庫一起打。前往希爾斯布萊德丘陵途中，經過幽暗城時可先看皇家區瓦里瑪薩斯，33 級才接 1048；若尚未滿 35 級，可在回東部王國去奧特蘭克山脈時一起打。帶血色十字軍鑰匙與圖書館、軍械庫的擊殺進度。｜From Arathi Highlands Hammerfall to fly Undercity, it can be played together with the library and armory when it reaches 35. en route to Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills, when passing Undercity, first look at the royal area Varimathras, and then go to 1048 after level 33; Below level 35, play it together when you return to Eastern Kingdoms and go to Alterac Mountains. Kill progress with The Scarlet Crusade key and library and armory.
05-副本.md:640｜標籤｜接取錨點 03-第16站｜Pick up anchor point 03-Stop 16
05-副本.md:642｜副本入口｜由大堂朝四門看，左數第二道鎖門；座標是室外修道院入口，進大堂後依門序找實際傳送門。｜Looking towards the four doors from the lobby, the second locked door from the left is located; the coordinate is the entrance to the outdoor monastery. After entering the lobby, follow the door sequence to find the actual portal.
05-副本.md:646｜交通步驟｜確認任務日誌有深入血色修道院 1048；接取詳見圖書館。｜Check that Into The Scarlet Monastery (1048) is in your log. See the Library section for the pickup.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟說明｜大教堂先清房間周圍；懷特邁恩會復活莫格萊尼。｜Clear the area around the cathedral room first; Whitemane will resurrect Mograine.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖可查大檢察官懷特邁恩；莫格萊尼 49.0,27.5（第 1 圖 49.10, 16.00）。｜Map 1: Whitemane (49.10, 16.00). Mograine: 49.0, 27.5.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟位置｜穿過噴泉庭院上階梯，進正殿打雙王。｜Cross the fountain courtyard and go up the steps. Kill both Cathedral bosses.
05-副本.md:650｜步驟順序｜莫格萊尼→懷特邁恩復活→雙王｜Mograine→Whitemane Resurrection→Double Kings
05-副本.md:654｜步驟說明｜四個首領都計入後回幽暗城皇家區。｜Return to the Undercity royal area after all four bosses are counted.
05-副本.md:656｜站內取捨｜若尚缺洛克希或赫洛德，先回相應分區，再一起回城。｜If Roxy or Herod is still missing, return to the partition first, and then return to the city together.
05-副本.md:657｜站內說明｜帶血色十字軍鑰匙，或請隊友中開鎖技能達 １７５ 點的盜賊開門。｜Bring the The Scarlet Crusade key, or ask a thief with a lockpicking skill of 175 points among teammates to open the door.
05-副本.md:660｜副本動線｜入口荊棘道沿路用地鼠找藍葉薯→走支路打魯古格→賈格巴→拉姆塔斯→蝙蝠洞收糞便→卡爾加小屋打王、拾心臟與任務物品→路清完再回尾王旁營帳，護送威利克斯到入口。｜Use the gopher for Blueleaf Tubers along the bramble path → Roogug on the side path → Jargba → Ramtusk → bat guano in the cave → Charlga's hut for her heart and quest loot → return to Willix's tent and escort him to the entrance.
05-副本.md:663｜副本入口｜貧瘠之地 1413 約 42.30, 89.90（荊棘通道的副本門附近）｜The Barrens 1413 about 42.30, 89.90 (near the copy door in the Thorn Passage)
05-副本.md:671｜站內前置接取路線｜前往千針石林時可順路進本。在貧瘠之地 棘齒城可先接 1221 並拿地鼠工具；前往希爾斯布萊德丘陵途中，經過幽暗城時找法拉尼爾接 1109；進本前若經雷霆崖找奧爾德接 1102。可從千針石林 亂風崗出發，經大升降梯回貧瘠之地，走西側荊棘路進本。｜Drop by this book on your way to Thousand Needles. In The Barrens Ratchet, first pick up 1221 and get the gopher tool; en route to Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills, when passing Undercity, ask for Faranir to pick up 1109; before entering this place, if you go through Thunder Bluff, talk to Alder to pick up 1102. start from Thousand Needles Freewind Post, return to The Barrens via The Great Lift, and take the thorny road on the west side to enter.
05-副本.md:671｜標籤｜接取錨點 03-第17站｜Pick up anchor point 03-Stop 17

05-副本.md:691｜步驟位置｜入口前段找魯古格支路，先清他身旁小怪。｜Take the early side path to Roogug. Clear his adds first.

05-副本.md:710｜站內取捨｜想接狂熱之心與剃刀高地後續，尾王及前廳蝙蝠都要打；只有短時間可先做沿路地鼠或護送。｜If you want to follow up with Hearts of Zeal and Razorfen Downs, fight the final boss and front hall bat; only for a short time, first be a gopher or escort en route.
05-副本.md:711｜站內說明｜大升降梯西側是剃刀沼澤；東側是剃刀高地。42.30, 89.90 為永恆版客戶端的門口標記。從大路沿西側荊棘隧道找傳送門。｜On the west side of the large The Great Lift is Razorfen Kraul; on the east side is Razorfen Downs. 42.30, 89.90 are the door markers for the WoW Forever client. Find the portal from the thorn tunnel on the west side of the road.
05-副本.md:714｜副本動線｜入本左轉下坡到清潔區→右側宿舍護送克努比→電刑器→群體打擊者→瑟瑪普拉格，拾密碼開保險箱。打到髒戒指後回清潔區用超級清潔器。｜Go left and downhill to the Clean Zone → escort Kernobee from the quarters on the right → Electrocutioner 6000 → Crowd Pummeler 9-60 → Thermaplugg, then use his code on the safe. Use the Sparklematic in the Clean Zone if you loot a Grime-Encrusted Ring.
05-副本.md:717｜副本入口｜荊棘谷 1434 27.60, 77.48｜Stranglethorn Vale 1434 27.60, 77.48
05-副本.md:717｜步驟說明｜部落入場用藏寶海灣傳送器，座標為斯庫提工作區。｜Horde enter via the Booty Bay teleporter. The pin marks Scooty's workshop.
05-副本.md:725｜站內前置接取路線｜前往荊棘谷 藏寶海灣前，在奧格瑪 榮譽谷先找索維克和諾格。從棘齒城坐船到藏寶海灣，或格羅姆高飛藏寶海灣；斯庫提完成 2842→2843 後，保留哥布林轉發器進入。｜Before Stranglethorn Vale Booty Bay, first look for Sovik and Nogg in the Orgrimmar Honor Valley. Take a boat from Ratchet to Booty Bay, or fly Grom to Booty Bay; after completing 2842→2843 in Scooty, keep the goblin transponder to enter.

05-副本.md:755｜站內取捨｜裝備或任務經驗值得時再打；和藏寶海灣任務一起交最省路。｜Fight again when the equipment or quest experience is worth it; it is the easiest to submit it together with the Booty Bay quest.
05-副本.md:756｜站內說明｜傳送到丹莫洛的設施後，循地下走道到實例門；不走鐵爐堡。若未解斯庫提，先完成傳送鏈。｜After teleporting to the facility at Dun Morogh, follow the underground corridor to the instance door; do not take Ironforge. If Scooty is not solved yet, complete the transmission chain first.
05-副本.md:759｜副本動線｜祖爾阿萊→伐塔卡→懼湧船長→不滅之髓→聖蛇米洛斯。沿途在入口水池左側、伐塔卡左側、船區頭骨嘴裡和米洛斯身後拓印石板；船區同時清海盜並收神器。原初元素與基爾可選。｜Zul'Alai → Var'Taka → Captain Dreadrise → Deathless Marrow → Min'loth the Serpent. Make rubbings left of the entrance pool, left of Var'Taka, in the skull by the ships and behind Min'loth. Loot artifacts from the pirates. Primeval Elemental and Gill are optional.
05-副本.md:762｜副本入口｜荊棘谷 1434 21.50, 27.70｜Stranglethorn Vale 1434 21.50, 27.70
05-副本.md:769｜站內前置接取路線｜荊棘谷第一次已排進主線：格羅姆高接 629 先做暗礁海、交後接 95748；藏寶海灣找克拉茲克接 95789、95791；祖昆達拓印 95748；回格羅姆高接 95770、95773 在西岸一起做完，交後接 95775、95776。若已開雷霆崖飛行點，進本前可飛雷霆崖，沿莫高雷道路去天空觀測高臺找瑪庫可。接齊後回格羅姆高，自西岸下水游到水下傳送門。｜Stranglethorn Vale has been queued into the main line for the first time: Grom Gao takes 629, do The Vile Reef first, and then take 95748; Booty Bay looks for Krazek and takes 95789, 95791; Zukunda rubs 95748; returns to Grom Gao and takes 95770, 95773 Finish it together on the West Coast and pick up 95775 and 95776 after handover. If you have opened the Thunder Bluff flight path, fly Thunder Bluff before entering, and follow the Mulgore road to the sky observation platform to find Mazu'kon. After collecting them, return to Grom'gol and swim from the west bank to the underwater portal.

05-副本.md:813｜站內取捨｜格羅姆高的兩條前置先做，避免游一趟只解船區；莫高雷單一交件太遠時可略。｜The two front lines of Gromgao are done first to avoid a trip to the unloading area; Mulgore optional when a single delivery is too far.
05-副本.md:814｜站內說明｜實例門在格羅姆高以西的水下洞窟。DungeonsForever 點 21.50, 27.70 與實地攻略的約 21.4, 27.9 相符；22.40, 27.18 是 95770 探查點。帶水下呼吸藥劑，或請有技能的隊友施放。｜The instance door is in the underwater caves west of Grom'gol. DungeonsForever points 21.50, 27.70 match the field guide's approximately 21.4, 27.9; 22.40, 27.18 are 95770 exploration points. Bring underwater breathing potion, or ask teammates with skills to cast it.
05-副本.md:817｜副本動線｜入口清到火眼莫德雷斯附近牢房→和貝尼斯特拉茲交換誓言石，再護送他封印神像，途中可能遇見腐爛的普雷莫→沿螺旋坡打亞門納爾，同區找寒冰使者之眼。｜Clear to Belnistrasz's cell near Mordresh Fire Eye → turn in the oathstone and escort him to the idol, with Plaguemaw the Rotting if encountered → take the spiral ramp to Amnennar and look for the Coldbringer's Eye nearby.
05-副本.md:820｜副本入口｜貧瘠之地 1413 約 49.10, 93.40（荊棘通道深處的副本門）｜The Barrens 1413 about 49.10, 93.40 (dungeon door deep in the thorn passage)
05-副本.md:828｜站內前置接取路線｜離開阿拉希高地 落錘鎮時先飛幽暗城。千針石林 閃光平原可先打剃刀沼澤並拾 6522。奧特蘭克山脈至阿拉希高地 落錘鎮經幽暗城時先交瓦里瑪薩斯，再同城找安德魯接 3341。由提里斯法坐飛艇回奧格瑪、飛雷霆崖，往莫高雷西北找蘇塔菈接 97196；飛陶拉祖往南，門外找麥雷姆。若從東部王國的火線港轉場，可搭船到熱砂港後北上千針石林。｜Fly Undercity first when leaving Arathi Highlands Hammerfall. Thousand Needles The Shimmering Flats type Razorfen Kraul first and pick up 6522. Alterac Mountains to Arathi Highlands Hammerfall When passing Undercity, first hand over Varimathras, and then find Andrew in the same city to pick up 3341. Take the zeppelin from Tirisfal back to Orgrimmar, fly to Thunder Bluff, go to the northwest of Mulgore to find Sutara and pick up 97196; fly to Taolajo to the south, and find Merem outside the door. If you transfer from Eastern Kingdoms to Powderfuse Port, take a boat to Steamwheedle Port and then go north to Thousand Needles.

05-副本.md:859｜站內說明｜五人隊，無鑰匙。門口在大升降梯北側的東路，與西側剃刀沼澤不同。若已轉入大河林地，可在火線港搭船到熱砂港後再北上。｜Team of Five, Keyless. The entrance is on the east road on the north side of The Great Lift, which is different from Razorfen Kraul on the west side. If you have transferred to Riverglades, take a boat from Powderfuse Port to Steamwheedle Port and then go north.
05-副本.md:860｜站內提醒｜五人隊，無鑰匙。門口在大升降梯北側的東路，與西側剃刀沼澤不同。若已轉入大河林地，可在火線港搭船到熱砂港後再北上。｜Team of Five, Keyless. The entrance is on the east road on the north side of The Great Lift, which is different from Razorfen Kraul on the west side. If you have transferred to Riverglades, take a boat from Powderfuse Port to Steamwheedle Port and then go north.
05-副本.md:864｜副本動線｜正門→雷夫洛什→找遺體取日記，先回卡加斯翻譯再回本。可從後門直接去黑曜石哨兵。【僅法師】第二挖掘場→加加恩→格瑞姆洛克→阿札達斯→查諾甘農圓盤。｜Main entrance → Revelosh → loot the journal from the remains. Return to Kargath for the translation before the next run. Mages can reach the Obsidian Sentinel from the back door. Second dig site → Galgann → Grimlok → Archaedas → Discs of Norgannon.

05-副本.md:875｜站內前置接取路線｜荒蕪之地 卡加斯走奧達曼；奧特蘭克山脈、阿拉希高地 落錘鎮到幽暗城先接派翠克的 2342。由落錘鎮或格羅姆高飛荒蕪之地 卡加斯，接加卡爾 2258→2202，再找里格弗茲與塞爾杜林。滿 35 級可在塵泥沼澤先做塔貝薩的前置【僅法師】。想做項鏈時，第一趟先打到破碎項鏈，可趁往返奧格瑪時交德蘭，第二趟再從卡加斯進副本。｜Badlands Kargath goes to Uldaman; Alterac Mountains, Arathi Highlands Hammerfall to Undercity first connects to Patrick’s 2342. From Hammerfall or Grom Goofy Badlands Kargath, go to Jarkal Mossmeld 2258→2202, then find Rigglefuzz and Seldulin. If you reach level 35, do Tabetha first in Dustwallow Marsh [Mage only]. When you want to make a necklace, get the Broken Necklace on the first trip. hand it to Delan while traveling to and from Orgrimmar, and then get the dungeon from Kargath on the second trip.

05-副本.md:938｜站內取捨｜優先順手接 2202、2342、2418，達 40 可取圓盤並拿背包。項鏈要來回兩趟以上，想快速練級時可略。｜Give priority to picking up 2202, 2342, and 2418. When you reach 40, get the disc and the backpack. The necklace requires more than two trips, so skip it if you want to level up quickly.
05-副本.md:939｜站內說明｜五人隊。34 級先接幽暗城 2342，荒蕪之地順路再做外洞；清尾王建議 42 級。正門適合全清與項鏈，後門適合只打後半。要做法師任務可從後門走【僅法師】。部分資料只標地面洞口，找門時沿洞內主道。｜Team of five. At level 34, pick up Undercity 2342 first, then Badlands en route and then make the outer cave; King Qingwei recommends level 42. The front door is suitable for full cleaning and necklaces, and the back door is suitable for only the second half. To do the mage quest, go through the back door [Mage only]. Some information only marks the entrance of the hole on the ground. When looking for the door, follow the main road inside the cave.
05-副本.md:939｜標籤｜僅法師｜Mage only

05-副本.md:944｜副本動線｜礦道打葛羅克斯→暮光指揮官扎爾莫克→阿什卡旁鐵匠鋪找鑄模→納古克取暮光寶典→橋頭圖夫→霸主馬戈取馬戈之眼。全程沿途收暮光教徒耳朵。｜Mine: Slavecrusher Grox → Twilight Commander Zarmok → moulding in Ashka's smithy → Nar'gurk for Tome of Twilight → Bossman Toof at the bridge → Overlord Mugg for Eye of Mugg. Loot cultist ears throughout.
05-副本.md:947｜副本入口｜大河林地 2548 48.60, 26.30｜Riverglades 2548 48.60, 26.30
05-副本.md:953｜站內前置接取路線｜到大河林地羅格瑪先做特朗古爾的 Sunnyglade 與棒趾鏈，跑博德羅克的鈍拳前置；之後從羅格瑪往西進暮光營地找達羅許和 Crag’rog，回羅格瑪交書信再接眼與寶典。飛羅格瑪或從卡加斯步行進河林，往 Sunnyglade 正北的高地找門。厚皮 ×4、鐵錠 ×12 可先備給模具後續。｜Go to Riverglades Rog'mar, first make the Sunnyglade and Clubtoe chains of Tran'gul, run the Clugfist frontend of Bolder'ok; then go west from Rog'mar to Twilight Base Camp to find Da'grosh and Crag’rog, and return Rog'mar Hand in the letter and then receive the eye and the book. Fly Rog'mar or walk from Kargath into the river forest and look for the door at The Uplands due north of Sunnyglade. Thick Leather ×4 and Iron Bar ×12 can be prepared for molding later.

05-副本.md:1039｜站內取捨｜先完成 大河林地羅格瑪、大河林地博德羅克與火線港前置再組隊，可同趟完成三項。鑄模材料可預備，有打到再交。｜Complete the prerequisites of Riverglades Rog'mar, Riverglades Bolder'ok and Powderfuse Port first and then form a team. complete all three in the same trip. The molding materials can be prepared and handed over when they are ready.
05-副本.md:1040｜站內說明｜入口在 Sunnyglade 正北，城門旁另有要塞傳送門。採用本機 DungeonsForever 入口點；Wowhead 河林概覽的早期標記與此不同。94800 系列等聯盟任務不列入部落路線。｜The entrance is directly north of Sunnyglade, and there is a fortress portal next to the city gate. Features a native DungeonsForever entry point; earlier markup of the Wowhead River Forest Overview differs from this. Alliance quests such as the 94800 series are not included in the Horde route.
05-副本.md:1043｜副本動線｜橙線打諾克賽恩、銳刺鞭笞者，紫線打維利塔恩；沿路收塑像、可汗寶石和任務材料→兩線掉落齊了到匯合點找塞雷布拉斯，跟完節杖儀式→地歌瀑布→公主→洛特格里普水池（選做）。｜Orange: Noxxion and Razorlash. Purple: Lord Vyletongue. Collect statues, khan gems and other quest loot → Celebras at the junction, then follow his scepter ritual → Earth Song Falls → the Princess → Rotgrip's pool if needed.
05-副本.md:1046｜副本入口｜淒涼之地 1443 29.10, 62.50｜Desolace 1443 29.10, 62.50
05-副本.md:1054｜站內前置接取路線｜前往淒涼之地 葬影村前，可從奧格瑪尤塞爾奈接暗影殘片，但最低 39 級。離開菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地後往淒涼之地 葬影村，先找瓦克與瑟琳德拉，再繞維洛、半人馬賤民。想做永恆版水瓶支線先到東南辛德拉，完成水晶塔與魔導師引導後到遺忘花園接 93594→93404。辛德拉任務的最低 35 級由 Wowhead 永恆版補足。進瑪拉頓橙門之前接凱雯德拉。｜Before Desolace Shadowprey Village, pick up Shadowshard Fragments from Orgrimmar Uthel'nay, but the minimum level is 39. Leave Feralas Camp Mojache and go to Desolace Shadowprey Village. First find Wacker and Selendra, then go around Willow and Centaur Pariah. If you want to do the eternal version of the Aquarius branch, first go to Southeast Sindra. After completing the Crystal Tower and the Magister's Guide, go to the Forgotten Garden to pick up 93594→93404. The Min. level 35 for Syndra Quest is topped up by Wowhead WoW Forever. Enter Maraudon and take Cavindra before entering the orange door.

05-副本.md:1088｜交通步驟｜橙線（Foulspore Cavern，45–53）。進洞深處看橙色水晶和池塘，先裝水再穿橙色傳送門。｜Orange side: Foulspore Cavern (45–53). Look for orange crystals and the pool deep in the cave. Fill the vial before entering the portal.
05-副本.md:1089｜步驟位置｜橙門外水池裝水，進門後沿路找藤蔓。｜Fill the vial at the pool outside the orange portal. Find vines inside.
05-副本.md:1090｜交通步驟｜紫線（Wicked Grotto，45–53）。由三岔處走紫色水晶通道；取得維利塔恩掉落的鑽石。｜Purple side: Wicked Grotto (45–53). Take the purple crystal passage at the three-way fork. Loot the diamond from Lord Vyletongue.
05-副本.md:1091｜步驟說明｜本機 QuestieDB 任務文字為 15；舊攻略可能列 25，以日誌為準。｜QuestieDB says 15; older guides may list 25. Follow your quest log.

05-副本.md:1092｜步驟說明｜第一位在橙紫兩線之間；第二與第三位分別在門外通道；第四、第五位在橙、紫門內，各巡邏。｜Three khans patrol by the fork and outer tunnels. One is inside each portal.
05-副本.md:1092｜步驟位置｜橙紫分岔與兩外洞找前三人，兩門內各一人。｜Find three khans at the fork and outer caves, then one inside each portal.

05-副本.md:1115｜站內取捨｜首次想拿節杖就走橙、紫兩線，若只打公主與鱷魚，隊友有節杖可直接進內區。任務若需門外暗影怪或不同分支，不要從捷徑跳過。｜If you want to get the scepter for the first time, go to the orange and purple lines. If you only play the princess and the crocodile, your teammates can go directly into the inner zone if they have the scepter. If a quest requires a shadow monster outside the door or a different branch, don't skip the shortcut.
05-副本.md:1116｜站內說明｜29.10, 62.50 是荒野洞口，橙與紫兩道實例門要沿對應顏色洞道尋找；實例門單獨的世界座標 ?。紫線與橙線在毒水瀑布附近會合。｜29.10 and 62.50 are the wilderness cave entrances. The orange and purple instance doors must be found along the color caves; the individual world coordinates of the instance doors are?. The purple and orange lines meet near Poison Water Falls.
05-副本.md:1119｜副本動線｜安圖蘇爾支路→塞卡甲蟲房順取第一塊摩沙魯石板→祖穆拉恩墓地→金字塔階梯事件→水占師維蕾薩取第二塊摩沙魯石板和探水棒（水池可選召加茲瑞拉）→烏克茲。沿路收聖甲蟲殼和食人妖調和劑。｜Antu'sul's side path → Theka for the first Mosh'aru Tablet → Zum'rah's graveyard → pyramid stairs event for the Divino-matic Rod → Velratha for the second tablet → optional Gahz'rilla at the pool → Chief Ukorz. Loot scarab shells and Troll Temper throughout.
05-副本.md:1122｜副本入口｜塔納利斯 1446 38.70, 20.00｜Tanaris 1446 38.70, 20.00
05-副本.md:1130｜站內前置接取路線｜先到塔納利斯 加基森接三個本地任務，再到熱砂港接葉基亞 3520；在菲拉斯捉靈魂，回塔納利斯先到熱砂港交 3520、接 3527，再和隊伍於加基森會合。走過千針石林的閃光平原時可接 2770，前往悲傷沼澤前可繞塵泥沼澤解塔貝薩支線【僅法師】。｜First go to Tanaris Gadgetzan to pick up three local quests, then go to Steamwheedle Port to pick up Yeh'kinya 3520; catch the soul at Feralas, return to Tanaris first go to Steamwheedle Port to hand in 3520, pick up 3527, and then join the team at Gadgetzan Rendezvous. When passing through The Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles, pick up 2770. before Swamp of Sorrows, go around Dustwallow Marsh to solve the Tabetha side quest [Mage only].

05-副本.md:1163｜站內取捨｜優先加基森三任與摩沙魯石板；已有木槌再打加茲瑞拉；塔貝薩留給會經塵泥沼澤的角色。｜Priority will be given to Gadgetzan San Ren and Mosaru Slate; if you already have a mallet, hit Gahz'rilla; Tabetha will be reserved for the characters who will go through Dustwallow Marsh.
05-副本.md:1164｜站內說明｜可在塔納利斯 熱砂港與加基森先刷一次；走完整葉基亞前置才建議塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地刷。摩沙魯石板亦為哈卡鏈前置。｜Brush Tanaris Steamwheedle Port and Gadgetzan first; brush Tanaris Gadgetzan and Dunemaul Compound after completing Yeh'kinya. Mosaru Slate is also Hakkar chain front.
05-副本.md:1168｜副本動線｜入口上層牢房找弗卡爾→打典獄長監督者瑞克斯取鑰匙→清審問者和海潮主母並收頭巾→開下層牢門打『清潔者』卡特莉娜與燃吼→在尾王身後密室查看紙條，再回上層牢房找弗卡爾。｜Find Commander Folkar in the upper cells → kill Overseer Wrex for the key → clear The Questioner and Tidemistress Ca'zass, looting bandanas → open the lower cells for Katerina the Cleaner and Blazeroar → read the note in the hidden room and return to Folkar upstairs.
05-副本.md:1171｜副本入口｜塵泥沼澤 1445 75.30, 14.10｜Dustwallow Marsh 1445 75.30, 14.10
05-副本.md:1180｜站內前置接取路線｜前往悲傷沼澤時，未到 48 級可先開塵泥沼澤 蕨牆村飛行點。前往灼熱峽谷前，在奧格瑞瑪智慧谷索爾的大廳向伊崔格接 95283（1454 34.28, 39.35），再飛蕨牆村找納澤爾·血矛。沿東北海岸游往奧卡茲島，在島側軍士處依序交 95284、95285，拿 95309 再進島塔地下。留下 95483 至下次奧格瑞瑪。｜When going to Swamp of Sorrows, open Dustwallow Marsh Brackenwall Village flight points before reaching level 48. Before heading to Searing Gorge, take 95283 (1454 34.28, 39.35) to Eitrigg in the lobby of Orgrimmar Wisdom Valley Thrall, then fly Brackenwall Village to find Nazeer Bloodpike. Swim along the northeastern coast to Alcaz Island, turn in 95284 and 95285 at the sergeant's office on the island side, take 95309 and go underground in the island tower. Leave 95483 until next time Orgrimmar.

05-副本.md:1219｜站內說明｜部落可避開塞拉摩；由蕨牆村到東北海岸後游泳。軍士在島側，副本門位於島塔地下走廊。｜The Horde can avoid Theramore; swim to the northeastern coast via Brackenwall Village. The sergeant is on the island side, and the dungeon door is in the underground corridor of the island tower.
05-副本.md:1223｜副本動線｜入口右側平路→下層環廊查祭壇並點雕像→阿塔拉利恩→上層六座陽台清守衛→獻祭之穴東廊打迦瑪蘭→西廊可選召哈卡→四龍獸→伊蘭尼庫斯與精華之泉。沿途打阿塔萊食人妖收神像。｜Take the right entrance path to the lower ring → check the altar, activate the statues and kill Atal'alarion → clear the six upper balconies → east from the Pit of Sacrifice for Jammal'an → optional Hakkar event west → four dragonkin → Eranikus and the Essence Font. Loot idols from Atal'ai trolls throughout.
05-副本.md:1226｜副本入口｜悲傷沼澤 1435 69.50, 52.50（神廟建築外部路標）｜Swamp of Sorrows 1435 69.50, 52.50 (road sign outside the temple building)
05-副本.md:1234｜站內前置接取路線｜到悲傷沼澤 斯通納德完成 1424 並保留 1429；從辛特蘭 惡齒村飛行點走到辛特蘭南側流放者交 1429、接 1444 與 1446，若完成祖爾法拉克石板鏈再去辛薩羅拿卵。菲拉斯先接 3380；塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地先到瑪爾馮開石環任務，飛棘齒城取物，再回瑪爾馮接兩個神廟任務。在塔納利斯 熱砂港交卵後，可從加基森飛棘齒城，再搭船到藏寶海灣，飛斯通納德交 1444、接 1445 並赴神廟。｜Go to Swamp of Sorrows Stonard to complete 1424 and keep 1429; from The Hinterlands Revantusk Village flight path to The Hinterlands south side exile handover 1429, pick up 1444 and 1446, if complete Zul'Farrak slate chain then go Jintha'Alor Get eggs. Feralas first pick up 3380; Tanaris Gadgetzan and Dunemaul Compound first go to Malvon to open the stone ring quest, fly Ratchet to pick up the items, and then return to Malvon to pick up the two temple quests. After spawning Tanaris Steamwheedle Port, fly from Gadgetzan to Ratchet, then take a boat to Booty Bay, fly Stonard to hand over 1444, pick up 1445 and go to the temple.

05-副本.md:1287｜站內取捨｜斯通納德與辛特蘭本地鏈優先；摩沙魯鏈適合已刷祖爾法拉克並到辛薩羅的人；石環在塔納利斯 加基森與砂槌營地安排棘齒城一趟。｜Stonard and The Hinterlands local chains are given priority; Mosalu chain is suitable for people who have brushed Zul'Farrak and went to Jintha'Alor; Shihuan arranges a trip to Ratchet at Tanaris, Gadgetzan and Dunemaul Compound.
05-副本.md:1288｜站內說明｜座標指向淚水之池建築外。沿南側階梯進神廟，經面具之廳及儀式之廳到骸骨之廳中層的副本門。｜The coordinates point outside the building Pool of Tears. Enter the temple along the stairs on the south side, pass through the Hall of Masks and the Hall of Ceremonies to the dungeon door on the middle floor of the Hall of Bones.
05-副本.md:1292｜副本動線｜入口外可先打征服者派隆→監獄與競技場外廊清鐵怒矮人→黑鐵砧打伊森迪奧斯→工藝大廳打弗諾斯、到紀念碑換影爐鑰匙→寶庫取山脈之心、黑鐵酒吧打雷布裏和取秘方，順路可互換→過七賢與熔岩橋，到熔火之心門旁拾核心碎片。沿途打元素怪與魔像。｜Optional Pyron outside → Ironfury dwarves in the Detention Block and Ring of Law → Incendius at the Black Anvil → Fineous in the Hall of Crafting and the monument for the Shadowforge Key → Heart in the vault and Ribbly and the recipe in the Grim Guzzler, in either order → pass the Seven and the lava bridge for the Core Fragment. Loot elementals and golems throughout.
05-副本.md:1295｜副本入口｜灼熱峽谷 1427 34.80, 85.30（黑石山外部路標）｜Searing Gorge 1427 34.80, 85.30 (Blackrock Mountain external road mark)
05-副本.md:1303｜站內前置接取路線｜在灼熱峽谷 瑟銀哨塔開點，去燃燒平原 烈焰峰時先找尤卡與麥克斯沃特。飛卡加斯接桑德哈特、通緝板與薇薇安，進黑石山殺門外派隆後回卡加斯交 3906，接 3907、7201；再由瑟銀哨塔或烈焰峰進山。｜Open at Searing Gorge Thorium Point and go to Burning Steppes Flame Crest first to find Yuka and Maxwater. Fly Kargath to pick up boards Thunderheart, WANTED and Vivian, enter Blackrock Mountain, kill Pailong outside the gate, return to Kargath, turn in 3906, pick up 3907, 7201; then enter the mountain via Thorium Point or Flame Crest.

05-副本.md:1345｜站內說明｜北側入口通往黑石山，內部沿中央鎖鏈下行，穿過磨石場及派隆後找到實際副本門。也可由燃燒平原 1428 29.40, 38.30 進山。｜The north entrance leads to Blackrock Mountain. Go down the central chain inside and pass through the grindstone and Pylon to find the actual copy door. also enter the mountain via Burning Steppes 1428 29.40, 38.30.
05-副本.md:1349｜副本動線｜下層入口→歐莫克→沃什加斯→斜坡下找比修和裝置→沃恩→蛛網區清卵與煙網蛛后→哈雷肯與基茲魯爾→維姆薩拉克。歐莫克、沃恩與維姆薩拉克的寶鑽一路收齊。｜Lower entrance → Omokk → Vosh'gajin → Bijou and her belongings down the ramp → Voone → eggs and Mother Smolderweb → Halycon and Gizrul → Wyrmthalak. Loot the gems from Omokk, Voone and Wyrmthalak.
05-副本.md:1352｜副本入口｜灼熱峽谷 1427 34.80, 85.30（黑石山外部路標）｜Searing Gorge 1427 34.80, 85.30 (Blackrock Mountain external road mark)
05-副本.md:1360｜站內前置接取路線｜在燃燒平原 烈焰峰先開飛行點，55 級後回烈焰峰找基布雷爾接兩件。到冬泉谷 永望鎮找基爾拉姆，跨海回東部王國後飛卡加斯向高圖斯、賈拉瑪弗、雷克斯洛特接任。走灼熱峽谷或烈焰峰到黑石山東側上層陽台入共同傳送門；回卡加斯交 4903，接 4941 並保留。｜In Burning Steppes Flame Crest, unlock the flight path first. After level 55, return to Flame Crest and find Kibler to pick up two pieces. Go to Winterspring Everlook to find Kilram, cross the sea and return to Eastern Kingdoms, then fly Kargath to Gautus, Jaramafo, and Lexlort to take over. Take Searing Gorge or Flame Crest to the upper balcony on the east side of Blackrock Mountain and enter the common teleportation door; return to Kargath and turn in 4903, pick up 4941 and keep it.

05-副本.md:1381｜步驟位置｜過歐莫克後走通道，找暗影獵手沃什加斯｜Pass Omokk and follow the tunnel to Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin.
05-副本.md:1381｜步驟順序｜先打沃什加斯，再沿其房間斜坡找比修｜Fight Washgarth first, then follow the ramp in its room to find Bijou
05-副本.md:1382｜步驟說明｜先告訴隊伍留一隻幼狼，避免被範圍攻擊擊殺。｜First tell the team to keep a young wolf to avoid being killed by range attacks.
05-副本.md:1382｜步驟位置｜過蜘蛛區與食人妖岔道，進狼房抓幼狼｜Past the spiders and troll fork, enter the wolf room and cage a pup.
05-副本.md:1383｜步驟位置｜蜘蛛區後岔路往右，沿路進左側狼巢｜Go right at the fork after the spiders. Take the left side into the wolf den.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟說明｜文件位置會變，遇到前三房先找。｜The file location will change. Find the first three rooms when you encounter them.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 35.10, 55.30、52.50, 54.90、57.80, 60.50。依序為歐莫克、沃恩、維姆薩拉克。文件若出現在不同首領房間，逐間查看。｜Map: Omokk 35.10,55.30; Voone 52.50,54.90; Wyrmthalak 57.80,60.50. Check each room.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟位置｜沿三王線逐房找文件，也查看烏洛克貢品堆｜Check each of the three bosses' rooms and Urok's tribute pile for the documents.
05-副本.md:1384｜步驟順序｜歐莫克→沃恩→維姆薩拉克｜Ormoc → Vaughn → Vimsa Rarc

05-副本.md:1402｜站內取捨｜優先三王文件、座狼、卵與比修；隊伍已有能開上層的人就可略過印章鏈。｜Prioritize the three king files, Worg, egg and Bijou; if the team already has someone who can open the upper level, they can skip the seal chain.
05-副本.md:1403｜站內說明｜開服後下層可進。黑石山外部路標另可用燃燒平原 1428 29.40, 38.30；進山後沿上行路到東側高台，進門後往右下走。｜Enter the lower level after opening the server. Blackrock Mountain External road signs are also available Burning Steppes 1428 29.40, 38.30; after entering the mountain, follow the upward path to the east high platform, enter the door and go down to the right.
05-副本.md:1407｜副本動線｜正門→市場菸草店→進血色堡壘，威利支線可略→檔案管理員加爾福特的房間同時取資料與燒檔案→需要全清再打巴納札爾。｜Main gate → tobacco shop in Market Row → Scarlet Bastion. Skip Cannon Master Willey if desired. In Archivist Galford's room, retrieve the painting and burn the records. Kill Balnazzar for a full clear.
05-副本.md:1410｜副本入口｜東瘟疫之地 1423 約 27.10, 10.70（正門傳送門）｜Eastern Plaguelands 1423 About 27.10, 10.70 (main entrance portal)
05-副本.md:1418｜站內前置接取路線｜先在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂找公爵和煙鬼。沿瘟疫之地大道往西北，走正門；要做提里恩的畫，先在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂完成狩獵，接續跑南部墓穴、北谷，轉去西瘟疫凱爾達隆找畫家，再回東瘟疫。｜First find Duke and Smoker at Eastern Plaguelands Light's Hope Chapel. Go northwest along the Plaguelands Avenue and take the main entrance; to do Tirion's painting, first go to Eastern Plaguelands Light's Hope Chapel The Hunt Completed, then go to the southern tomb, Northdale, then go to the Western Plague Caer Darrow to find the painter, and then return to the Eastern Plague.

05-副本.md:1449｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 27.10, 75.10。檔案管理員座標，血色檔案位於同一間檔案室。｜DungeonsForever map: Archivist (27.10, 75.10). The records are in his room.
05-副本.md:1449｜步驟位置｜進血色堡壘檔案室，打加爾福特後燒檔案｜Kill Galford in the Scarlet Bastion archives, then burn the records.
05-副本.md:1450｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 27.10, 75.10。這是檔案室首領的位置，雙月畫在同一間，沒有獨立座標。｜Map: Archivist (27.10, 75.10). The painting is in the same room.
05-副本.md:1450｜步驟位置｜同一間血色檔案室，查牆上的雙月畫｜Check the painting of two moons on the wall of the Scarlet archives.
05-副本.md:1457｜站內取捨｜煙草和檔案任務兩件好接；已完成提里恩前半再加愛與家庭。想只跑一趟時先把前置接齊。｜Tobacco and archive quests are both easy to pick up; after completing the first half of Tirion, add Of Love and Family. If you want to run only one trip, connect all the front parts first.
05-副本.md:1458｜站內說明｜五人隊。血色要塞門請帶血色十字軍鑰匙。未滿 58 級時先接、到等級再組；可從地下側門進亡靈區。｜Team of five. Please bring the The Scarlet Crusade key to the Scarlet Fortress Gate. If you are under level 58, pick it up first and then group it together when you reach a higher level; enter the Undead Zone from the underground side door.
05-副本.md:1459｜站內提醒｜五人隊。血色要塞門請帶血色十字軍鑰匙。未滿 58 級時先接、到等級再組；可從地下側門進亡靈區。｜Team of five. Please bring the The Scarlet Crusade key to the Scarlet Fortress Gate. If you are under level 58, pick it up first and then group it together when you reach a higher level; enter the Undead Zone from the underground side door.
05-副本.md:1463｜副本動線｜側門先找小教堂的奧里克斯→打三座通靈塔的安娜絲塔麗、奈魯布恩坎和蒼白的瑪勒基，順查通靈塔資料→屠宰場拉姆斯登→打瑞文戴爾後與奧里克斯交談。沿路收肉塊、開木箱取聖水、解放幽靈居民。｜Service gate → Aurius in the chapel → Baroness Anastari, Nerub'enkan and Maleki in the three ziggurats. Check for the data → Ramstein in the Slaughterhouse → Baron Rivendare, then speak to Aurius. Loot flesh and Holy Water and free Spectral Citizens on the way.
05-副本.md:1466｜副本入口｜東瘟疫之地 1423 約 43.50, 19.40（亡靈區側門）｜Eastern Plaguelands 1423 about 43.50, 19.40 (side entrance of the undead area)
05-副本.md:1474｜站內前置接取路線｜先在東瘟疫之地 聖光之願禮拜堂找貝蒂娜、萊尼德與護理者奧林，西去恐懼谷找伊根後再進側門。從正門跑過的隊伍可把後續 5213 留這一趟。｜First go to Eastern Plaguelands Light's Hope Chapel to find Bettina, Lenid and Caretaker Alen, then go west to Terrordale to find Egan and then enter the side door. The team that ran through the main entrance can save the follow-up 5213 for this trip.

05-副本.md:1554｜副本動線｜西門→花園清水晶塔→特迪斯·扭木→上層找古靈接任務並清塔（卡雷迪斯、伊琳娜可選）→牢籠打伊莫塔爾→圖書館打托塞德林→回古靈交接，再返圖書館找寶藏與遺骸。｜West gate → clear the garden pylons → Tendris Warpwood → see the Ancient upstairs and clear the remaining pylons, with Kalendris and Illyanna optional → Immol'thar in the prison → Prince Tortheldrin in the Library. Turn in to the Ancient, then return to the Library for the chest and remains.

After flying to Moshache, go west along the avenue. The team will confirm Crescent Key first; if no one has it, go to the east area first.

05-副本.md:1589｜副本動線｜一般全清依序走莫爾達、克雷格、芬古斯、諾特旁的陷阱、克羅卡斯和戈多克大王。打貢品則保留沿途守衛，找諾特並處理陷阱，打完大王再回克雷格。職業書可另由入口庭院側門通圖書館。｜Full clear: Guard Mol'dar → Stomper Kreeg → Guard Fengus → trap by Knot → Captain Kromcrush → King Gordok. Tribute: leave guards alive, find Knot and fix the trap, then see Kreeg after killing the king. The courtyard side door leads to the Library for class books.

05-副本.md:1600｜站內前置接取路線｜在菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地整隊再往西；菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地可先準備材料。北區常用任務多在本內，先在東區取得月牙鑰匙，或者與有鑰匙的隊友同行。要交職業書可先從拍賣場備妥對應書。｜At Feralas Camp Mojache, form a team and head west; Feralas Camp Mojache can prepare materials first. Most of the common quests in the North District are in this book. Get Crescent Key in the East District first, or go with teammates who have the key. To submit a professional certificate, first prepare the certificate from the auction house.

05-副本.md:1647｜站內取捨｜練級以一趟能打完的隊伍優先；只為貢品而刻意等材料時，可先做主線。｜When leveling up, give priority to the team that can complete it in one trip; if you are deliberately waiting for materials just for tribute, do the main story first.
05-副本.md:1648｜站內說明｜貢品打法盡量保留守衛和克雷格，打倒戈多克大王後再對話。只想打普通全清，先和隊伍講清楚。｜Try to keep the guards and Craig as a tribute, and talk to them after defeating King Gordok. If you only want to play normal and clear, please make it clear to your team first.
05-副本.md:1649｜站內提醒｜貢品打法盡量保留守衛和克雷格，打倒戈多克大王後再對話。只想打普通全清，先和隊伍講清楚。｜Try to keep the guards and Craig as a tribute, and talk to them after defeating King Gordok. If you only want to play normal and clear, please make it clear to your team first.
05-副本.md:1654｜副本動線｜入口→泰坦遺跡沿途收四色水晶→在無色水晶旁一起處理水池目標。泰坦龍、Bolt、Vitrix、納納雅的完整擊殺順序待核。｜Entrance → collect four crystal colors through the titan ruins → handle the pool objectives by the Colorless Crystal. The full order for the titan dragon, Bolt, Vitrix and Nanaya remains unconfirmed.
05-副本.md:1654｜標籤｜需遊戲實測｜Needs in-game check

05-副本.md:1666｜站內前置接取路線｜前往月光林地途中，經雷霆崖時可先到莫高雷西北找 Mayena Earthseeker。回安戈洛環形山 馬紹爾營地後，沿北邊石階往上找泰坦建築；95928 以外兩件的接取者仍待確認。｜En route to Moonglade, when passing through Thunder Bluff, first go to the northwest of Mulgore to find Mayena Earthseeker. After returning to Un'Goro Crater Marshal's Refuge, go up the stone steps on the north side to find the Titan Building; the recipients of the two pieces other than 95928 are still to be confirmed.

05-副本.md:1685｜站內說明｜永恆版新增五人副本。由馬紹爾營地北側上坡，泰坦門前可用安戈洛採集的能量水晶。安戈洛約 48.10, 6.10 為泰坦建築的外側入口路標，副本傳送門精確點 ?。｜A new five-player dungeon has been added to the WoW Forever. Go uphill from the north side of Marshal's Refuge, and use Crystals of Power collected by Un'Goro in front of the Titan Gate. Un'Goro is about 48.10 and 6.10. It is the outer entrance sign of the Titan building. The exact point of the dungeon portal is?.

05-副本.md:1690｜副本動線｜入口橋→第一大廳取地契→召喚廳後取另一份→骨庫打血骨傀儡與瘟疫幼龍→萊斯·霜語房取地契→下層六室拿末份並清卡斯迪諾夫房→黑暗院長加丁。｜Entrance bridge → deed in the first hall → another past the summoning chamber → ossuary for Rattlegore and hatchlings → deed in Ras Frostwhisper's room → final deed and Krastinov downstairs → Darkmaster Gandling.
05-副本.md:1693｜副本入口｜西瘟疫之地 1422 約 68.90, 72.80（凱爾達隆地下入口）｜Western Plaguelands 1422 about 68.90, 72.80 (Caer Darrow underground entrance)
05-副本.md:1701｜站內前置接取路線｜在西瘟疫之地 亡靈壁壘可先接阿萊克斯 5341 與鑰匙前段；聖光之願禮拜堂接 5529。從亡靈壁壘沿南路上凱爾達隆島，先找艾瓦再進門。若要親自做鑰匙，在亡靈壁壘交骸骨碎片後接模具，去塔納利斯 加基森與安戈洛環形山 火羽山，最後回亡靈壁壘完成。｜In Western Plaguelands The Bulwark, first connect Alex 5341 and the front part of the key; Light's Hope Chapel connect 5529. From The Bulwark, follow the south road to Caer Darrow Island, look for Ava first and then enter the door. If you want to make the key yourself, go to The Bulwark to Skeletal Fragments and then connect the mold, go to Tanaris Gadgetzan and Un'Goro Crater Fire Plume Ridge, and finally return to The Bulwark to complete.

05-副本.md:1736｜步驟說明｜DungeonsForever 地城圖參考點 88.80, 45.50。卡斯迪諾夫教授。艾瓦與盧森遺骸在其房內，沒有獨立位置。｜Map: Krastinov (88.80, 45.50). Eva's and Lucien's remains are in the room.
05-副本.md:1736｜步驟位置｜進末段六室找卡斯迪諾夫，同房焚兩份遺骸｜Find Krastinov in the last six rooms. Burn both sets of remains in his room.
05-副本.md:1736｜步驟順序｜遺骸在同房｜Remains in the same room
05-副本.md:1739｜步驟說明｜艾瓦可接下一趟的恐懼之袋；練級首趟可以只交教授。｜Take The Bag of Horrors from Eva for next time. On a first run, just turn in.
05-副本.md:1743｜站內取捨｜四張地契、瘟疫幼龍和教授同趟收益高。鑰匙只要隊伍有人能開門，其他人可省整條材料鏈。｜Four land deeds, Plagued Hatchling and the professor’s trip together will bring high returns. As long as someone in the team can open the key, others can save the entire chain of materials.
05-副本.md:1744｜站內說明｜五人隊。帶鑰匙者先開外門。教授之後 5515、5384 要接續刷本，留給有同一隊伍的行程。｜Five players. Have the keyholder open the outer gate. Quests 5515 and 5384 after Krastinov require return runs; save them for a group that can stay.
05-副本.md:1745｜站內提醒｜五人隊。帶鑰匙者先開外門。教授之後 5515、5384 要接續刷本，留給有同一隊伍的行程。｜Five players. Have the keyholder open the outer gate. Quests 5515 and 5384 after Krastinov require return runs; save them for a group that can stay.
05-副本.md:1749｜副本動線｜入口熊怪通道沿路收黑喉袋子→地下根系區收諾達希爾根帽→枯萎之喉與骨鼻的岔路→血鬃長老取儀祭圖騰。分岔與打王順序待核。｜Loot Blackmaw Pouches in the entrance tunnels → gather Nordrassil Rootcaps underground → branches for Withermaw and Bonesnout the Unbroken → Elder Shaman Bloodmane for the ritual totem. Exact forks and boss order are unconfirmed.

05-副本.md:1760｜站內前置接取路線｜瓦羅莫克找傑迪加接 92346；同站可到奧汀克接 92069，滿 55 級再回艾薩拉找 Ekkal。經貧瘠之地 棘齒城回卡林多時先飛雷霆崖到長者高地交傑迪加的信、接 92343，並往莫高雷找穆倫·地怒。最後飛瓦羅莫克，由艾薩拉地道前往副本；留 92343、97198 到下次雷霆崖和莫高雷回程。｜At Valormok, go to Jediga and pick up 92346; at the same station, go to Ogtinc to pick up 92069. After reaching level 55, return to Azshara to find Ekkal. When returning to Kalimdor via The Barrens Ratchet, fly Thunder Bluff to Elder Rise, hand in the letter from Jediga, answer 92343, and go to Mulgore to find Mullen Earthfury. Finally, fly Valormok and go to the dungeon through the Azshara tunnel; leave 92343 and 97198 for the next return trip of Thunder Bluff and Mulgore.

05-副本.md:1784｜步驟說明｜QuestieDB 記錄莫高雷穆倫·地怒是接任 NPC；交任 NPC／座標尚待核對。｜QuestieDB lists Mulen Earthfury as the pickup. The turn-in is unconfirmed.
05-副本.md:1786｜站內取捨｜順路先準備奧汀克、埃達拉斯廢墟任務；部落根帽鏈在雷霆崖一次辦完。｜En route, prepare Ogtinc and Ruins of Eldarath quests first; the Horde root hat chain can be completed in one go at Thunder Bluff.
05-副本.md:1787｜站內說明｜傳送門的座標落在冬泉谷地圖。從艾薩拉 1447 38.70, 33.40 進熊怪地道一路走到門，勿由冬泉谷地表尋找。｜The coordinates of the portal are located on the Winterspring map. From Azshara 1447 38.70, 33.40, enter the furbolg tunnel and walk all the way to the door. Do not search on the surface of Winterspring.
05-副本.md:1791｜副本動線｜龍塔大廳七符文→烈焰衛士艾博希爾→孵化間取石板→黑手大廳→競技場打雷德與蓋斯→熔爐（比斯巨獸可選）→塔頂王座打達基薩斯並查看身後寶珠。｜Clear the seven runes → Pyroguard Emberseer → tablet in the rookery → Blackhand Hall → Rend and Gyth in the arena → forge, with The Beast optional → General Drakkisath at the throne and his brand behind him.
05-副本.md:1794｜副本入口｜灼熱峽谷 1427 34.80, 85.30（黑石山外部路標）｜Searing Gorge 1427 34.80, 85.30 (Blackrock Mountain external road mark)
05-副本.md:1802｜站內前置接取路線｜滿 55 級後從冬泉谷 永望鎮飛奧格瑪，再搭飛艇到東部王國先做下層 4903，回卡加斯高圖斯接 4941。可於貧瘠之地 棘齒城後回奧格瑞瑪智慧谷向伊崔格、索爾交接並留 4974。57 級後回幽暗城煉金區接 4769，再飛卡加斯交給薇薇安，接 4768。下層至少一人完成 4742→4743 帶印章開門；已有持章隊友可直接打上層。｜After reaching level 55, fly from Winterspring Everlook to Orgrimmar, then take the zeppelin to Eastern Kingdoms. First do the lower level 4903, then return to Kargath and pick up 4941 in Gaotusi. return to Orgrimmar Wisdom Valley after The Barrens Ratchet to hand over to Eitrigg and Thrall and keep 4974. After level 57, return to Undercity Alchemy Zone to pick up 4769, then fly Kargath to Vivian and pick up 4768. At least one person on the lower floor must complete 4742→4743 and open the door with a seal; if there are already teammates with seals, they can go directly to the upper floor.

05-副本.md:1816｜標籤｜可共享｜Shareable
05-副本.md:1817｜標籤｜接取等級 55｜Min. level 55
05-副本.md:1817｜標籤｜建議等級 60｜Suggested level 60
05-副本.md:1817｜標籤｜前置：無｜Prefix: none
05-副本.md:1817｜步驟說明｜在黑石塔門外從裂盾軍需官拿到信後右鍵接；有意開黑翼之巢才做。｜Loot and use the quartermaster's letter outside Blackrock Spire for BWL access.
05-副本.md:1817｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
05-副本.md:1817｜標籤｜不可共享｜Not shareable
05-副本.md:1821｜步驟說明｜黑石塔上層特製地圖第 3 圖層：雷德·黑手 48.60, 25.60。｜Blackrock Spire Upper Special Map Layer 3: Red Blackhand 48.60, 25.60.
05-副本.md:1821｜標籤｜掉率 100%｜Drop rate: 100%
05-副本.md:1821｜步驟位置｜過孵化間上黑手大廳，進競技場北門觸發雷德｜Pass the rookery to Blackhand Hall. Enter the arena north gate to trigger Rend.
05-副本.md:1821｜步驟順序｜先取孵化間石板再打競技場｜Take the incubator stone first and then play the arena.
05-副本.md:1822｜步驟說明｜貼路線避開龍蛋，踩碎會引雛龍。｜Stay on the path and avoid the eggs. Broken eggs spawn whelps.
05-副本.md:1822｜步驟位置｜殺烈焰衛士後進孵化間，沿牆看地上的石板｜After Pyroguard Emberseer, enter the rookery. Check the floor by the wall.
05-副本.md:1822｜步驟順序｜在第13步競技場前完成｜Completed before the arena in step 13
05-副本.md:1823｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
05-副本.md:1823｜步驟說明｜黑石塔上層特製地圖第 3 圖層：達基薩斯 34.80, 50.10，烙印在其後方。｜Blackrock Spire Upper Special Map Layer 3: Dakisas 34.80, 50.10, imprinted behind it.
05-副本.md:1823｜步驟位置｜競技場南門出，經熔爐往王座，烙印在王後｜Leave the arena's south gate and pass the forge. The brand is behind the boss.
05-副本.md:1823｜步驟順序｜擊殺達基薩斯後點擊身後烙印｜After killing Drakisas, click on the mark behind you.
05-副本.md:1824｜標籤｜可跳過｜Optional
05-副本.md:1824｜標籤｜需遊戲實測｜Needs in-game check
05-副本.md:1831｜站內取捨｜卡加斯和奧格瑞瑪先接滿；黑手的命令是團隊副本傳送前置，有需求再做。｜Kargath and Orgrimmar should be filled up first; Blackhand's Command is the prerequisite for team copy transmission, and will be done if needed.
05-副本.md:1832｜站內說明｜與下層共用外門，進門後向左上去找上層鎖門；組隊先找可用晉升印章的隊友。開服後攻略已有上層實際門序；若遇到跳台地形擋路，走上層外側步道。｜It shares the outer door with the lower floor. After entering, go up to the left to find the locked door on the upper floor. When forming a team, first look for teammates who can use Seal of Ascension. After the server is launched, the guide has the actual door sequence of the upper level; if you encounter terrain blocking the way, walk up the outer trail of the upper level.
06-路線外任務.md:13｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:13｜路線外理由｜想解鎖對應寵物才做，經幽暗城順路處理。｜Only do it if you want to unlock the pet, and it will be processed by Undercity.
06-路線外任務.md:14｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:14｜路線外理由｜此步可接「歸還書籍」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Return Book", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:15｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:15｜路線外理由｜在幽暗城清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Undercity, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:16｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:16｜路線外理由｜限食人妖的牧師，交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Priests who are restricted to eating transvestites need to change the map when submitting documents, and then do it easily when going to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:17｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:17｜路線外理由｜經過奧雷薩多·盧卡附近時再接，回城或交件時順手完成。｜Pick it up when you pass near Oresado Luca, and easily complete it when you return to the city or deliver a package.

06-路線外任務.md:18｜路線外理由｜限食人妖的牧師，交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Priests who are restricted to eating transvestites need to change the map when submitting documents, and then do it easily when going to the destination flight path.

06-路線外任務.md:132｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:132｜路線外理由｜在微風島清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Zephras Isle, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:133｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:133｜路線外理由｜可與主線「非常時期」一起打怪或收集，省一次清場。｜Defeat monsters or collect them together with the main line "Desperate Times", saving you one time of clearing the field.
06-路線外任務.md:134｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:134｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「更多奧拉凱斯耳朵」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and receive "More Orakes Ears" after delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:135｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:135｜路線外理由｜可重複交材料換聲望，只有要刷該陣營時才保留。｜Materials can be exchanged repeatedly for reputation, and will only be retained when you want to farm that camp.
06-路線外任務.md:136｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:136｜路線外理由｜這段練級不會順路經過目標，單為此任務折返耗時。｜This leveling phase will not pass the target en route, and it will take time to turn back just for this quest.
06-路線外任務.md:137｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:137｜路線外理由｜限天裔，到 40 級學騎術時同趟處理，已有對應坐騎與騎術則可省下這趟。｜Limited to Skyborne, the same trip is required when learning riding skills at level 40. If you already have the mount and riding skills, save this trip.
06-路線外任務.md:141｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:141｜路線外理由｜這段練級不會順路經過目標，單為此任務折返耗時。｜This leveling phase will not pass the target en route, and it will take time to turn back just for this quest.
06-路線外任務.md:142｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:142｜路線外理由｜在古野村清周圍怪時順收九根梟羽，交給 Zet’gan。｜When Elderwild clears the surrounding monsters, collect the nine owl feathers and give them to Zet’gan.
06-路線外任務.md:143｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:143｜路線外理由｜處理完當地術士後沿道路往西北的哨站見 Zet’gan，可接村外支線。｜After dealing with the local warlock, follow the road to the northwest to see Zet’gan at the outpost, and connect to the side quest outside the village.
06-路線外任務.md:144｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:144｜路線外理由｜探訪古野村時順收十二株海加爾草藥，可接送藥後續。｜When visiting Elderwild, you will receive twelve herbs from the sea Garr, and pick up and deliver the medicine for follow-up.
06-路線外任務.md:145｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:145｜路線外理由｜已有敷劑時，留在古野村交給兩名傷者即可。｜When there is already a poultice, just leave it in Elderwild and give it to the two injured people.
06-路線外任務.md:146｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:146｜路線外理由｜已在海加爾山清廢棄營地時，順便找索耶家族線索。｜While clearing the abandoned camp at Mount Hyjal, look for clues about the Sawyer family.
06-路線外任務.md:147｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:147｜路線外理由｜索耶家族帳冊留到回幽暗城軍事區時交。｜The Sawyer family account books will be kept until they return to Undercity Military Zone.
06-路線外任務.md:148｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:148｜路線外理由｜帳冊已公證就回幽暗城軍事區交，和前一步同趟完成。｜Once the account book has been notarized, return to Undercity Military Zone and submit it, completing the same trip as the previous step.
06-路線外任務.md:149｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:149｜路線外理由｜有六份所需的鹿肉料理再交給古野村的 Ortak，省下專程採買。｜If you have six servings of venison dishes required, hand them over to Ortak at Elderwild, saving you a special trip to buy them.
06-路線外任務.md:150｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:150｜路線外理由｜已到西邊哨站才順清被遺忘士兵和吞肉怪，可和附近任務一起做。｜Clear the Forgotten Soldiers and Flesh-Eating Monsters after arriving at the western outpost. do this together with the nearby quests.
06-路線外任務.md:151｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:151｜路線外理由｜拿到戰紋布再找認得它的人，保留到送回森金村。｜Get the war pattern cloth and find someone who recognizes it. Keep it until you send it back to Sen'jin Village.
06-路線外任務.md:152｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:152｜路線外理由｜戰紋布要送往杜洛塔森金村，安排回卡林多東岸時一併送。｜The war pattern cloth will be sent to Durotar Sen'jin Village, and arrangements will be made to send it together when returning to the east coast of Kalimdor.
06-路線外任務.md:153｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:153｜路線外理由｜在古野村接旗幟與紋章收集，若需要武器，可做完回古野村選劍或匕首。｜Collect flags and coats of arms at Elderwild. If you need a weapon, return to Elderwild to choose a sword or dagger.
06-路線外任務.md:154｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:154｜路線外理由｜拿到倖存者的火炬後，再到骨堆召出敵人並收護符。｜After getting the survivor's torch, go to the bone pile to summon the enemy and collect the talisman.
06-路線外任務.md:155｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:155｜路線外理由｜要去永恆之巔時順手向德魯伊打聽倖存者村落。｜When you go to the Eternal Summit, ask the Druid about the survivor village.
06-路線外任務.md:156｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:156｜路線外理由｜已在古野村取得兔屍，再往南引出目標，和同區任務一起交。｜You have obtained the rabbit corpse at Elderwild, then go south to lead the target, and submit it together with the quest in the same area.
06-路線外任務.md:157｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:157｜路線外理由｜已有索耶家族帳冊時，在幽暗城商業區公證後回軍事區交件。｜If you already have the Sawyer family account book, go to the Undercity commercial area for notarization and return to the military area to submit the documents.
06-路線外任務.md:158｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:158｜路線外理由｜這段練級不會順路經過目標，單為此任務折返耗時。｜This leveling phase will not pass the target en route, and it will take time to turn back just for this quest.
06-路線外任務.md:162｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:162｜路線外理由｜亞服促銷資格已生效時才可領獎，回城順路確認。｜Only claim the prize if your Asian server promotion qualification has taken effect. Please check it when you return to the city.
06-路線外任務.md:163｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:163｜路線外理由｜限牧師，已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜Only for priests. If you already have triggers, please wait for them to drop. It is easy to slow down the progress.
06-路線外任務.md:164｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:164｜路線外理由｜經過Wendel Mathers附近時再接，回城或交件時順手完成。｜Pick it up when you pass near Wendel Mathers, and it can be completed smoothly when returning to the city or delivering a package.
06-路線外任務.md:165｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:165｜路線外理由｜在荊棘谷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Stranglethorn Vale, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:166｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:166｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「荊棘谷的青山 - 第壹章」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and access "Stranglethorn Vale's Qingshan - Chapter 1" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:167｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:167｜路線外理由｜在荊棘谷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Stranglethorn Vale, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:168｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:168｜路線外理由｜在荊棘谷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Stranglethorn Vale, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:169｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:169｜路線外理由｜在荊棘谷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Stranglethorn Vale, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:170｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:170｜路線外理由｜在荊棘谷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Stranglethorn Vale, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:171｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:171｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.
06-路線外任務.md:172｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:172｜路線外理由｜接交點在同一區且靠近主線，回營地時可順手交。｜The pick-up point is in the same area and close to the main line, so turn it in easily when you return to the camp.
06-路線外任務.md:173｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:173｜路線外理由｜經過旅行者拉茲戈特附近時再接，回城或交件時順手完成。｜Pick him up when he passes near the traveler Razgot, and he can finish it smoothly when he returns to the city or delivers a parcel.
06-路線外任務.md:174｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:174｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:175｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:175｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.
06-路線外任務.md:176｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:176｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接同名後續。｜The access point is close to the main line, and after delivery, the follow-up line with the same name can be connected.
06-路線外任務.md:177｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:177｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，同區可交件。｜Use it if you hit the trigger en route, and turn it in in the same area.
06-路線外任務.md:178｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:178｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 4650 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and the waiting time is about 4650 experience.
06-路線外任務.md:179｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:179｜路線外理由｜屬重複兌換或補領，練級只需做有經驗的首次任務。｜It belongs to repeated redemption or replacement. To level up, you only need to do the first quest with experience.
06-路線外任務.md:180｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:180｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「歌唱水晶」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and access the "Singing Crystal" after handing it over.
06-路線外任務.md:181｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:181｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「心靈之眼」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up "Mind's Eye" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:182｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:182｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，可接同名後續。｜Use it when you hit a trigger en route, and follow it up with the same name.
06-路線外任務.md:183｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:183｜路線外理由｜要交專業材料或成品，沒有專業需求時省下材料。｜Hand over professional materials or finished products, and save materials when there is no professional need.
06-路線外任務.md:184｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:184｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.

06-路線外任務.md:188｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「耶尼庫的命運」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up "Yenikku's Fate" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:189｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:189｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「拯救耶尼庫」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up "Save Yeniku" after handing it in.

06-路線外任務.md:190｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「靈魂寶石」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and receive the "Soul Gem" after handing it over.

06-路線外任務.md:196｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:196｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，可接「船長的彎刀」。｜Use it if you hit a trigger en route, and connect it to "Captain's Scimitar".
06-路線外任務.md:197｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:197｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「挑戰奈古拉什」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up "Challenge Negurash" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:198｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:198｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「引誘奈古拉什」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line. After handing in the item, pick up "Seducing Negurash".

06-路線外任務.md:202｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:202｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.
06-路線外任務.md:203｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:203｜路線外理由｜屬重複兌換或補領，練級只需做有經驗的首次任務。｜It belongs to repeated redemption or replacement. To level up, you only need to do the first quest with experience.

06-路線外任務.md:294｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:294｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.

06-路線外任務.md:414｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:414｜路線外理由｜限獸人／不死族／牛頭人，在提里斯法林地清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜Only for Orcs/Undead/Tauren, if you happen to reach the target area when clearing the main line in Tirisfal Glades, do it without making a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:415｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:415｜路線外理由｜限獸人／不死族，在提里斯法林地清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜Only for Orcs/Undead, if you happen to reach the target area when clearing the main line in Tirisfal Glades, do it without making a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:416｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:416｜路線外理由｜在布瑞爾與冷冽谷之間歸還書籍，可接證明忠誠及巫妖歸順。｜Return Book between Brill and Lenglie Valley to prove loyalty and submit to the lich.
06-路線外任務.md:417｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:417｜路線外理由｜在布瑞爾交完腐皮豺狼人的膿液後再走巫妖線，可和冷冽谷跑腿合併。｜After handing in Rot Hide Ichor at Brill and then taking the Lich route, merge it with the Lenglie Valley errand.
06-路線外任務.md:418｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:418｜路線外理由｜屬重複兌換或補領，練級只需做有經驗的首次任務。｜It belongs to repeated redemption or replacement. To level up, you only need to do the first quest with experience.
06-路線外任務.md:419｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon

06-路線外任務.md:421｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:421｜路線外理由｜歸還書籍後續，做完可接巫妖歸順，冷冽谷與布瑞爾同趟收尾。｜Return Book for follow-up. After completing it, receive the lich and surrender. Lenglie Valley and Brill will end on the same trip.
06-路線外任務.md:422｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:422｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:423｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:423｜路線外理由｜限不死族，接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「萊尼德的信件」。｜Only for undead, the access point is close to the main line, and receive "Lenid's Letter" after delivering the package.

06-路線外任務.md:428｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:428｜路線外理由｜限不死族，到 40 級學騎術時同趟處理，已有對應坐騎與騎術則可省下這趟。｜For undead only, the same process is required when learning riding skills at level 40. If you already have the mount and riding skills, save this trip.
06-路線外任務.md:429｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:429｜路線外理由｜節慶開放且剛好路過時再做，練級途中可先放著。｜Do it when the festival is open and you happen to be passing by. leave it alone during leveling.

06-路線外任務.md:452｜路線外理由｜前往森金村時可清蠍子取毒囊；已過杜洛塔的適等區就不必回頭。｜When heading to Sen'jin Village, clear the scorpion and get the poison sac; there is no need to look back after passing the zone of Durotar.

06-路線外任務.md:454｜路線外理由｜限不死族的牧師，交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Only for priests of the undead, change the map when submitting the documents, and do it when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:455｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:455｜路線外理由｜若已拿到巨獸脊骨斧線的觸發物，經杜洛塔時再接裝備支線。｜If you have obtained the trigger of the Behemoth Spine Ax Line, then connect the equipment side quest after passing Durotar.
06-路線外任務.md:456｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:456｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.

06-路線外任務.md:458｜路線外理由｜此步可接「惡魔之種」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Take "Devil's Seed" at this step, and wait until the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area before doing it together.

06-路線外任務.md:564｜路線外理由｜限食人妖的牧師，交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Priests who are restricted to eating transvestites need to change the map when submitting documents, and then do it easily when going to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:565｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:565｜路線外理由｜限不死族的牧師，交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Only for priests of the undead, change the map when submitting the documents, and do it when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:566｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:566｜路線外理由｜限獸人／牛頭人／食人妖，此步可接同名後續，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Only for orcs/tauren/trolls, this step can be followed by the follow-up with the same name. Wait until the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area and then do it together.
06-路線外任務.md:567｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route

06-路線外任務.md:568｜路線外理由｜限獸人／牛頭人／食人妖，在莫高雷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜Only for orcs/tauren/trolls, if you happen to reach the target area when clearing the main line in Mulgore, do it without making a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:569｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:569｜路線外理由｜血蹄村附近調查惡魔之傷，回村交件即可。｜Bloodhoof Village Investigate the Devil's Wound nearby, then return to the village and hand in the documents.
06-路線外任務.md:570｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:570｜路線外理由｜在莫高雷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Mulgore, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:571｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route

06-路線外任務.md:576｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:576｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.
06-路線外任務.md:577｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:577｜路線外理由｜限天裔，交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Only for Skyborne, change the map when submitting the documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:578｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:578｜路線外理由｜限牛頭人，到 40 級學騎術時同趟處理，已有對應坐騎與騎術則可省下這趟。｜Only for tauren, go through the same process when you learn riding skills at level 40. If you already have the mount and riding skills, save this trip.

06-路線外任務.md:579｜路線外理由｜暗月馬戲團輪值時再做，已有套牌、獎券或材料才值得交。｜Do it during the Darkmoon Faire rotation. It is only worth turning in if you already have a deck, tickets or materials.
06-路線外任務.md:580｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:580｜路線外理由｜節慶開放且剛好路過時再做，練級途中可先放著。｜Do it when the festival is open and you happen to be passing by. leave it alone during leveling.

06-路線外任務.md:588｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:588｜路線外理由｜限牛頭人，接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「飛往雷霆崖」。｜Only for Minotaurs, the pick-up point is close to the main line. After submitting the package, pick up "Fly to Thunder Bluff".
06-路線外任務.md:589｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:589｜路線外理由｜限牛頭人，此步可接「雙足飛龍管理員塔爾」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜For tauren only, this step can be done with "Wind Rider Administrator Tal", and then wait until the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:590｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:590｜路線外理由｜限牛頭人，此步可接「向加翰回復」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜For tauren only, this step can be followed by "Reply to Jiahan", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:591｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:591｜路線外理由｜限牛頭人，配合既有飛行或交件行程處理，免為單次送件另跑一趟。｜For Tauren only, it can be processed in conjunction with the existing flight or delivery itinerary to avoid having to make another trip for a single delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:592｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:592｜路線外理由｜限獸人／食人妖，接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「飛往奧格瑞瑪」。｜Only for orcs/trolls, the pick-up point is close to the main line. After submitting the package, pick up "Fly to Orgrimmar".
06-路線外任務.md:593｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:593｜路線外理由｜限獸人／食人妖，此步可接「雙足飛龍管理員多拉斯」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Only for orcs/trolls, this step can be followed by "Wind Rider Administrator Doras", and then do it together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:594｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:594｜路線外理由｜限獸人／食人妖，此步可接「返回十字路口」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Only for orcs/trolls, this step can be followed by "return to The Crossroads", and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:595｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:595｜路線外理由｜限獸人／食人妖，配合既有飛行或交件行程處理，免為單次送件另跑一趟。｜For orcs/trolls only, it can be processed in conjunction with the existing flight or delivery itinerary to avoid having to make another trip for a single delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:596｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:596｜路線外理由｜此步可接「高強度齒輪」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "High-intensity Gear", and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:597｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:597｜路線外理由｜和棘齒城西北伐木區的風險投資公司任務同趟收齒輪，可開加茲魯維後續。｜It is the same as Ratchet Venture Company Mining quest in the northwest logging area to collect gears, and can be followed by Gazlowe.
06-路線外任務.md:598｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:598｜路線外理由｜在陶拉祖營地周圍打野獸時順手收根鬚，單為樣本多刷一輪較慢。｜When fighting beasts around Camp Taurajo, it is easy to close the roots. It is slower to brush one more round just for the sample.
06-路線外任務.md:599｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:599｜路線外理由｜此步可接「主動式負載平衡器說明書」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by the "Active Load Balancer Instructions" and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:600｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:600｜路線外理由｜沿棘齒城西北伐木區拿說明書，可與同區風險投資公司任務合併。｜Take the instructions along the northwest logging area of ​​Ratchet, which can be merged with the Venture Company Mining quest in the same area.

06-路線外任務.md:601｜路線外理由｜屬重複兌換或補領，練級只需做有經驗的首次任務。｜It belongs to repeated redemption or replacement. To level up, you only need to do the first quest with experience.

06-路線外任務.md:607｜路線外理由｜屬重複兌換或補領，練級只需做有經驗的首次任務。｜It belongs to repeated redemption or replacement. To level up, you only need to do the first quest with experience.
06-路線外任務.md:608｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:608｜路線外理由｜在貧瘠之地清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in The Barrens, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:609｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:609｜路線外理由｜此步可接「墊腳石」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Take this step as a "stepping stone" and wait until the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area before doing it together.
06-路線外任務.md:610｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:610｜路線外理由｜在陶拉祖營地做野豬人任務時可順手打掘地鼠，想學食譜再交。｜When doing the quilboar quest in Camp Taurajo, easily dig up gophers. If you want to learn the recipe, submit it again.
06-路線外任務.md:611｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:611｜路線外理由｜可重複交材料換聲望，只有要刷該陣營時才保留。｜Materials can be exchanged repeatedly for reputation, and will only be retained when you want to farm that camp.
06-路線外任務.md:612｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:612｜路線外理由｜此步可接「匆匆忙忙」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Hurry", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:613｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:613｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，可接「部落的示威」。｜Use it if you hit a trigger en route, and pick up "Tribe's Demonstration".
06-路線外任務.md:614｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:614｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接同名後續。｜The access point is close to the main line, and after delivery, the follow-up line with the same name can be connected.
06-路線外任務.md:615｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:615｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 2100 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and there are about 2100 experience points for waiting for delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:616｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:616｜路線外理由｜這段練級不會順路經過目標，單為此任務折返耗時。｜This leveling phase will not pass the target en route, and it will take time to turn back just for this quest.

06-路線外任務.md:617｜路線外理由｜此步可接「依沙瓦克」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Ishawak", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.

06-路線外任務.md:703｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:703｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 3050 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and the waiting time is about 3050 experience.
06-路線外任務.md:704｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:704｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.
06-路線外任務.md:705｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:705｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:706｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:706｜路線外理由｜此步可接「塔蕾莎的禮物」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Take "Taressa's Gift" at this step, and wait until the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area before doing it together.
06-路線外任務.md:707｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:707｜路線外理由｜節慶開放且剛好路過時再做，練級途中可先放著。｜Do it when the festival is open and you happen to be passing by. leave it alone during leveling.
06-路線外任務.md:708｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:708｜路線外理由｜史詩戰馬要符文布、奧金錠、阿薩斯之淚、斯坦索姆聖水和 150 金，滿級再準備。｜The epic war horse requires Rune Cloth, Arcanite Bar, Tears of Arthas, Stratholme Holy Water and 150 gold. Prepare when it is at full level.
06-路線外任務.md:708｜標籤｜僅聖騎士｜Paladin only
06-路線外任務.md:712｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:712｜路線外理由｜屬於滿級團本前置、聲望或兌換，練級時先放掉，等對應團本開放再查。｜It belongs to the prerequisites, reputation or redemption of the full-level group book. Let it go when leveling up, and then check again when the group book is opened.
06-路線外任務.md:713｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:713｜路線外理由｜在梣谷清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Ashenvale, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.

06-路線外任務.md:767｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:767｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.

06-路線外任務.md:777｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:777｜路線外理由｜屬重複兌換或補領，練級只需做有經驗的首次任務。｜It belongs to repeated redemption or replacement. To level up, you only need to do the first quest with experience.
06-路線外任務.md:778｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:778｜路線外理由｜在菲拉斯清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Feralas, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:779｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:779｜路線外理由｜要交專業材料或成品，沒有專業需求時省下材料。｜Hand over professional materials or finished products, and save materials when there is no professional need.
06-路線外任務.md:780｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:780｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.

06-路線外任務.md:818｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:818｜路線外理由｜此步可接「通過試煉」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Passing the Trial" and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:819｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:819｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 3450 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and the waiting time is about 3450 experience.
06-路線外任務.md:820｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:820｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:821｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:821｜路線外理由｜30 級起，交完碼頭管理員迪茲維格（1111）向棘齒城同一位碼頭管理員（1413 63.35, 38.45）接；下次經千針石林 閃光平原賽道交克拉維爾·濃鬚（1441 77.79, 77.27），原地續接侏儒的貨物（1114）。｜Starting from level 30, after turning in Wharfmaster Dizzywig (1111), pick up Ratchet from the same dock manager (1413 63.35, 38.45); next time, turn in Thousand Needles The Shimmering Flats and turn in Clavel Nongsu (1441 77.79, 77.27), continue to pick up the dwarf's goods in place (1114).
06-路線外任務.md:822｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:822｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「車手的傳聞」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up the "Rider's Rumor" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:823｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:823｜路線外理由｜交完侏儒的貨物（1114）後向閃光平原的克拉維爾·濃鬚接，下趟到藏寶海灣找克拉茲克交並解鎖夢境之塵（1116）。｜After turning in the dwarf's cargo (1114), pick it up from Clavier Nosu at The Shimmering Flats. Go to Booty Bay next time to find Krazek to turn it in and unlock Dream Dust in the Swamp (1116).

06-路線外任務.md:847｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route

06-路線外任務.md:851｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:851｜路線外理由｜在阿拉希高地清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Arathi Highlands, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:852｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:852｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.
06-路線外任務.md:853｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:853｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，同區可交件。｜Use it if you hit the trigger en route, and turn it in in the same area.
06-路線外任務.md:854｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:854｜路線外理由｜有隊伍時順手處理精英「石拳虐待者」，單練可以先跳。｜When there is a team, deal with the elite "Stone Fist Torturer" easily, and jump first when practicing alone.
06-路線外任務.md:855｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
