06-路線外任務.md:857｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:857｜路線外理由｜接交點在同一區且靠近主線，回營地時可順手交。｜The pick-up point is in the same area and close to the main line, so turn it in easily when you return to the camp.
06-路線外任務.md:858｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:858｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「托爾貝恩符印」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up the "Sign of Trollbane" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:859｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:859｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「托卡拉爾」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and access "Tokal LAL" after delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:860｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:860｜路線外理由｜此步可接同名後續，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by the same name, and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:861｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:861｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 4300 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and there are about 4300 experience for the delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:862｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:862｜路線外理由｜這段練級不會順路經過目標，單為此任務折返耗時。｜This leveling phase will not pass the target en route, and it will take time to turn back just for this quest.
06-路線外任務.md:863｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:863｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.

06-路線外任務.md:994｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:994｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，可接「拯救OOX-17/TN！」。｜Use it if you hit a trigger en route, and pick up "Save OOX-17/TN!".
06-路線外任務.md:995｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:995｜路線外理由｜已走到護送起點且沿途好清怪才接。｜You will be picked up only after you reached the starting point of the escort and there are clear monsters en route.
06-路線外任務.md:996｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:996｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 5900 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and there are about 5900 experience for the delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:997｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:997｜路線外理由｜此步可接「返回雷霆崖」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "return to Thunder Bluff", and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:998｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:998｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.
06-路線外任務.md:999｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:999｜路線外理由｜接交點在同一區且靠近主線，回營地時可順手交。｜The pick-up point is in the same area and close to the main line, so turn it in easily when you return to the camp.
06-路線外任務.md:1000｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1000｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「臨危不懼」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up "Fearless in the face of danger" after handing in the package.
06-路線外任務.md:1001｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1001｜路線外理由｜此步可接同名後續，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by the same name, and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1002｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1002｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:1003｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:1003｜路線外理由｜可重複交材料換聲望，只有要刷該陣營時才保留。｜Materials can be exchanged repeatedly for reputation, and will only be retained when you want to farm that camp.

06-路線外任務.md:1015｜路線外理由｜先達成聲望門檻，已有聲望進度再回來交。｜Reach the reputation threshold first, then come back and submit the reputation progress.

06-路線外任務.md:1063｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route

06-路線外任務.md:1103｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1103｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 3450 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and the waiting time is about 3450 experience.
06-路線外任務.md:1104｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1104｜路線外理由｜此步可接「完好無損的毒囊」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Pick up the "intact poison sac" at this step, and wait until the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area before doing it together.
06-路線外任務.md:1105｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1105｜路線外理由｜此步可接「請教加德林大師」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Ask Master Gadrin", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1106｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1106｜路線外理由｜此步可接「蜘蛛之神」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Spider God", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1107｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1107｜路線外理由｜已走到護送起點且沿途好清怪才接。｜You will be picked up only after you reached the starting point of the escort and there are clear monsters en route.
06-路線外任務.md:1108｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1108｜路線外理由｜此步可接「奧蘭的感謝」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Olan's Thank You", and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1109｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1109｜路線外理由｜經過奧蘭·蛇繞附近時再接，回城或交件時順手完成。｜Pick it up again when passing by Oran Snake Circle, and it can be completed smoothly when returning to the city or delivering a package.
06-路線外任務.md:1110｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1110｜路線外理由｜此步可接「送回蜜酒」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Send Mead back", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1111｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1111｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，可接「拯救OOX-09/HL！」。｜Use it if you hit a trigger en route, and pick up "Save OOX-09/HL!".
06-路線外任務.md:1112｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1112｜路線外理由｜已走到護送起點且沿途好清怪才接。｜You will be picked up only after you reached the starting point of the escort and there are clear monsters en route.
06-路線外任務.md:1113｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1113｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「又壹個給蠻錘部族的警告」。｜The access point is close to the main line. After handing it in, receive "Another Warning for the Wildhammer Tribe".
06-路線外任務.md:1114｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1114｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「給蠻錘部族的最後警告」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line. After handing it in, pick up "The Last Warning to the Wildhammer Tribe".
06-路線外任務.md:1115｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1115｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 4400 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and there are about 4,400 experience points for a decent delivery.

06-路線外任務.md:1116｜路線外理由｜在辛特蘭清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in The Hinterlands, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.

06-路線外任務.md:1118｜路線外理由｜此步可接「送往幽暗城的毒藥」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Poison sent to Undercity", and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.

06-路線外任務.md:1146｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1146｜路線外理由｜在艾薩拉清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Azshara, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:1147｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1147｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「克希雷姆的報酬」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and receive "Xylem's Reward" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:1148｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1148｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.

06-路線外任務.md:1239｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.
06-路線外任務.md:1240｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1240｜路線外理由｜拿到召喚書且有隊伍時，順路到風暴祭壇打精英，回奧格瑪選武器或護甲。｜When you get the summons book and have a team, go to Altar of Storms to fight elites, and return to Orgrimmar to choose weapons or armor.

06-路線外任務.md:1281｜路線外理由｜經過霍萊伊·馬紹爾附近時再接，回城或交件時順手完成。｜Pick it up when you pass near Holayi Marshall, and it can be completed smoothly when you return to the city or deliver the parcel.

06-路線外任務.md:1282｜路線外理由｜有隊伍時順手處理精英「火焰使者」，單練可以先跳。｜When there is a team, handle the elite "Blazerunner" easily, and jump first when practicing alone.
06-路線外任務.md:1283｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1283｜路線外理由｜節慶開放且剛好路過時再做，練級途中可先放著。｜Do it when the festival is open and you happen to be passing by. leave it alone during leveling.
06-路線外任務.md:1284｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1284｜路線外理由｜打算養毒皮暴掠龍再順手收兩種肉，交給莫維克換聲望。｜I plan to raise Poison Skin Ravasaur and then collect two kinds of meat and give them to Movik in exchange for reputation.
06-路線外任務.md:1288｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1288｜路線外理由｜進奧卡茲監獄時向囚犯接支線，打審問者拿鐐銬鑰匙可接藏寶後續。｜When entering Alcaz Prison, pick up the side quest from the prisoner. Call The Questioner to get the shackles key to pick up the treasure.
06-路線外任務.md:1289｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1289｜路線外理由｜已幫石匠康納利解開鐐銬才接，拿到筆記再找他的藏寶。｜He had already helped the stonemason Connelly to unshackle himself, and then found his treasure after getting the notes.
06-路線外任務.md:1290｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1290｜路線外理由｜已有文件盒時再帶回奧格瑪找納茲格雷爾，和監獄回報合併。｜If there is already a file box, bring back Orgrimmar to find Nazgrel, and merge it with Prison report.
06-路線外任務.md:1294｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1294｜路線外理由｜可接主線已收錄的「腐化之井」。｜Can be connected to "Well of Corruption" already included in the main line.
06-路線外任務.md:1295｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1295｜路線外理由｜可接主線已收錄的「冬泉熊怪的威脅」。｜Can be connected to "Threat of the Winterfall" already included in the main line.
06-路線外任務.md:1296｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1296｜路線外理由｜已有觸發物再交，專程等掉落容易拖慢進度。｜If you already have a trigger and then turn it in, waiting for it to drop will easily slow down your progress.
06-路線外任務.md:1297｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1297｜路線外理由｜有隊伍時順手處理精英「布魯米蘭」，單練可以先跳。｜When there is a team, deal with the elite "Brumilan" easily, and jump first when practicing alone.
06-路線外任務.md:1298｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1298｜路線外理由｜在北部本來就要打老裂齒熊時一起完成，再回 Sarna Brownhorn。｜Complete it together in the north when you were supposed to fight the old Cracktooth Bear, and then return to Sarna Brownhorn.
06-路線外任務.md:1299｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1299｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，可接同名後續。｜Use it when you hit a trigger en route, and follow it up with the same name.
06-路線外任務.md:1300｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1300｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:1301｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1301｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:1302｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1302｜路線外理由｜在冬泉谷北部清同區奇美拉時一起做，回 Rilan Howard 報告。｜We will do this together in Chimera, Winterspring, Northern Qingtong District, and report back to Rilan Howard.
06-路線外任務.md:1303｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1303｜路線外理由｜本來要去北部熊區、能安全處理兩隻族母時，再把牠們的頭帶回。｜I was going to go to the northern bear area and bring the heads back to the two clan mothers when I could safely handle them.
06-路線外任務.md:1304｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1304｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「瑪艾裏的容器」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up "Maari's Container" after handing it over.
06-路線外任務.md:1305｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1305｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「霜刃魂精」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up "Frost Blade Soul Essence" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:1306｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:1306｜路線外理由｜屬重複兌換或補領，練級只需做有經驗的首次任務。｜It belongs to repeated redemption or replacement. To level up, you only need to do the first quest with experience.

06-路線外任務.md:1314｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1314｜路線外理由｜接交點在同一區且靠近主線，回營地時可順手交。｜The pick-up point is in the same area and close to the main line, so turn it in easily when you return to the camp.

06-路線外任務.md:1318｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.
06-路線外任務.md:1319｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1319｜路線外理由｜限戰士／聖騎士／薩滿，有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only warriors/paladins/shamans can keep it if they have practiced the majors. When you return to the area to find a professional trainer, do it together.
06-路線外任務.md:1320｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1320｜路線外理由｜此步可接同名後續，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by the same name, and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.

06-路線外任務.md:1326｜路線外理由｜可重複交材料換聲望，只有要刷該陣營時才保留。｜Materials can be exchanged repeatedly for reputation, and will only be retained when you want to farm that camp.
06-路線外任務.md:1327｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1327｜路線外理由｜已有五張奇美拉皮和五根梟羽再交給埃文·維布魯，換冬泉谷隱蔽藥水。｜There are already five Chimera Skins and five Owl Feathers, and then they are given to Evan Viburu in exchange for Winterspring Concealment Potion.

06-路線外任務.md:1338｜路線外理由｜限術士，交件後可接「戈瑟奇·邪眼」，可同一趟處理。｜Only for warlocks, receive "Gosage·Evil Eye" after handing it in, and it can be processed in the same trip.

06-路線外任務.md:1340｜路線外理由｜限術士，下次回職業訓練師或走職業鏈時可接「背叛者烏拉泰克」。｜Only for warlocks, pick up "Uratek the Betrayer" next time you return to the professional trainer or follow the professional chain.

06-路線外任務.md:1384｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1384｜路線外理由｜可接主線已收錄的「帕米拉的洋娃娃」。｜Can be connected to "Pamela's Doll" already included in the main line.
06-路線外任務.md:1385｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1385｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「爪牙的天災石」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and pick up "Minion's Scourge Stone" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:1386｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:1386｜路線外理由｜可重複交材料換聲望，只有要刷該陣營時才保留。｜Materials can be exchanged repeatedly for reputation, and will only be retained when you want to farm that camp.
06-路線外任務.md:1387｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:1387｜路線外理由｜可重複交材料換聲望，只有要刷該陣營時才保留。｜Materials can be exchanged repeatedly for reputation, and will only be retained when you want to farm that camp.

06-路線外任務.md:1389｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1389｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 4200 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and there are about 4,200 experience points for a decent delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:1390｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1390｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「達隆郡的掠奪者」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and access "Plunder of Darrowshire" after delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:1391｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1391｜路線外理由｜此步可接「達隆郡的英雄」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "The Hero of Darrowshire", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1392｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1392｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「達隆郡的掠奪者」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and access "Plunder of Darrowshire" after delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:1393｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1393｜路線外理由｜限聖騎士，在東瘟疫之地清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜For Paladins only, if you happen to reach the target area when clearing the main line in Eastern Plaguelands, just do it without making a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:1394｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1394｜路線外理由｜回奧格瑪智慧谷時再找 Corswyn Aseril，省一次跨洲。｜When you return to Orgrimmar, find Corswyn Aseril again in the Valley of Wisdom to save yourself from crossing the continent.
06-路線外任務.md:1395｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1395｜路線外理由｜此步可接「最後的石板」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by the "last slate" and then done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1396｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1396｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「煙鬼的炸藥」。｜The access point is close to the main line, and pick up "Smoker's Explosives" after handing it in.

06-路線外任務.md:1398｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1398｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「返回克羅米身邊」。｜The access point is close to the main line. After handing in the parcel, pick up "return to Chromie".
06-路線外任務.md:1399｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1399｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接「銀色黎明寶箱」。｜The pick-up point is close to the main line, and pick up the "Silver Dawn Treasure Chest" after handing it in.
06-路線外任務.md:1400｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1400｜路線外理由｜接交點在同一區且靠近主線，回營地時可順手交。｜The pick-up point is in the same area and close to the main line, so turn it in easily when you return to the camp.

06-路線外任務.md:1401｜路線外理由｜此步可接「禁錮靈魂的遺物」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜Take "The Relic that Imprisoned the Soul" at this step, and then do it together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.

06-路線外任務.md:1402｜路線外理由｜先達成聲望門檻，已有聲望進度再回來交。｜Reach the reputation threshold first, then come back and submit the reputation progress.

06-路線外任務.md:1475｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route

06-路線外任務.md:1566｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1566｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，可接「逃出加德納爾」。｜Use it if you hit a trigger en route, and connect to "Escape Jaedenar".
06-路線外任務.md:1567｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1567｜路線外理由｜已走到護送起點且沿途好清怪才接。｜You will be picked up only after you reached the starting point of the escort and there are clear monsters en route.
06-路線外任務.md:1568｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1568｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接同名後續。｜The access point is close to the main line, and after delivery, the follow-up line with the same name can be connected.
06-路線外任務.md:1569｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1569｜路線外理由｜有練對應專業才留，回區域找專業訓練師時一起辦。｜Only keep it if you have practiced in the major, and do it together when you return to the area to find a professional trainer.
06-路線外任務.md:1570｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route

06-路線外任務.md:1571｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:1571｜路線外理由｜要交專業材料或成品，沒有專業需求時省下材料。｜Hand over professional materials or finished products, and save materials when there is no professional need.

06-路線外任務.md:1573｜路線外理由｜先達成聲望門檻，已有聲望進度再回來交。｜Reach the reputation threshold first, then come back and submit the reputation progress.

06-路線外任務.md:1576｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon

06-路線外任務.md:1577｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1577｜路線外理由｜順路打到觸發物就用，同區可交件。｜Use it if you hit the trigger en route, and turn it in in the same area.
06-路線外任務.md:1578｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1578｜路線外理由｜在費伍德森林清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Felwood, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:1579｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1579｜路線外理由｜在費伍德森林清主線時若剛好到目標區就做，無須專程折返。｜When clearing the main line in Felwood, just do it if you happen to reach the target area. There is no need to make a special trip to turn back.
06-路線外任務.md:1580｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1580｜路線外理由｜交件要換地圖，去目的地飛行點時再順手辦。｜Change the map when submitting documents, and do it easily when you go to the destination flight path.
06-路線外任務.md:1581｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon

06-路線外任務.md:1582｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1582｜路線外理由｜此步可接「特雷·萊弗治的殘骸」，等主線走到接取或交件區再一併做。｜This step can be followed by "Trey Leverage's Wreck", and then be done together when the main line reaches the pick-up or delivery area.
06-路線外任務.md:1583｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1583｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 7550 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and the waiting time is about 7550 experience.
06-路線外任務.md:1584｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1584｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，交件後可接同名後續。｜The access point is close to the main line, and after delivery, the follow-up line with the same name can be connected.

06-路線外任務.md:1585｜路線外理由｜限術士，交件後可接「克索諾斯星塵」，可同一趟處理。｜Only for warlocks, receive "Xonos Stardust" after handing it in, and it can be processed in the same trip.
06-路線外任務.md:1586｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1586｜路線外理由｜接取點靠近主線，適等交件約有 6400 經驗。｜The access point is close to the main line, and there are about 6,400 experience points waiting for delivery.
06-路線外任務.md:1587｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1587｜路線外理由｜限術士，下次回職業訓練師或走職業鏈時可接「瓶中的小鬼」。｜Only for warlocks, pick "Imp in a Jar" the next time you return to the professional trainer or follow the professional chain.
06-路線外任務.md:1588｜路線外判定｜值得做｜Worth doing
06-路線外任務.md:1588｜路線外理由｜限獵人，接交點在同一區且靠近主線，回營地時可順手交。｜For hunters only, the pick-up point is in the same area and close to the main line, so turn it in easily when you return to the camp.
06-路線外任務.md:1589｜路線外判定｜可放掉｜Safe to abandon
06-路線外任務.md:1589｜路線外理由｜限獵人，須排戰場或完成 PvP 目標，有打戰場再留。｜Only for hunters, you must queue up the battlefield or complete PvP objectives. If you have completed the battlefield, stay.

06-路線外任務.md:1856｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1856｜路線外理由｜有排這座副本再帶上，交件後可接「超越」。｜Bring this dungeon with you if you have lined up it. After handing it in, pick up "Transcendence".
06-路線外任務.md:1857｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1857｜路線外理由｜有排這座副本再帶上，交件後可接「瑪克斯韋爾·泰羅索斯男爵」。｜Bring this dungeon with you if you have a row. After handing it in, pick up "Baron Maxwell Tyrossos".
06-路線外任務.md:1858｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1858｜路線外理由｜有排這座副本再帶上，交件後可接同名後續。｜Bring this copy with you if you have arranged it. After submitting it, pick up the follow-up with the same name.
06-路線外任務.md:1859｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1859｜路線外理由｜已組隊要打這座副本再接，可和同本任務一起交。｜If you have already formed a team and want to fight this dungeon before picking it up, turn it in together with the same quest.
06-路線外任務.md:1860｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1860｜路線外理由｜節慶開放且剛好路過時再做，練級途中可先放著。｜Do it when the festival is open and you happen to be passing by. leave it alone during leveling.
06-路線外任務.md:1861｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1861｜路線外理由｜有排這座副本再帶上，交件後可接「生命的證據」。｜Bring this copy with you. After submitting it, receive "Proof of Life".
06-路線外任務.md:1862｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route
06-路線外任務.md:1862｜路線外理由｜有排這座副本再帶上，交件後可接「我看見你的未來有奧卡茲島……」。｜Bring this dungeon with you. After submitting it, answer "I see Alcaz Island..." in your future.
06-路線外任務.md:1863｜路線外判定｜之後順路｜Later, en route

07-訓練師.md:33｜訓練時機｜貧瘠之地 棘齒城／陶拉祖營地或石爪山脈轉奧格瑪時。20 級可問雙持。可順路補的等級為 20、24 級。｜When The Barrens Ratchet / Camp Taurajo or Stonetalon Mountains is converted to Orgrimmar. At level 20, ask for dual wielding. The levels that can be replenished en route are levels 20 and 24.
07-訓練師.md:34｜訓練時機｜前往希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾前，在奧格瑪轉飛艇時。30 級可先在勇士島做狂暴姿態任務。可順路補的等級為 30、34、38 級。｜Before Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills Tarren Mill, when Orgrimmar was transferred to zeppelin. At level 30, first do the Violent Stance quest in Fray Island. The levels that can be replenished en route are levels 30, 34, and 38.
07-訓練師.md:35｜訓練時機｜悲傷沼澤 斯通納德初訪與回訪，補常用攻擊與防禦技能。可順路補的等級為 40、42–44、48 級。｜Swamp of Sorrows Stonard Initial visit and return visit to supplement common attack and defense skills. Levels that can be replenished en route are levels 40, 42–44, and 48.
07-訓練師.md:36｜訓練時機｜經幽暗城往辛特蘭 惡齒村時接職業支線並訓練，或升到 60 後回主城。可順路補的等級為 50–52、56、60 級。｜When going from Undercity to The Hinterlands Revantusk Village, pick up the career branch and train, or return to the main city after reaching level 60. Levels that can be replenished en route are 50–52, 56, and 60.

07-訓練師.md:45｜訓練時機｜銀松森林 瑟伯切爾／葛雷邁恩之牆或希爾斯布萊德丘陵 塔倫米爾行程經幽暗城時。20 級禍狼線要用雙手劍，先向軍事區武器大師確認。可順路補的等級為 16、18、20、26、30 級。｜Silverpine Forest The Sepulcher / Greymane's Wall or Hillsbrad Foothills Tarren Mill travels through Undercity. Level 20 Wolfsbane line requires a two-handed sword. Please confirm with the weapons master of the military zone first. The levels that can be replenished en route are levels 16, 18, 20, 26, and 30.

At level 40, receive professional war horse guidance. The levels that can be replenished en route are 38, 40, and 44.
07-訓練師.md:47｜訓練時機｜菲拉斯 莫沙徹營地回訪或升到 60 後，從卡林多順路飛雷霆崖。若正在東部王國，經幽暗城可改找嘉瑞‧拉苟。可順路補的等級為 50、56、60 級。｜Fly to Thunder Bluff on the Camp Mojache return or at level 60. In the Eastern Kingdoms, visit Garen Largo in Undercity. Train at levels 50, 56, and 60.

07-訓練師.md:318｜訓練時機｜坦德爾林地任務回報，離開林地前。｜Thendal Grove quest report, before leaving the woodland.
07-訓練師.md:319｜訓練時機｜微風島主線到申德村，回交同區任務時。｜Zephras Isle main line to Shen'dar Village, when handing back quests in the same area.
07-訓練師.md:320｜訓練時機｜瓦拉納爾回報、準備搭莫高雷線飛艇前。｜Valanaar returns and prepares to take the Mulgore line zeppelin.
07-訓練師.md:321｜訓練時機｜莫沙徹營地四次回訪交件時。｜Camp Mojache Four return visits and submission of documents.
07-訓練師.md:322｜訓練時機｜做月光林地職業任務，或永夜港兩次回訪時。｜When doing Moonglade professional quests, or Nighthaven two return visits.
07-訓練師.md:323｜訓練時機｜莫高雷離站，或經卡林多飛行點轉場時，由雷霆崖補技能。｜When Mulgore leaves the station or transitions through the flight path of Kalimdor, Thunder Bluff will supplement the skills.
07-訓練師.md:324｜訓練時機｜莫高雷離站，或經卡林多飛行點轉場時，由雷霆崖補技能。｜When Mulgore leaves the station or transitions through the flight path of Kalimdor, Thunder Bluff will supplement the skills.
07-訓練師.md:325｜訓練時機｜莫高雷離站，或經卡林多飛行點轉場時，由雷霆崖補技能。｜When Mulgore leaves the station or transitions through the flight path of Kalimdor, Thunder Bluff will supplement the skills.
07-訓練師.md:329｜訓練時機｜森金村／剃刀嶺做完一圈回鎮或往十字路口前。｜Sen'jin Village / Razor Hill After completing a circle, return to town or go to The Crossroads.
07-訓練師.md:330｜訓練時機｜莫高雷回血蹄村交件、轉往雷霆崖前。｜Mulgore returns to Bloodhoof Village before submission and transfer to Thunder Bluff.
07-訓練師.md:331｜訓練時機｜瓦拉納爾回報、準備搭莫高雷線飛艇前。｜Valanaar returns and prepares to take the Mulgore line zeppelin.
07-訓練師.md:332｜訓練時機｜荊棘谷第一次回格羅姆高交件，或第二次到營地時。｜Stranglethorn Vale When you return to Grom'gol for the first time or at the camp for the second time.
07-訓練師.md:333｜訓練時機｜去大河林地前經斯通納德，或悲傷沼澤兩趟回村交件時。｜When going to Riverglades via Stonard, or Swamp of Sorrows and returning to the village to submit documents.
07-訓練師.md:334｜訓練時機｜往銀松森林、塔倫米爾、格羅姆高或艾薩拉途中，已經過奧格瑪就補。｜En route to Silverpine Forest, Tarren Mill, Gromgau or Azshara, please make up after passing Orgrimmar.
07-訓練師.md:335｜訓練時機｜從血蹄村或微風島出發轉往十字路口，及已走莫高雷轉場時。｜When transferring from Bloodhoof Village or Zephras Isle to The Crossroads, and when transferring to Mulgore.
07-訓練師.md:342｜訓練時機｜往銀松森林、塔倫米爾、格羅姆高或艾薩拉途中，已經過奧格瑪就補。分別學該主城的傳送與傳送門。｜En route to Silverpine Forest, Tarren Mill, Gromgau or Azshara, please make up after passing Orgrimmar. Learn the teleportation and teleportation gates of the main city.
07-訓練師.md:343｜訓練時機｜從血蹄村或微風島出發轉往十字路口，及已走莫高雷轉場時。分別學該主城的傳送與傳送門。｜When transferring from Bloodhoof Village or Zephras Isle to The Crossroads, and when transferring to Mulgore. Learn the teleportation and teleportation gates of the main city.
07-訓練師.md:344｜訓練時機｜布瑞爾離站、銀松森林、塔倫米爾或辛特蘭出入東部王國時。分別學該主城的傳送與傳送門。｜When Brill leaves the station, Silverpine Forest, Tarren Mill or The Hinterlands enters or exits Eastern Kingdoms. Learn the teleportation and teleportation gates of the main city.
07-訓練師.md:350｜訓練時機｜弓、單手斧、雙手斧、法杖、投擲武器，每項 10 銀。｜Bows, one-handed axes, two-handed axes, staffs, thrown weapons, 10 silver each.
07-訓練師.md:351｜訓練時機｜弓、匕首、拳套、單手斧、雙手斧、法杖、投擲武器，每項 10 銀。｜Bows, daggers, gauntlets, one-handed axes, two-handed axes, staffs, throwing weapons, 10 silver each.
07-訓練師.md:352｜訓練時機｜槍械、單手錘、雙手錘、法杖，每項 10 銀。｜Firearms, one-handed maces, two-handed maces, staffs, 10 silver each.
07-訓練師.md:353｜訓練時機｜弩、匕首、單手劍、雙手劍，每項 10 銀。｜Crossbow, dagger, one-handed sword, two-handed sword, 10 silver each.
07-訓練師.md:354｜訓練時機｜長柄武器，1 金。銀松森林回幽暗城時可學，也可順便為後續長柄武器準備。｜Polearm, 1 gold. Silverpine Forest can be learned when returning to Undercity, and can also be used to prepare for subsequent pole weapons.
07-訓練師.md:363｜訓練時機｜學職業戰馬的任務對象。一般職業訓練由阿拉米斯‧錘手、夏莉‧斯迪威爾、嘉瑞‧拉苟或阿洛丹等已確認訓練師處理。｜The quest object of learning the professional war horse. General career training is handled by confirmed trainers such as Aramis Hammerhand, Shari Stilwell, Garen Largo or Alodan.
